tasks.question: 早高峰出站量高于进站量的地铁站中，差值最大的10个站是哪些？给出进站量、出站量、差值和观测小时数。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH station_hour AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour,
         SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_flow,
         SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), ranked AS (
  SELECT station_id,
         SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_total,
         SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_total,
         SUM(exit_flow) - SUM(entry_flow) AS difference,
         COUNT(*) AS compared_hours
  FROM station_hour
  GROUP BY station_id
  HAVING SUM(exit_flow) > SUM(entry_flow)
)
SELECT r.station_id, s.station_name, r.entry_total, r.exit_total,
       r.difference, r.compared_hours
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)

tasks.question: 每个地铁站今天进站量最高的小时是什么？并列峰值全部保留。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH station_hour AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_total
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), peaks AS (
  SELECT station_id, MAX(entry_total) AS peak_entry
  FROM station_hour
  GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT h.station_id, s.station_name, h.stat_hour AS peak_hour,
       h.entry_total AS peak_entry
FROM station_hour AS h
JOIN peaks AS p ON p.station_id = h.station_id
               AND p.peak_entry = h.entry_total
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)
ORDER BY h.station_id, h.stat_hour;

tasks.question: 早晚高峰六个小时都有记录的公交线路中，晚高峰比早高峰增加最多的10条线路是哪些？
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH windows AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN passenger_flow END) AS morning_total,
         SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN passenger_flow END) AS evening_total,
         COUNT(*) AS observed_hours
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
)
SELECT w.bus_line_id, l.line_name, w.morning_total, w.evening_total,
       w.evening_total - w.morning_total AS increase
FROM windows AS w
JOIN bus_line AS l USING (bus_line_id)
WHERE w.observed_hours = 6
ORDER BY increase DESC, w.bus_line_id
LIMIT 10;

tasks.question: 哪些公交线路今天有记录的小时少于18个？按有记录小时的平均客流列出前10条，并给出观测小时数、全天客流和小时平均客流。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH coverage AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id,
         COUNT(*) AS observed_hours,
         SUM(passenger_flow) AS daily_total,
         AVG(passenger_flow) AS average_hourly_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) < 18
)
SELECT c.bus_line_id, l.line_name, c.observed_hours, c.daily_total,
       ROUND(c.average_hourly_flow, 2) AS average_hourly_flow
FROM coverage AS c
JOIN bus_line AS l USING (bus_line_id)
ORDER BY c.average_hourly_flow DESC, c.bus_line_id
LIMIT 10;

tasks.question: 早晚高峰都有出租车下车完单观测的网格中，哪些网格晚高峰高于早高峰？给出两段总量和观测小时数。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH windows AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN taxi_dropoffs END) AS morning_dropoffs,
         SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN taxi_dropoffs END) AS evening_dropoffs,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS morning_hours,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS evening_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT geohash, morning_dropoffs, evening_dropoffs,
       morning_hours, evening_hours
FROM windows
WHERE morning_hours > 0 AND evening_hours > 0
  AND evening_dropoffs > morning_dropoffs
ORDER BY evening_dropoffs - morning_dropoffs DESC, geohash;

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(ridehail_orders) AS orders,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(orders) AS all_orders, SUM(dropoffs) AS all_dropoffs
  FROM hourly
)
SELECT h.hour, h.orders, h.dropoffs,
       ROUND(100.0 * h.orders / NULLIF(t.all_orders, 0), 2) AS order_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * h.dropoffs / NULLIF(t.all_dropoffs, 0), 2) AS dropoff_pct
FROM hourly AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY h.hour;

         MAX(CASE WHEN stat_hour = 7 THEN bike_locks END) AS locks_7,

         MAX(CASE WHEN stat_hour = 9 THEN bike_locks END) AS locks_9,

  FROM grid_flow_hour

  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT geohash, locks_7, locks_8, locks_9
FROM morning
WHERE observed_hours = 3
  AND locks_7 < locks_8
  AND locks_8 < locks_9
ORDER BY geohash;

WITH windows AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN bike_locks END) AS morning_locks,
         SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN bike_locks END) AS evening_locks,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS morning_hours,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS evening_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY geohash
)

       evening_locks - morning_locks AS increase,
       morning_hours, evening_hours
FROM windows
WHERE morning_hours > 0 AND evening_hours > 0
  AND evening_locks > morning_locks
ORDER BY increase DESC, geohash
LIMIT 10;

tasks.question: 公交客流量和网约车下单量各自最高的连续三小时窗口是什么？只使用两项都有观测的连续窗口，并列峰值全部保留。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH bus AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
), ridehail AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(ridehail_orders) AS ridehail_orders
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
), common AS (
  SELECT b.hour, b.bus_flow, r.ridehail_orders
  FROM bus AS b JOIN ridehail AS r USING (hour)
), windows AS (
  SELECT a.hour AS start_hour, c.hour AS end_hour,
         a.bus_flow + b.bus_flow + c.bus_flow AS bus_total,
         a.ridehail_orders + b.ridehail_orders + c.ridehail_orders AS ridehail_total
  FROM common AS a
  JOIN common AS b ON b.hour = a.hour + 1
  JOIN common AS c ON c.hour = a.hour + 2
), answers AS (
  SELECT '公交客流量' AS metric, start_hour, end_hour, bus_total AS window_total
  FROM windows WHERE bus_total = (SELECT MAX(bus_total) FROM windows)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '网约车下单量', start_hour, end_hour, ridehail_total
  FROM windows WHERE ridehail_total = (SELECT MAX(ridehail_total) FROM windows)
)
SELECT metric, start_hour, end_hour, window_total
FROM answers
ORDER BY metric, start_hour;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH wide AS (
  SELECT m.hour, m.metro_entries, b.bus_flow,
         g.taxi_pickups, g.ridehail_orders, g.bike_locks
  FROM (
    SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entries
    FROM metro_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' GROUP BY stat_hour
  ) AS m
  JOIN (
    SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
    FROM bus_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' GROUP BY stat_hour
  ) AS b USING (hour)
  JOIN (
    SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
           SUM(taxi_pickups) AS taxi_pickups,
           SUM(ridehail_orders) AS ridehail_orders,
           SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' GROUP BY stat_hour
  ) AS g USING (hour)
  WHERE g.taxi_pickups IS NOT NULL
    AND g.ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
    AND g.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
), long AS (
  SELECT '地铁进站量' AS metric, hour, metro_entries AS total FROM wide
  UNION ALL SELECT '公交客流量', hour, bus_flow FROM wide
  UNION ALL SELECT '出租车上车量', hour, taxi_pickups FROM wide
  UNION ALL SELECT '网约车下单量', hour, ridehail_orders FROM wide
  UNION ALL SELECT '共享单车锁车量', hour, bike_locks FROM wide
), running AS (
  SELECT metric, hour,
         SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY hour) AS cumulative_total,
         SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY metric) AS full_total
  FROM long
)
SELECT metric, MIN(hour) AS half_total_hour
FROM running
WHERE cumulative_total * 2 >= full_total
GROUP BY metric
ORDER BY metric;

tasks.question: 8时出租车下客、网约车下客和共享单车锁车三项指标的覆盖集合，两两交集数、并集数和交并比是多少？
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH presence AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         MAX(taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL) AS has_taxi,
         MAX(ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL) AS has_ridehail,
         MAX(bike_locks IS NOT NULL) AS has_bike
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour = 8
  GROUP BY geohash
), pairs AS (
  SELECT '出租车下客' AS metric_a, '网约车下客' AS metric_b,
         SUM(has_taxi AND has_ridehail) AS intersection_count,
         SUM(has_taxi OR has_ridehail) AS union_count
  FROM presence
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '出租车下客', '共享单车锁车',
         SUM(has_taxi AND has_bike), SUM(has_taxi OR has_bike)
  FROM presence
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '网约车下客', '共享单车锁车',
         SUM(has_ridehail AND has_bike), SUM(has_ridehail OR has_bike)
  FROM presence
)
SELECT metric_a, metric_b, intersection_count, union_count,
       ROUND(1.0 * intersection_count / NULLIF(union_count, 0), 6) AS jaccard
FROM pairs
ORDER BY metric_a, metric_b;

notes: metric_a与metric_b按题目列举的指标顺序排列：出租车下客、网约车下客、共享单车锁车；每组中metric_a必须位于metric_b之前。

  WHERE taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL

  SELECT *, (taxi_rank <= 100) + (ridehail_rank <= 100) + (bike_rank <= 100) AS top_count

FROM flagged

ORDER BY hotspot_pair, geohash;

tasks.question: 早高峰和晚高峰中，出租车与网约车下客量各自前20个网格的交集数、并集数和交并比分别是多少？
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '早高峰' ELSE '晚高峰' END AS period,
         geohash,
         SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY period, geohash
), taxi AS (
  SELECT period, geohash,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY taxi_dropoffs DESC, geohash) AS rank
  FROM totals WHERE taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
), ridehail AS (
  SELECT period, geohash,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash) AS rank
  FROM totals WHERE ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
), members AS (
  SELECT period, geohash, 'taxi' AS mode FROM taxi WHERE rank <= 20
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period, geohash, 'ridehail' FROM ridehail WHERE rank <= 20
), counts AS (
  SELECT period, geohash, COUNT(*) AS mode_count
  FROM members GROUP BY period, geohash
)
SELECT period,
       SUM(mode_count = 2) AS intersection_count,
       COUNT(*) AS union_count,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(mode_count = 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 6) AS jaccard
FROM counts
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period;

WITH common AS (
  SELECT geohash, stat_hour AS hour, taxi_dropoffs, ridehail_dropoffs,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY geohash) AS common_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
), peaks AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(taxi_dropoffs) OVER (PARTITION BY geohash) AS max_taxi,
         MAX(ridehail_dropoffs) OVER (PARTITION BY geohash) AS max_ridehail
  FROM common
), classified AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         MAX(taxi_dropoffs = max_taxi AND ridehail_dropoffs = max_ridehail) AS has_common_peak
  FROM peaks
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT CASE WHEN has_common_peak THEN '峰值小时有重合' ELSE '峰值小时无重合' END AS peak_relation,
       COUNT(*) AS grid_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY has_common_peak
ORDER BY has_common_peak DESC;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH taxi AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, geohash,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY taxi_dropoffs DESC, geohash) AS rank
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
), ridehail AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, geohash,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash) AS rank
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
), bike AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, geohash,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY bike_locks DESC, geohash) AS rank
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
), members AS (
  SELECT hour, geohash, '出租车下客' AS metric FROM taxi WHERE rank <= 10
  UNION ALL SELECT hour, geohash, '网约车下客' FROM ridehail WHERE rank <= 10
  UNION ALL SELECT hour, geohash, '共享单车锁车' FROM bike WHERE rank <= 10
), qualified AS (
  SELECT hour, geohash, COUNT(*) AS hotspot_types,
         GROUP_CONCAT(metric, '+') AS included_metrics
  FROM members
  GROUP BY hour, geohash
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT hour, geohash, hotspot_types, included_metrics,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY hour) AS qualifying_grids_in_hour
FROM qualified
ORDER BY hour, geohash;

tasks.question: 共同观测不少于6个小时且两项均值为正的网格中，网约车下客和共享单车锁车的峰均比差异最大的10个是哪些？
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH common AS (
  SELECT geohash, stat_hour,
         ridehail_dropoffs, bike_locks,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY geohash) AS common_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT geohash, common_hours,
         MAX(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_peak,
         AVG(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_mean,
         MAX(bike_locks) AS bike_peak,
         AVG(bike_locks) AS bike_mean
  FROM common
  GROUP BY geohash, common_hours
  HAVING common_hours >= 6
     AND AVG(ridehail_dropoffs) > 0
     AND AVG(bike_locks) > 0
)
SELECT geohash, common_hours,
       ROUND(1.0 * ridehail_peak / ridehail_mean, 6) AS ridehail_peak_ratio,
       ROUND(1.0 * bike_peak / bike_mean, 6) AS bike_peak_ratio,
       ROUND(ABS(1.0 * ridehail_peak / ridehail_mean
               - 1.0 * bike_peak / bike_mean), 6) AS ratio_difference
FROM stats
ORDER BY ratio_difference DESC, geohash
LIMIT 10;

WITH long AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, geohash, 'ridehail' AS metric, ridehail_dropoffs AS value
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, 'bike', bike_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY metric, hour ORDER BY value DESC, geohash
  ) AS rank_in_hour
  FROM long
), concentration AS (
  SELECT metric, hour,
         1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rank_in_hour <= 10 THEN value END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(value), 0) AS concentration
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY metric, hour
  HAVING SUM(value) > 0
), wide AS (
  SELECT hour,
         MAX(CASE WHEN metric = 'ridehail' THEN concentration END) AS ridehail_concentration,
         MAX(CASE WHEN metric = 'bike' THEN concentration END) AS bike_concentration
  FROM concentration
  GROUP BY hour
  HAVING ridehail_concentration IS NOT NULL AND bike_concentration IS NOT NULL
), compared AS (
  SELECT *,
         AVG(ridehail_concentration) OVER () AS average_ridehail_concentration,
         AVG(bike_concentration) OVER () AS average_bike_concentration
  FROM wide
)
SELECT hour,
       ROUND(ridehail_concentration, 6) AS ridehail_concentration,
       ROUND(bike_concentration, 6) AS bike_concentration,
       ROUND(average_ridehail_concentration, 6) AS average_ridehail_concentration,
       ROUND(average_bike_concentration, 6) AS average_bike_concentration
FROM compared
WHERE ridehail_concentration > average_ridehail_concentration
  AND bike_concentration > average_bike_concentration
ORDER BY hour;

FROM metro_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '公交客流量',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN passenger_flow END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN passenger_flow END)
FROM bus_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '出租车下客',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN taxi_dropoffs END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN taxi_dropoffs END)
FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '网约车下客',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN ridehail_dropoffs END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN ridehail_dropoffs END)
FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '共享单车锁车',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN bike_locks END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN bike_locks END)
FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
ORDER BY mode;

WITH RECURSIVE hours(hour) AS (
  SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT hour + 1 FROM hours WHERE hour < 23
), target AS (
  SELECT station_id FROM metro_station WHERE station_name = '徐家汇'
), ring_grid AS (
  SELECT d.geohash,
         CASE WHEN d.distance_m <= 300 THEN '0-300' ELSE '300-800' END AS ring
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN target AS t USING (station_id)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 800
), totals AS (
  SELECT r.ring, f.stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(f.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs,
         SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
         SUM(f.bike_locks) AS bike_locks
  FROM ring_grid AS r
  JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f USING (geohash)
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY r.ring, f.stat_hour
), rings(ring) AS (
  SELECT '0-300' UNION ALL SELECT '300-800'
)

FROM rings AS r CROSS JOIN hours AS h
LEFT JOIN totals AS t USING (ring, hour)
ORDER BY r.ring, h.hour;

tasks.question: 地铁出站量与站点500米内共享单车锁车量共同观测不少于6个小时的站中，两项峰值小时有重合和无重合的站分别有多少？若存在并列峰值，只要两个峰值小时集合有交集即视为有重合。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH metro AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour AS hour, SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), bike AS (
  SELECT d.station_id, f.stat_hour AS hour, SUM(f.bike_locks) AS bike_locks
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f USING (geohash)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
    AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND f.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.station_id, f.stat_hour
), common AS (
  SELECT m.station_id, m.hour, m.exit_flow, b.bike_locks,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.station_id) AS common_hours
  FROM metro AS m JOIN bike AS b USING (station_id, hour)
), peaks AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(exit_flow) OVER (PARTITION BY station_id) AS max_exit,
         MAX(bike_locks) OVER (PARTITION BY station_id) AS max_bike
  FROM common
  WHERE common_hours >= 6
), classified AS (
  SELECT station_id,
         MAX(exit_flow = max_exit AND bike_locks = max_bike) AS has_common_peak
  FROM peaks
  GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN has_common_peak THEN '峰值小时有重合' ELSE '峰值小时无重合' END AS peak_relation,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY has_common_peak
ORDER BY has_common_peak DESC;

WITH metro AS (

  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), ridehail AS (
  SELECT d.station_id, f.stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f USING (geohash)

), common AS (
  SELECT m.station_id, m.hour, m.exit_flow, r.ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM metro AS m JOIN ridehail AS r USING (station_id, hour)
), windows AS (
  SELECT station_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN exit_flow END) AS morning_exit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN exit_flow END) AS evening_exit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN ridehail_dropoffs END) AS morning_ridehail,

FROM windows AS w

)

       all_taxi AS all_grid_total,
       ROUND(100.0 * covered_taxi / NULLIF(all_taxi, 0), 2) AS covered_pct

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH covered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
), grid_totals AS (
  SELECT f.geohash,
         CASE WHEN c.geohash IS NULL THEN '500米范围外' ELSE '500米范围内' END AS area_type,
         SUM(f.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_daily,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END) AS taxi_morning,
         SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_daily,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN f.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS ridehail_morning
  FROM grid_flow_hour AS f
  LEFT JOIN covered AS c USING (geohash)
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY f.geohash, area_type
), area_totals AS (
  SELECT area_type,
         SUM(taxi_daily) AS taxi_daily,
         SUM(taxi_morning) AS taxi_morning,
         SUM(ridehail_daily) AS ridehail_daily,
         SUM(ridehail_morning) AS ridehail_morning
  FROM grid_totals
  WHERE taxi_daily IS NOT NULL OR ridehail_daily IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY area_type
)
SELECT area_type, '出租车下客' AS metric,
       taxi_morning AS morning_total, taxi_daily AS daily_total,
       ROUND(100.0 * taxi_morning / NULLIF(taxi_daily, 0), 2) AS morning_pct
FROM area_totals
UNION ALL
SELECT area_type, '网约车下客', ridehail_morning, ridehail_daily,
       ROUND(100.0 * ridehail_morning / NULLIF(ridehail_daily, 0), 2)
FROM area_totals
ORDER BY area_type, metric;

tasks.question: 对于同时位于至少两个地铁站500米内的网格，将其分配给最近站。按归属站汇总晚高峰共享单车锁车量和网约车下客量。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
  GROUP BY geohash
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 2
), ranked AS (
  SELECT d.station_id, d.geohash, d.distance_m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY d.geohash ORDER BY d.distance_m, d.station_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN candidates AS c USING (geohash)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
), owners AS (
  SELECT station_id, geohash FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), assigned_stations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT station_id FROM owners
), totals AS (
  SELECT o.station_id,
         SUM(f.bike_locks) AS evening_bike,
         SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
  FROM owners AS o
  LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f
    ON f.geohash = o.geohash
   AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND f.stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
  GROUP BY o.station_id
)
SELECT a.station_id, s.station_name, t.evening_bike, t.evening_ridehail
FROM assigned_stations AS a
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN totals AS t USING (station_id)
ORDER BY a.station_id;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT station_id, station_name
  FROM metro_station
  WHERE station_name IN ('徐家汇', '上海体育馆')
), membership AS (
  SELECT d.geohash,
         MAX(t.station_name = '徐家汇') AS near_xujiahui,
         MAX(t.station_name = '上海体育馆') AS near_stadium
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN target AS t USING (station_id)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 800
  GROUP BY d.geohash
), classified AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         CASE
           WHEN near_xujiahui AND near_stadium THEN '两站都覆盖'
           WHEN near_xujiahui THEN '只靠近徐家汇'
           ELSE '只靠近上海体育馆'
         END AS area_type
  FROM membership
), totals AS (
  SELECT c.area_type,
         SUM(f.taxi_dropoffs) AS evening_taxi,
         SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail,
         SUM(f.bike_locks) AS evening_bike
  FROM classified AS c
  LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f
    ON f.geohash = c.geohash
   AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND f.stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
  GROUP BY c.area_type
), axis(area_type) AS (
  SELECT '只靠近徐家汇'
  UNION ALL SELECT '只靠近上海体育馆'
  UNION ALL SELECT '两站都覆盖'
)
SELECT a.area_type, t.evening_taxi, t.evening_ridehail, t.evening_bike
FROM axis AS a LEFT JOIN totals AS t USING (area_type)
ORDER BY a.area_type;

WITH metro_hour AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_flow
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), metro AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS morning_entry,
         COUNT(*) AS metro_observed_hours
  FROM metro_hour GROUP BY station_id
), bus AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS morning_bus_flow,
         COUNT(*) AS bus_observed_hours
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
), nearby AS (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       n.bus_line_id, l.line_name,
       b.morning_bus_flow, b.bus_observed_hours,
       m.morning_entry, m.metro_observed_hours
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN nearby AS n USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN bus_line AS l USING (bus_line_id)
LEFT JOIN bus AS b USING (bus_line_id)
LEFT JOIN metro AS m USING (station_id)
ORDER BY s.station_id, n.bus_line_id;

LEFT JOIN daily AS d USING (bus_line_id)
ORDER BY n.station_count DESC, n.bus_line_id;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY bus_line_id ORDER BY distance_m, station_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
), assigned AS (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), bus_daily AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS daily_bus_total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
), assigned_totals AS (
  SELECT a.station_id,
         COUNT(*) AS assigned_lines,
         SUM(b.daily_bus_total) AS assigned_bus_total
  FROM assigned AS a
  LEFT JOIN bus_daily AS b USING (bus_line_id)
  GROUP BY a.station_id
), metro AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entry_total
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       COALESCE(a.assigned_lines, 0) AS assigned_lines,
       a.assigned_bus_total, m.metro_entry_total
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN assigned_totals AS a USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN metro AS m USING (station_id)
ORDER BY s.station_id;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH station_exit AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(exit_flow) AS morning_exit
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY station_id
), top_stations AS (
  SELECT station_id FROM station_exit
  ORDER BY morning_exit DESC, station_id LIMIT 10
), selected_grids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance JOIN top_stations USING (station_id)
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
), all_station_grids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance WHERE distance_m <= 500
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END) AS selected_taxi,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END) AS all_taxi,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS selected_ridehail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS all_ridehail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.bike_locks END) AS selected_bike,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.bike_locks END) AS all_bike
  FROM grid_flow_hour AS f
  LEFT JOIN selected_grids AS s USING (geohash)
  LEFT JOIN all_station_grids AS a USING (geohash)
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT '出租车下客' AS metric, selected_taxi AS selected_total,
       all_taxi AS all_station_total,
       ROUND(100.0 * selected_taxi / NULLIF(all_taxi, 0), 2) AS selected_pct
FROM totals
UNION ALL
SELECT '网约车下客', selected_ridehail, all_ridehail,
       ROUND(100.0 * selected_ridehail / NULLIF(all_ridehail, 0), 2)
FROM totals
UNION ALL
SELECT '共享单车锁车', selected_bike, all_bike,
       ROUND(100.0 * selected_bike / NULLIF(all_bike, 0), 2)
FROM totals;

tasks.question: 对每个地铁站，分别以800米内共享单车锁车量和网约车下客量为权重计算平均距离。列出两项平均距离之差的绝对值最大的10个站。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY geohash
), weighted AS (
  SELECT d.station_id,
         SUM(d.distance_m * g.bike_locks) / NULLIF(SUM(g.bike_locks), 0) AS bike_average_distance,
         SUM(d.distance_m * g.ridehail_dropoffs) / NULLIF(SUM(g.ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS ridehail_average_distance,
         SUM(g.bike_locks) AS bike_total,
         SUM(g.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_total
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN daily AS g USING (geohash)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 800
  GROUP BY d.station_id
)
SELECT w.station_id, s.station_name,
       w.bike_average_distance, w.ridehail_average_distance,
       ABS(w.bike_average_distance - w.ridehail_average_distance) AS distance_difference
FROM weighted AS w
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)
WHERE w.bike_total > 0 AND w.ridehail_total > 0
ORDER BY distance_difference DESC, w.station_id
LIMIT 10;

notes: distance_difference使用未提前舍入的两个平均距离计算。

tasks.question: 对每个地铁站，在500米范围内寻找共享单车锁车和出租车下客各自最高的连续三小时窗口。只使用两项指标在窗口三个小时均有观测的窗口；列出两项最高窗口起点相同的站，并列峰值全部保留。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH station_hour AS (
  SELECT d.station_id, f.stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(f.bike_locks) AS bike_locks,
         SUM(f.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f USING (geohash)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 500 AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY d.station_id, f.stat_hour
), windows AS (
  SELECT a.station_id, a.hour AS start_hour,
         a.bike_locks + b.bike_locks + c.bike_locks AS bike_window,
         a.taxi_dropoffs + b.taxi_dropoffs + c.taxi_dropoffs AS taxi_window
  FROM station_hour AS a
  JOIN station_hour AS b ON b.station_id = a.station_id AND b.hour = a.hour + 1
  JOIN station_hour AS c ON c.station_id = a.station_id AND c.hour = a.hour + 2
  WHERE a.bike_locks IS NOT NULL AND b.bike_locks IS NOT NULL AND c.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    AND a.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL AND b.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL AND c.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
), peaks AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(bike_window) OVER (PARTITION BY station_id) AS max_bike_window,
         MAX(taxi_window) OVER (PARTITION BY station_id) AS max_taxi_window
  FROM windows
)
SELECT p.station_id, s.station_name, p.start_hour,
       p.bike_window, p.taxi_window
FROM peaks AS p
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)
WHERE p.bike_window = p.max_bike_window
  AND p.taxi_window = p.max_taxi_window
ORDER BY p.station_id, p.start_hour;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH ranked_neighbors AS (
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id, distance_m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY distance_m, nearby_station_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM metro_station_distance
), chosen AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_neighbors WHERE rn <= 3
), station_hour AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_flow
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), morning AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS morning_entry, COUNT(*) AS observed_hours
  FROM station_hour GROUP BY station_id
), neighbor_summary AS (
  SELECT c.station_id,
         COUNT(*) AS selected_neighbor_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.observed_hours = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_neighbor_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.observed_hours = 3 THEN m.morning_entry END) AS available_neighbor_entry
  FROM chosen AS c
  LEFT JOIN morning AS m ON m.station_id = c.nearby_station_id
  GROUP BY c.station_id
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       CASE WHEN own.observed_hours = 3 THEN own.morning_entry END AS station_morning_entry,
       COALESCE(n.selected_neighbor_count, 0) AS selected_neighbor_count,
       COALESCE(n.valid_neighbor_count, 0) AS valid_neighbor_count,
       CASE WHEN n.selected_neighbor_count = n.valid_neighbor_count
            THEN n.available_neighbor_entry END AS neighbor_entry_total
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN morning AS own USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN neighbor_summary AS n USING (station_id)
ORDER BY s.station_id;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH nearest AS (
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id, distance_m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY distance_m, nearby_station_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM metro_station_distance
), mutual AS (
  SELECT a.station_id AS station_a_id,
         a.nearby_station_id AS station_b_id,
         a.distance_m
  FROM nearest AS a
  JOIN nearest AS b
    ON b.station_id = a.nearby_station_id
   AND b.nearby_station_id = a.station_id
  WHERE a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 1 AND a.station_id < a.nearby_station_id
), station_hour AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), evening AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(exit_flow) AS evening_exit, COUNT(*) AS observed_hours
  FROM station_hour GROUP BY station_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
)
SELECT m.station_a_id, a.station_name AS station_a_name,
       m.station_b_id, b.station_name AS station_b_name,
       m.distance_m,
       ea.evening_exit AS station_a_exit,
       eb.evening_exit AS station_b_exit,
       ABS(ea.evening_exit - eb.evening_exit) AS exit_difference
FROM mutual AS m
JOIN metro_station AS a ON a.station_id = m.station_a_id
JOIN metro_station AS b ON b.station_id = m.station_b_id
JOIN evening AS ea ON ea.station_id = m.station_a_id
JOIN evening AS eb ON eb.station_id = m.station_b_id
ORDER BY exit_difference DESC, m.station_a_id, m.station_b_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH outer_lines AS (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id, distance_m
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m > 500 AND distance_m <= 1000
), bus AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS morning_bus_flow,
         COUNT(*) AS observed_hours
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       o.bus_line_id, l.line_name, o.distance_m,
       b.morning_bus_flow, b.observed_hours
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN outer_lines AS o USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN bus_line AS l USING (bus_line_id)
LEFT JOIN bus AS b USING (bus_line_id)
ORDER BY s.station_id, o.bus_line_id;

tasks.question: 哪些地铁站300米内没有公交线路，但300至800米内至少有3条？给出外围线路数、早高峰观测完整线路数、早高峰公交客流量、本站早高峰出站量和本站早高峰观测小时数。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH candidate_stations AS (
  SELECT s.station_id
  FROM metro_station AS s
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM metro_bus_line_distance AS d
    WHERE d.station_id = s.station_id AND d.distance_m <= 300
  )
), peripheral AS (
  SELECT d.station_id, d.bus_line_id
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance AS d
  JOIN candidate_stations AS s USING (station_id)
  WHERE d.distance_m > 300 AND d.distance_m <= 800
), qualified AS (
  SELECT station_id
  FROM peripheral
  GROUP BY station_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bus_line_id) >= 3
), bus AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS morning_bus_flow,
         COUNT(*) AS observed_hours
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
), bus_summary AS (
  SELECT p.station_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.bus_line_id) AS nearby_lines,
         SUM(b.observed_hours = 3) AS complete_lines,
         SUM(b.morning_bus_flow) AS morning_bus_total
  FROM peripheral AS p
  JOIN qualified AS q USING (station_id)
  LEFT JOIN bus AS b USING (bus_line_id)
  GROUP BY p.station_id
), metro_hour AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
), metro AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(exit_flow) AS morning_exit, COUNT(*) AS observed_hours
  FROM metro_hour GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT q.station_id, s.station_name,
       b.nearby_lines, b.complete_lines, b.morning_bus_total,
       m.morning_exit, m.observed_hours AS metro_observed_hours
FROM qualified AS q
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)
JOIN bus_summary AS b USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN metro AS m USING (station_id)
ORDER BY q.station_id;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH coverage AS (
  SELECT geohash, COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS nearby_stations
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 800
  GROUP BY geohash
), totals AS (
  SELECT
         CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(c.nearby_stations, 0) = 0 THEN '0'
           WHEN c.nearby_stations = 1 THEN '1'
           WHEN c.nearby_stations = 2 THEN '2'
           ELSE '3+'
         END AS station_count_group,
         SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
         SUM(f.bike_locks) AS bike_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour AS f
  LEFT JOIN coverage AS c USING (geohash)
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_count_group
), all_totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS all_ridehail,
         SUM(bike_locks) AS all_bike
  FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT t.station_count_group, t.ridehail_dropoffs, t.bike_locks,
       ROUND(100.0 * t.ridehail_dropoffs / NULLIF(a.all_ridehail, 0), 2) AS ridehail_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * t.bike_locks / NULLIF(a.all_bike, 0), 2) AS bike_pct
FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN all_totals AS a
ORDER BY CASE t.station_count_group WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

tasks.question: 将全部地铁站的网格并集从500米扩大到800米。新增网格内出租车和网约车下客量分别是多少，相当于原500米范围总量的百分比是多少？
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH within500 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash FROM metro_grid_distance WHERE distance_m <= 500
), within800 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash FROM metro_grid_distance WHERE distance_m <= 800
), added AS (
  SELECT geohash FROM within800
  EXCEPT
  SELECT geohash FROM within500
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END) AS added_taxi,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END) AS base_taxi,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS added_ridehail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN f.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS base_ridehail
  FROM grid_flow_hour AS f
  LEFT JOIN added AS a USING (geohash)
  LEFT JOIN within500 AS b USING (geohash)
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT added_taxi, base_taxi,
       ROUND(100.0 * added_taxi / NULLIF(base_taxi, 0), 2) AS taxi_added_pct,
       added_ridehail, base_ridehail,
       ROUND(100.0 * added_ridehail / NULLIF(base_ridehail, 0), 2) AS ridehail_added_pct
FROM totals;

tasks.question: 对于500米范围有共同网格的地铁站对，计算共同网格内早高峰共享单车锁车量和网约车下客量，按锁车量列出前10对。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH station_grid AS (
  SELECT station_id, geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance WHERE distance_m <= 500
), shared AS (
  SELECT a.station_id AS station_a_id,
         b.station_id AS station_b_id,
         a.geohash
  FROM station_grid AS a
  JOIN station_grid AS b
    ON b.geohash = a.geohash AND b.station_id > a.station_id
), morning AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY geohash
), pair_totals AS (
  SELECT s.station_a_id, s.station_b_id,
         SUM(m.bike_locks) AS morning_bike,
         SUM(m.ridehail_dropoffs) AS morning_ridehail
  FROM shared AS s
  JOIN morning AS m USING (geohash)
  GROUP BY s.station_a_id, s.station_b_id
)
SELECT p.station_a_id, a.station_name AS station_a_name,
       p.station_b_id, b.station_name AS station_b_name,
       p.morning_bike, p.morning_ridehail
FROM pair_totals AS p
JOIN metro_station AS a ON a.station_id = p.station_a_id
JOIN metro_station AS b ON b.station_id = p.station_b_id
ORDER BY p.morning_bike DESC, p.station_a_id, p.station_b_id
LIMIT 10;

tasks.gold_sql:
WITH line_station AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT line_id, station_id FROM metro_flow_hour
), station_grid AS (
  SELECT ls.line_id, ls.station_id, d.geohash
  FROM line_station AS ls
  JOIN metro_grid_distance AS d USING (station_id)
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
), bike AS (
  SELECT geohash, SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geohash
), station_totals AS (
  SELECT g.line_id, g.station_id, SUM(b.bike_locks) AS station_bike
  FROM station_grid AS g JOIN bike AS b USING (geohash)
  GROUP BY g.line_id, g.station_id
), station_sum AS (
  SELECT line_id, SUM(station_bike) AS station_sum_locks
  FROM station_totals GROUP BY line_id
), union_sum AS (
  SELECT line_id, SUM(b.bike_locks) AS union_locks
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT line_id, geohash FROM station_grid) AS g
  JOIN bike AS b USING (geohash)
  GROUP BY line_id
)
SELECT l.line_id, l.line_name,
       s.station_sum_locks, u.union_locks,
       s.station_sum_locks - u.union_locks AS repeated_locks,
       ROUND(100.0 * (s.station_sum_locks - u.union_locks)
             / NULLIF(s.station_sum_locks, 0), 2) AS repeated_pct
FROM metro_line AS l
LEFT JOIN station_sum AS s USING (line_id)
LEFT JOIN union_sum AS u USING (line_id)
ORDER BY l.line_id;

WITH ranked_distance AS (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id, distance_m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY distance_m, bus_line_id
         ) AS near_rank
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 800
), nearest_five AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_distance WHERE near_rank <= 5
), daily AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS daily_bus_total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
), choices AS (
  SELECT n.*, d.daily_bus_total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY n.station_id
           ORDER BY d.daily_bus_total DESC, n.bus_line_id
         ) AS flow_rank
  FROM nearest_five AS n
  LEFT JOIN daily AS d USING (bus_line_id)
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       c.bus_line_id, l.line_name,
       c.daily_bus_total, c.distance_m, c.near_rank
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN choices AS c ON c.station_id = s.station_id AND c.flow_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN bus_line AS l USING (bus_line_id)
ORDER BY s.station_id;

tasks.question: 将地铁站1公里内网格唯一分配给最近站，再分为0至300米、300至500米、500至1000米三环。给出每站每环晚高峰共享单车锁车量和网约车下客量；每个站的三个环都保留，没有分配网格或观测时指标为NULL。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT station_id, geohash, distance_m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY geohash ORDER BY distance_m, station_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM metro_grid_distance
), owners AS (
  SELECT station_id, geohash,
         CASE
           WHEN distance_m <= 300 THEN '0-300'
           WHEN distance_m <= 500 THEN '300-500'
           ELSE '500-1000'
         END AS ring
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), evening AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
  GROUP BY geohash
), totals AS (
  SELECT o.station_id, o.ring,
         SUM(e.bike_locks) AS evening_bike,
         SUM(e.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
  FROM owners AS o
  LEFT JOIN evening AS e USING (geohash)
  GROUP BY o.station_id, o.ring
), rings(ring) AS (
  SELECT '0-300' UNION ALL SELECT '300-500' UNION ALL SELECT '500-1000'
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, r.ring,
       t.evening_bike, t.evening_ridehail
FROM metro_station AS s CROSS JOIN rings AS r
LEFT JOIN totals AS t USING (station_id, ring)
ORDER BY s.station_id, r.ring;

将地铁站1公里内网格唯一分配给最近站，再分为0至300米、300至500米、500至1000米三环。给出每站每环晚高峰共享单车锁车量和网约车下客量；每个站的三个环都保留，没有分配网格或观测时指标为NULL。

  - `station_name`：TEXT，非空
  - `ring`：TEXT，非空，可选值：“0-300”、“300-500”、“500-1000”
  - `evening_bike`：INTEGER，可为NULL
  - `evening_ridehail`：INTEGER，可为NULL

tasks.question: 每个地铁站500米内有多少个网格？给出站点ID、站名和网格数，保留网格数为0的站。
tasks.gold_sql:
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.geohash) AS grid_count
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN metro_grid_distance AS d
  ON d.station_id = s.station_id AND d.distance_m <= 500
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY s.station_id;

tasks.question: 每个地铁站800米内网约车下客量是多少？给出有下客观测的网格数，并保留没有下客观测的站。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT geohash, SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       SUM(daily.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
       COUNT(daily.ridehail_dropoffs) AS observed_grids
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN metro_grid_distance AS d
  ON d.station_id = s.station_id AND d.distance_m <= 800
LEFT JOIN daily USING (geohash)
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY s.station_id;
supplementary_notes: “今天”指2026-08-24，时间按上海本地时间解释。

tasks.question: 对1公里内至少有一个地铁站的公交线路，给出最近地铁站及距离；距离并列时按站点ID取一个。
tasks.gold_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT d.bus_line_id, d.station_id, d.distance_m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY d.bus_line_id
           ORDER BY d.distance_m, d.station_id
         ) AS distance_rank
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance AS d
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 1000
)
SELECT r.bus_line_id, b.line_name,
       r.station_id, s.station_name, r.distance_m
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN bus_line AS b USING (bus_line_id)
JOIN metro_station AS s USING (station_id)
WHERE r.distance_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.bus_line_id;
supplementary_notes: “今天”指2026-08-24，时间按上海本地时间解释。

SELECT mf.station_id AS station_id, ms.station_name AS station_name, SUM(mf.entry_flow) AS entry_total
FROM metro_flow_hour AS mf
JOIN metro_station AS ms ON mf.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE mf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY mf.station_id, ms.station_name
ORDER BY entry_total DESC, mf.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8) THEN entry_flow ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_entry,
    COALESCE(SUM(entry_flow), 0) AS daily_entry
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  morning_entry,
  daily_entry,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN daily_entry > 0 THEN morning_entry * 100.0 / daily_entry
      ELSE 0.0
    END,
    2
  ) AS morning_pct
FROM agg;

SELECT
  s.station_id AS station_id,
  s.station_name AS station_name,
  SUM(f.entry_flow) AS entry_total,
  SUM(f.exit_flow) AS exit_total,
  SUM(f.exit_flow) - SUM(f.entry_flow) AS difference,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.stat_hour) AS compared_hours
FROM metro_flow_hour AS f
JOIN metro_station AS s ON s.station_id = f.station_id
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 8
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
HAVING SUM(f.exit_flow) > SUM(f.entry_flow)
ORDER BY difference DESC, s.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  s.station_id AS station_id,
  s.station_name AS station_name,
  f.stat_hour AS hour,
  SUM(f.entry_flow) AS entry_total,
  SUM(f.exit_flow) AS exit_total
FROM metro_station AS s
JOIN metro_flow_hour AS f
  ON s.station_id = f.station_id
WHERE s.station_name = '徐家汇'
  AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, f.stat_hour
ORDER BY s.station_id, f.stat_hour;

WITH hourly_entry AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    stat_hour,
    SUM(entry_flow) AS peak_entry
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
),
ranked_entry AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    stat_hour AS peak_hour,
    peak_entry,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY station_id
      ORDER BY peak_entry DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM hourly_entry
)
SELECT
  r.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  r.peak_hour,
  r.peak_entry
FROM ranked_entry r
JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = r.station_id
WHERE r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY r.station_id, r.peak_hour;

SELECT ml.line_id,
       ml.line_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0) AS entry_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) AS exit_total
FROM metro_line ml
LEFT JOIN metro_flow_hour mfh
  ON mfh.line_id = ml.line_id
 AND mfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY ml.line_id, ml.line_name
ORDER BY ml.line_id;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS bus_total FROM bus_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24';

SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
       SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bus_line_id) AS observed_lines
FROM bus_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY stat_hour
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT b.bus_line_id AS bus_line_id,
       b.line_name AS line_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(f.passenger_flow), 0) AS bus_total
FROM bus_flow_hour f
JOIN bus_line b ON b.bus_line_id = f.bus_line_id
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY b.bus_line_id, b.line_name
ORDER BY bus_total DESC, b.bus_line_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH today_flow AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, stat_hour, passenger_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7,8,9,17,18,19)
),
valid_lines AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id
  FROM today_flow
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 6
),
morning AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS morning_total
  FROM today_flow
  WHERE stat_hour IN (7,8,9)
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
),
evening AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS evening_total
  FROM today_flow
  WHERE stat_hour IN (17,18,19)
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
)
SELECT bl.bus_line_id,
       bl.line_name,
       m.morning_total,
       e.evening_total,
       e.evening_total - m.morning_total AS increase
FROM valid_lines v
JOIN morning m ON v.bus_line_id = m.bus_line_id
JOIN evening e ON v.bus_line_id = e.bus_line_id
JOIN bus_line bl ON v.bus_line_id = bl.bus_line_id
ORDER BY increase DESC, bl.bus_line_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    stat_hour,
    SUM(passenger_flow) AS peak_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND passenger_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bus_line_id, stat_hour
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    stat_hour AS peak_hour,
    peak_flow,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bus_line_id ORDER BY peak_flow DESC) AS rnk
  FROM hourly
)
SELECT
  r.bus_line_id,
  b.line_name,
  r.peak_hour,
  r.peak_flow
FROM ranked r
JOIN bus_line b ON b.bus_line_id = r.bus_line_id
WHERE r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY r.bus_line_id, r.peak_hour;

SELECT
  b.bus_line_id,
  b.line_name,
  SUM(f.passenger_flow) AS night_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.passenger_flow > 0 THEN f.stat_hour END) AS positive_hours
FROM bus_flow_hour AS f
JOIN bus_line AS b ON b.bus_line_id = f.bus_line_id
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND f.stat_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5
GROUP BY b.bus_line_id, b.line_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.passenger_flow > 0 THEN f.stat_hour END) > 0
ORDER BY b.bus_line_id;

SELECT
  b.bus_line_id,
  b.line_name,
  f.stat_hour AS hour,
  f.passenger_flow
FROM bus_flow_hour AS f
JOIN bus_line AS b
  ON f.bus_line_id = b.bus_line_id
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND b.line_name = '隧道夜宵线'
ORDER BY b.bus_line_id, f.stat_hour;

SELECT
  b.bus_line_id,
  l.line_name,
  COUNT(b.passenger_flow) AS observed_hours,
  SUM(b.passenger_flow) AS daily_total,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(b.passenger_flow) / COUNT(b.passenger_flow), 2) AS average_hourly_flow
FROM bus_flow_hour AS b
JOIN bus_line AS l ON l.bus_line_id = b.bus_line_id
WHERE b.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY b.bus_line_id, l.line_name
HAVING COUNT(b.passenger_flow) < 18
   AND COUNT(b.passenger_flow) > 0
ORDER BY average_hourly_flow DESC, b.bus_line_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_pickups), 0) AS pickup_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_dropoffs), 0) AS dropoff_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24';

SELECT
  stat_hour AS hour,
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_pickups), 0) AS pickup_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_dropoffs), 0) AS dropoff_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND (taxi_pickups IS NOT NULL OR taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY stat_hour
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT geohash, SUM(taxi_pickups) AS pickup_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND taxi_pickups IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY geohash
ORDER BY pickup_total DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT geohash, SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS dropoff_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY geohash
HAVING SUM(taxi_dropoffs) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dropoff_total DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT geohash, stat_hour AS hour, taxi_pickups, taxi_dropoffs, taxi_dropoffs - taxi_pickups AS difference
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND taxi_pickups IS NOT NULL
  AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC, geohash ASC, hour ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH morning AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS morning_dropoffs,
         COUNT(taxi_dropoffs) AS morning_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
    AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geohash
),
evening AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS evening_dropoffs,
         COUNT(taxi_dropoffs) AS evening_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
    AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT m.geohash,
       m.morning_dropoffs,
       e.evening_dropoffs,
       m.morning_hours,
       e.evening_hours
FROM morning m
JOIN evening e ON m.geohash = e.geohash
WHERE m.morning_hours > 0
  AND e.evening_hours > 0
  AND e.evening_dropoffs > m.morning_dropoffs
ORDER BY m.geohash;

WITH grid_totals AS (
  SELECT geohash, SUM(taxi_pickups) AS pickups
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  GROUP BY geohash
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT geohash, pickups
  FROM grid_totals
  WHERE pickups IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY pickups DESC, geohash ASC
  LIMIT 10
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(taxi_pickups), 0) AS all_pickups
  FROM grid_flow_hour
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pickups) FROM top10), 0) AS top10_pickups,
  (SELECT all_pickups FROM totals) AS all_pickups,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT all_pickups FROM totals) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE ROUND(
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pickups) FROM top10), 0) * 100.0 / (SELECT all_pickups FROM totals),
      2
    )
  END AS top10_pct;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    geohash,
    taxi_dropoffs AS dropoff_total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY stat_hour
      ORDER BY taxi_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC
    ) AS rank_in_hour
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  hour,
  geohash,
  dropoff_total,
  rank_in_hour
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_hour <= 3
ORDER BY hour ASC, rank_in_hour ASC;

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ridehail_orders) AS total_orders,
    SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS total_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_orders), 0) AS orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
)
SELECT
  h.hour,
  h.orders,
  h.dropoffs,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(100.0 * h.orders / NULLIF(d.total_orders, 0), 0),
    2
  ) AS order_pct,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(100.0 * h.dropoffs / NULLIF(d.total_dropoffs, 0), 0),
    2
  ) AS dropoff_pct
FROM hourly h
CROSS JOIN daily d
ORDER BY h.hour;

SELECT geohash, SUM(ridehail_orders) AS order_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND geohash IS NOT NULL
  AND ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY geohash
ORDER BY order_total DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8) THEN ridehail_orders ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (17, 18) THEN ridehail_orders ELSE 0 END), 0) AS evening_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_orders), 0) AS daily_orders
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  morning_orders,
  evening_orders,
  daily_orders,
  CASE WHEN daily_orders = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * morning_orders / daily_orders, 2) END AS morning_pct,
  CASE WHEN daily_orders = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * evening_orders / daily_orders, 2) END AS evening_pct
FROM agg;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT geohash) AS qualifying_grids
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND ridehail_orders >= 100;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT geohash, stat_hour AS hour, ridehail_orders, stat_date
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE ridehail_orders > 0
    AND ridehail_dropoffs = 0
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_grid_hours
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.geohash,
       q.hour,
       q.ridehail_orders,
       t.qualifying_grid_hours
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY q.ridehail_orders DESC, q.geohash ASC, q.hour ASC, q.stat_date ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH grid_stats AS (
    SELECT
        geohash,
        SUM(ridehail_orders) AS daily_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN ridehail_orders ELSE 0 END) AS evening_orders
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT
    geohash,
    daily_orders,
    COALESCE(evening_orders, 0) AS evening_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(evening_orders, 0) / daily_orders, 2) AS evening_pct
FROM grid_stats
WHERE daily_orders >= 100
ORDER BY (100.0 * COALESCE(evening_orders, 0) / daily_orders) DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  t1.geohash AS geohash,
  t1.stat_hour AS previous_hour,
  t2.stat_hour AS current_hour,
  t1.ridehail_orders AS previous_orders,
  t2.ridehail_orders AS current_orders,
  t2.ridehail_orders - t1.ridehail_orders AS increase
FROM grid_flow_hour AS t1
JOIN grid_flow_hour AS t2
  ON t1.geohash = t2.geohash
 AND t1.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
 AND t2.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
 AND t2.stat_hour = t1.stat_hour + 1
 AND t1.ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
 AND t2.ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC, geohash ASC, previous_hour ASC, current_hour ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  geohash,
  stat_hour AS hour,
  ridehail_orders,
  ridehail_dropoffs,
  ridehail_orders - ridehail_dropoffs AS difference
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
  AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC, geohash ASC, hour ASC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks), 0) AS lock_total FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24';

SELECT stat_hour AS hour, COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks), 0) AS lock_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY stat_hour
ORDER BY stat_hour;

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    SUM(bike_locks) AS lock_total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
)
SELECT
  hour,
  lock_total
FROM hourly
WHERE lock_total = (SELECT MAX(lock_total) FROM hourly)
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT geohash, SUM(bike_locks) AS lock_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY geohash
HAVING SUM(bike_locks) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lock_total DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH grid_locks AS (
    SELECT geohash, COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks), 0) AS locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    GROUP BY geohash
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT locks
    FROM grid_locks
    ORDER BY locks DESC, geohash ASC
    LIMIT 10
),
top_sum AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(locks), 0) AS top10_locks
    FROM top10
),
all_sum AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(locks), 0) AS all_locks
    FROM grid_locks
)
SELECT
    top_sum.top10_locks AS top10_locks,
    all_sum.all_locks AS all_locks,
    ROUND(100.0 * top_sum.top10_locks / all_sum.all_locks, 2) AS top10_pct
FROM top_sum, all_sum;

SELECT geohash, locks_7, locks_8, locks_9
FROM (
  SELECT geohash,
         MAX(CASE WHEN stat_hour = 7 THEN bike_locks END) AS locks_7,
         MAX(CASE WHEN stat_hour = 8 THEN bike_locks END) AS locks_8,
         MAX(CASE WHEN stat_hour = 9 THEN bike_locks END) AS locks_9
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY geohash
)
WHERE locks_7 IS NOT NULL
  AND locks_8 IS NOT NULL
  AND locks_9 IS NOT NULL
  AND locks_7 < locks_8
  AND locks_8 < locks_9;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN bike_locks END), 0) AS morning_locks,
    COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks), 0) AS daily_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  morning_locks,
  daily_locks,
  CASE
    WHEN daily_locks = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * morning_locks / daily_locks, 2)
  END AS morning_pct
FROM agg;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END) AS morning_locks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS morning_hours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END) AS evening_locks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evening_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT
  geohash,
  morning_locks,
  evening_locks,
  evening_locks - morning_locks AS increase,
  morning_hours,
  evening_hours
FROM agg
WHERE morning_hours > 0
  AND evening_hours > 0
  AND evening_locks > morning_locks
ORDER BY increase DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH metro_hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entries
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND entry_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
bus_hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND passenger_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
metro_cum AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, metro_entries,
         SUM(metro_entries) OVER (ORDER BY stat_hour) AS cumulative_metro_entries
  FROM metro_hourly
),
bus_cum AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, bus_flow,
         SUM(bus_flow) OVER (ORDER BY stat_hour) AS cumulative_bus_flow
  FROM bus_hourly
)
SELECT m.stat_hour AS hour,
       m.metro_entries,
       b.bus_flow,
       m.cumulative_metro_entries,
       b.cumulative_bus_flow
FROM metro_cum m
JOIN bus_cum b ON m.stat_hour = b.stat_hour
ORDER BY hour;

WITH RECURSIVE hours(hour) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT hour + 1 FROM hours WHERE hour < 23
),
bus_hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
ridehail_hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, SUM(ridehail_orders) AS total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
valid_hours AS (
  SELECT h.hour,
         b.total AS bus_total,
         r.total AS ridehail_total
  FROM hours h
  JOIN bus_hourly b ON b.stat_hour = h.hour
  JOIN ridehail_hourly r ON r.stat_hour = h.hour
  WHERE b.total IS NOT NULL AND r.total IS NOT NULL
),
windows AS (
  SELECT v1.hour AS start_hour,
         v1.hour + 2 AS end_hour,
         v1.bus_total + v2.bus_total + v3.bus_total AS bus_window_total,
         v1.ridehail_total + v2.ridehail_total + v3.ridehail_total AS ridehail_window_total
  FROM valid_hours v1
  JOIN valid_hours v2 ON v2.hour = v1.hour + 1
  JOIN valid_hours v3 ON v3.hour = v1.hour + 2
),
bus_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(bus_window_total) AS max_total FROM windows
),
ridehail_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(ridehail_window_total) AS max_total FROM windows
)
SELECT '公交客流量' AS metric, start_hour, end_hour, bus_window_total AS window_total
FROM windows
WHERE bus_window_total = (SELECT max_total FROM bus_max)
UNION ALL
SELECT '网约车下单量' AS metric, start_hour, end_hour, ridehail_window_total AS window_total
FROM windows
WHERE ridehail_window_total = (SELECT max_total FROM ridehail_max);

WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT '地铁进站量' AS metric, stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS total
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '公交客流量' AS metric, stat_hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '出租车上车量' AS metric, stat_hour, SUM(taxi_pickups) AS total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '网约车下单量' AS metric, stat_hour, SUM(ridehail_orders) AS total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '共享单车锁车量' AS metric, stat_hour, SUM(bike_locks) AS total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
peaks AS (
  SELECT m.metric, m.stat_hour
  FROM metrics m
  WHERE m.total IS NOT NULL
    AND m.total = (
      SELECT MAX(m2.total)
      FROM metrics m2
      WHERE m2.metric = m.metric
        AND m2.total IS NOT NULL
    )
)
SELECT p1.metric AS metric_a,
       p2.metric AS metric_b,
       p1.stat_hour AS common_peak_hour
FROM peaks p1
JOIN peaks p2
  ON p1.stat_hour = p2.stat_hour
 AND p1.metric < p2.metric
ORDER BY metric_a, metric_b, common_peak_hour;

WITH metro_hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entries
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND entry_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
bus_hourly AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND passenger_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
joined AS (
  SELECT m.hour,
         m.metro_entries,
         b.bus_flow
  FROM metro_hourly m

WITH line_agg AS (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) AS observed_hours,
    SUM(passenger_flow)       AS daily_total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) < 18
)

  a.bus_line_id                                        AS bus_line_id,
  b.line_name                                          AS line_name,
  a.observed_hours                                     AS observed_hours,
  a.daily_total                                        AS daily_total,
  ROUND(a.daily_total * 1.0 / a.observed_hours, 2)     AS average_hourly_flow
FROM line_agg AS a
JOIN bus_line AS b ON b.bus_line_id = a.bus_line_id
ORDER BY average_hourly_flow DESC, a.bus_line_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH obs AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    stat_hour AS current_hour,
    ridehail_orders AS current_orders,
    LAG(ridehail_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY geohash ORDER BY stat_hour) AS previous_orders,

  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  geohash,
  previous_hour,
  current_hour,
  previous_orders,
  current_orders,
  current_orders - previous_orders AS increase
FROM obs
WHERE previous_hour = current_hour - 1
  AND previous_orders IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC, geohash ASC, previous_hour ASC, current_hour ASC
LIMIT 10;

pairs AS (

    SELECT

        '共享单车锁车',

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT geohash FROM r UNION SELECT geohash FROM b))
)
SELECT
    metric_a,
    metric_b,
    intersection_count,
    union_count,

-- 早/晚高峰出租车与网约车下客量 Top20 网格的重合度
-- 口径：2026-08-24 上海本地时间；早高峰 7-9 时，晚高峰 17-19 时
-- 指标：出租出租车下车完单量 taxi_dropoffs、网约车下车完单量 ridehail_dropoffs（单位：次/单）
-- Top20 消歧：同一周期内按下客量合计降序，同值时按 geohash 升序取满 20 项
WITH period_agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN '早高峰' ELSE '晚高峰' END AS period,
        geohash,
        SUM(taxi_dropoffs)      AS taxi_dropoffs_sum,
        SUM(ridehail_dropoffs)  AS ridehail_dropoffs_sum
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY period, geohash
),
taxi_top AS (
    SELECT period, geohash
    FROM (
        SELECT period, geohash,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period
                                  ORDER BY taxi_dropoffs_sum DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
        FROM period_agg
        WHERE taxi_dropoffs_sum IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn <= 20
),
ridehail_top AS (
    SELECT period, geohash
    FROM (
        SELECT period, geohash,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period
                                  ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs_sum DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
        FROM period_agg
        WHERE ridehail_dropoffs_sum IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn <= 20
),
membership AS (
    SELECT period, geohash, 'taxi'     AS src FROM taxi_top
    UNION ALL
    SELECT period, geohash, 'ridehail' AS src FROM ridehail_top
),
per_grid AS (
    SELECT period, geohash, COUNT(DISTINCT src) AS src_cnt
    FROM membership
    GROUP BY period, geohash
)
SELECT
    period,
    SUM(src_cnt = 2)                            AS intersection_count,
    COUNT(*)                                    AS union_count,
    (1.0 * SUM(src_cnt = 2)) / COUNT(*)         AS jaccard
FROM per_grid
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY CASE period WHEN '早高峰' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

-- 出租车与网约车下车观测共存的网格，仅在共同观测小时内比较峰值小时是否重合
-- 数据对象：grid_flow_hour（2026-08-24，小时粒度，网格 = GeoHash 7）
-- 指标：taxi_dropoffs 出租车下车完单量（次）、ridehail_dropoffs 网约车下车完单量（单）
WITH common_hours AS (
    -- 共同观测小时：同一网格同一小时下，出租车与网约车下车指标均有观测（非 NULL）
    SELECT geohash, stat_hour, taxi_dropoffs, ridehail_dropoffs
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
      AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
),
max_in_common AS (
    SELECT geohash,
           MAX(taxi_dropoffs)     AS max_taxi,
           MAX(ridehail_dropoffs) AS max_ridehail
    FROM common_hours
    GROUP BY geohash
),
peak_flags AS (
    -- 标记该网格共同观测小时内，哪些小时分别是两方式的峰值小时
    SELECT c.geohash,
           CASE WHEN c.taxi_dropoffs     = m.max_taxi     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_taxi_peak,
           CASE WHEN c.ridehail_dropoffs = m.max_ridehail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ridehail_peak
    FROM common_hours c
    JOIN max_in_common m ON m.geohash = c.geohash
),
grid_relation AS (
    -- 存在同一小时同时为两方式峰值小时 => 峰值小时有重合
    SELECT geohash,
           MAX(is_taxi_peak * is_ridehail_peak) AS has_overlap
    FROM peak_flags
    GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT CASE WHEN has_overlap = 1 THEN '峰值小时有重合'
            ELSE '峰值小时无重合' END AS peak_relation,
       COUNT(*)                      AS grid_count
FROM grid_relation
GROUP BY peak_relation
ORDER BY CASE WHEN peak_relation = '峰值小时有重合' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

--   共同观测小时 = 同一 geohash 同一 stat_hour 下 ridehail_dropoffs 与 bike_locks 均非 NULL 的小时；
--   峰均比 = 共同观测小时内的最大值 / 共同观测小时内的均值；

WITH common AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    COUNT(*)                    AS common_hours,
    AVG(ridehail_dropoffs)      AS ridehail_mean,
    AVG(bike_locks)             AS bike_mean,
    MAX(ridehail_dropoffs)      AS ridehail_peak,
    MAX(bike_locks)             AS bike_peak
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geohash
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6
     AND AVG(ridehail_dropoffs) > 0
     AND AVG(bike_locks) > 0
)
SELECT
  geohash,
  common_hours,
  ROUND(ridehail_peak * 1.0 / ridehail_mean, 6)                          AS ridehail_peak_ratio,
  ROUND(bike_peak * 1.0 / bike_mean, 6)                                  AS bike_peak_ratio,
  ROUND((ridehail_peak * 1.0 / ridehail_mean)
        - (bike_peak * 1.0 / bike_mean), 6)                              AS ratio_difference
FROM common
ORDER BY ratio_difference DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- 每小时集中度 = 该小时 Top10 网格指标合计 / 该小时全市该指标合计
-- 指标：网约车下客（ridehail_dropoffs）、共享单车锁车（bike_locks）
-- Top10 同值时按 geohash 升序取满 10 项；小时平均值 = 当日 24 小时集中度的算术平均
WITH rh_ranked AS (
    SELECT stat_hour,
           ridehail_dropoffs AS v,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour
                              ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
),
rh_hour AS (
    SELECT stat_hour,
           SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN v ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(v) AS ridehail_concentration
    FROM rh_ranked
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
bk_ranked AS (
    SELECT stat_hour,
           bike_locks AS v,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour
                              ORDER BY bike_locks DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
),
bk_hour AS (
    SELECT stat_hour,
           SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN v ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(v) AS bike_concentration
    FROM bk_ranked
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
joined AS (
    SELECT rh.stat_hour AS hour,
           rh.ridehail_concentration,
           bk.bike_concentration
    FROM rh_hour rh
    JOIN bk_hour bk ON bk.stat_hour = rh.stat_hour
)
SELECT hour,
       ROUND(ridehail_concentration, 10) AS ridehail_concentration,
       ROUND(bike_concentration, 10)     AS bike_concentration,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(ridehail_concentration) FROM joined), 10) AS average_ridehail_concentration,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(bike_concentration) FROM joined), 10)     AS average_bike_concentration
FROM joined
WHERE ridehail_concentration > (SELECT AVG(ridehail_concentration) FROM joined)
  AND bike_concentration     > (SELECT AVG(bike_concentration) FROM joined)
ORDER BY hour;

-- 输出：三项合计最高的 10 个区域；合计并列时按 area5 升序取满 10 项
WITH area5_agg AS (
    SELECT
        substr(geohash, 1, 5)                       AS area5,
        COALESCE(SUM(taxi_dropoffs), 0)             AS taxi_dropoffs,
        COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs), 0)         AS ridehail_dropoffs,
        COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks), 0)                AS bike_locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour

    GROUP BY substr(geohash, 1, 5)
)
SELECT
    area5,
    taxi_dropoffs,
    ridehail_dropoffs,
    bike_locks,
    taxi_dropoffs + ridehail_dropoffs + bike_locks AS combined_total
FROM area5_agg
ORDER BY combined_total DESC, area5 ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- 均有观测的站点中，按 RANK 分别排名，取名次差最大的 10 个站（并列按 station_id 升序取满）
WITH metro_morning AS (
    -- 物理站点粒度：汇总该 station_id 全部线路的早高峰出站量
    SELECT station_id,
           SUM(exit_flow) AS morning_exit
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
      AND exit_flow IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY station_id
),
bike_morning AS (
    -- 站点 500 米内（distance_m <= 500）网格的早高峰共享单车锁车量
    SELECT d.station_id,
           SUM(g.bike_locks) AS morning_bike
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS d

-- 问题：地铁出站量与站点 500 米内共享单车锁车量共同观测不少于 6 个小时的站中，
--       两项峰值小时有重合和无重合的站分别有多少？（并列峰值只要有交集即视为有重合）
-- 数据：2026-08-24 上海多方式交通快照（地铁站小时出站量、网格小时共享单车锁车量、地铁站—网格距离）
-- 口径：物理站点按 station_id 汇总全部线路；站点 500 米内网格取 metro_grid_distance.distance_m <= 500；
--       站点小时共享单车锁车量为范围内网格 bike_locks 之和，bike_locks 为 NULL 表示无观测、不参与求和；
--       共同观测小时 = 地铁出站与共享单车锁车同时有观测的小时；峰值在该站的共同观测小时内取最大值的全部小时（保留并列）。
WITH near_grid AS (
    SELECT station_id, geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
metro_hour AS (
    SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
),
bike_hour AS (
    SELECT ng.station_id, gf.stat_hour, SUM(gf.bike_locks) AS bike_locks
    FROM near_grid ng
    JOIN grid_flow_hour gf
      ON gf.geohash = ng.geohash
     AND gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    WHERE gf.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ng.station_id, gf.stat_hour
),
common_hour AS (
    SELECT m.station_id, m.stat_hour, m.exit_flow, b.bike_locks
    FROM metro_hour m
    JOIN bike_hour b
      ON b.station_id = m.station_id
     AND b.stat_hour = m.stat_hour
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT station_id
    FROM common_hour
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6
),
peak_flag AS (
    SELECT c.station_id,
           c.stat_hour,
           CASE WHEN c.exit_flow = MAX(c.exit_flow) OVER (PARTITION BY c.station_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_exit_peak,
           CASE WHEN c.bike_locks = MAX(c.bike_locks) OVER (PARTITION BY c.station_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bike_peak
    FROM common_hour c
    JOIN qualified q ON q.station_id = c.station_id
),
station_relation AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           CASE WHEN MAX(is_exit_peak * is_bike_peak) = 1
                THEN '峰值小时有重合'
                ELSE '峰值小时无重合' END AS peak_relation
    FROM peak_flag
    GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT peak_relation,
       COUNT(*) AS station_count
FROM station_relation
GROUP BY peak_relation
ORDER BY peak_relation DESC;

-- 口径：
--   日期 2026-08-24（上海本地时间）；早高峰 = 7/8/9 时，晚高峰 = 17/18/19 时。
--   本站出站量：metro_flow_hour.exit_flow 按 station_id 汇总（换乘站多线路相加），单位为“人次”。
--   500米内网约车下客量：metro_grid_distance 中 distance_m <= 500 的网格，取
--   grid_flow_hour.ridehail_dropoffs 按 station_id、stat_hour 求和，单位为“单”；NULL 不参与求和，
--   若某小时该站 500 米内全部网格均为 NULL，则该小时记为该站无观测。
--   “六个小时都有观测”：地铁出站与 500 米网约车下客在 7/8/9/17/18/19 六个小时均有有效观测。
--   “都增加”：晚高峰合计 > 早高峰合计（出站量与网约车下客量同时严格增加）。
--   ridehail_increase = 晚高峰网约车下客量 - 早高峰网约车下客量。
--   排名：ridehail_increase 降序，同值时按 station_id 升序消歧，固定取前 10 名。
WITH metro_peak AS (
    SELECT
        m.station_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)   THEN m.exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS morning_exit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN m.exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS evening_exit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.stat_hour) AS metro_observed_hours
    FROM metro_flow_hour AS m
    WHERE m.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND m.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
      AND m.exit_flow IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.station_id
),
ridehail_station_hour AS (
    SELECT
        d.station_id,
        g.stat_hour,
        SUM(g.ridehail_dropoffs) AS dropoffs
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
    JOIN grid_flow_hour AS g
      ON g.geohash = d.geohash
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
      AND g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND g.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY d.station_id, g.stat_hour
),
ridehail_peak AS (
    SELECT
        r.station_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)    THEN r.dropoffs END) AS morning_ridehail,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN r.dropoffs END) AS evening_ridehail,
        COUNT(r.dropoffs) AS ridehail_observed_hours
    FROM ridehail_station_hour AS r
    GROUP BY r.station_id
)
SELECT
    s.station_id                                   AS station_id,
    s.station_name                                 AS station_name,
    mp.morning_exit                                AS morning_exit,
    mp.evening_exit                                AS evening_exit,
    rp.morning_ridehail                            AS morning_ridehail,
    rp.evening_ridehail                            AS evening_ridehail,
    (rp.evening_ridehail - rp.morning_ridehail)    AS ridehail_increase
FROM metro_peak        AS mp
JOIN ridehail_peak     AS rp ON rp.station_id = mp.station_id
JOIN metro_station     AS s  ON s.station_id  = mp.station_id
WHERE mp.metro_observed_hours = 6
  AND rp.ridehail_observed_hours = 6
  AND mp.evening_exit > mp.morning_exit
  AND rp.evening_ridehail > rp.morning_ridehail
ORDER BY ridehail_increase DESC, s.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

--       以及各占对应网格（全部网格）全天总量的百分比（0-100 口径）。
-- 数据：2026-08-24 上海多方式交通快照（上海本地时间，全天 0-23 时）
-- 口径：覆盖网格 = metro_grid_distance 中 distance_m <= 500 的网格按 geohash 去重形成的并集；
--       "全天量" = 当日该指标全部有效小时观测求和（NULL 不参与求和，不补零）。

WITH covered(geohash) AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
covered_sum AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(gf.taxi_dropoffs)     AS taxi_dropoffs,
        SUM(gf.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
        SUM(gf.bike_locks)        AS bike_locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour AS gf
    WHERE gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND gf.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered)
),
all_sum AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(gf.taxi_dropoffs)     AS taxi_dropoffs,
        SUM(gf.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
        SUM(gf.bike_locks)        AS bike_locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour AS gf
    WHERE gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT '出租车下客' AS metric, c.taxi_dropoffs AS covered_total, a.taxi_dropoffs AS all_grid_total
    FROM covered_sum AS c CROSS JOIN all_sum AS a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '网约车下客', c.ridehail_dropoffs, a.ridehail_dropoffs
    FROM covered_sum AS c CROSS JOIN all_sum AS a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '共享单车锁车', c.bike_locks, a.bike_locks
    FROM covered_sum AS c CROSS JOIN all_sum AS a
)
SELECT
    metric,
    covered_total,
    all_grid_total,
    ROUND(100.0 * covered_total / all_grid_total, 2) AS covered_pct
FROM metrics
ORDER BY CASE metric
             WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 1
             WHEN '网约车下客' THEN 2
             WHEN '共享单车锁车' THEN 3
