  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL OR ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
),
grid_area AS (
  SELECT
    g.geohash,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metro_grid_distance d
        WHERE d.geohash = g.geohash AND d.distance_m <= 500
      ) THEN '500米范围内'
      ELSE '500米范围外'
    END AS area_type
  FROM target_grid g
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    a.area_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END) AS taxi_morning,
    SUM(f.taxi_dropoffs)                                                 AS taxi_daily,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN f.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS rh_morning,
    SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs)                                             AS rh_daily
  FROM grid_area a
  JOIN grid_flow_hour f ON f.geohash = a.geohash
  GROUP BY a.area_type
),
unpivoted AS (
  SELECT area_type, '出租车下客' AS metric, taxi_morning AS morning_total, taxi_daily AS daily_total FROM agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT area_type, '网约车下客' AS metric, rh_morning AS morning_total, rh_daily AS daily_total FROM agg
)
SELECT
  area_type,
  metric,
  CAST(morning_total AS INTEGER)                            AS morning_total,
  CAST(daily_total AS INTEGER)                              AS daily_total,
  ROUND(morning_total * 100.0 / daily_total, 2)             AS morning_pct
FROM unpivoted
ORDER BY
  CASE area_type WHEN '500米范围内' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  CASE metric WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH eligible_grid AS (
    SELECT geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
    GROUP BY geohash
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        d.geohash,
        d.station_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.geohash
            ORDER BY d.distance_m ASC, d.station_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN eligible_grid e ON e.geohash = d.geohash
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT geohash, station_id
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
grid_evening AS (
    SELECT
        geohash,
        SUM(bike_locks)        AS evening_bike,
        SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT
    s.station_id                       AS station_id,
    s.station_name                     AS station_name,
    SUM(g.evening_bike)                AS evening_bike,
    SUM(g.evening_ridehail)            AS evening_ridehail
FROM assigned a
JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = a.station_id
LEFT JOIN grid_evening g ON g.geohash = a.geohash
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY s.station_id;

WITH line_assign AS (

      ON d.bus_line_id = lb.bus_line_id

    WHERE lb.min_distance <= 500
    GROUP BY lb.bus_line_id
),

    GROUP BY station_id

-- 目的：对每个地铁站，分别以 800 米内共享单车锁车量(bike_locks)、网约车下车完单量(ridehail_dropoffs)
--       为权重计算加权平均距离，取两项平均距离之差绝对值最大的 10 个站。
-- 数据：data:shanghai-multimodal-20260824（shanghai_text2sql_simplified_v1.db），业务日期 2026-08-24，上海本地时间。
-- 口径：空间范围取 metro_grid_distance.distance_m <= 800；权重为该网格全天(0-23 时)有效观测之和（NULL 不补零）；
--       加权平均距离 = SUM(distance_m * weight) / SUM(weight)；权重合计为 0 或缺失时该站平均距离不可定义，不参与排名。
-- 消歧：distance_difference 同值时按 station_id 升序取满 10 项，不扩展并列。

WITH grid_weight AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    SUM(bike_locks)        AS bike_weight,
    SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_weight
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY geohash
),
station_avg AS (
  SELECT
    d.station_id,
    SUM(d.distance_m * g.bike_weight)        * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(g.bike_weight), 0)        AS bike_average_distance,
    SUM(d.distance_m * g.ridehail_weight)    * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(g.ridehail_weight), 0)    AS ridehail_average_distance
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN grid_weight AS g
    ON g.geohash = d.geohash
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 800
  GROUP BY d.station_id
)
SELECT
  s.station_id                                   AS station_id,
  m.station_name                                 AS station_name,
  s.bike_average_distance                        AS bike_average_distance,
  s.ridehail_average_distance                    AS ridehail_average_distance,
  ABS(s.bike_average_distance - s.ridehail_average_distance) AS distance_difference
FROM station_avg AS s
JOIN metro_station AS m
  ON m.station_id = s.station_id
WHERE s.bike_average_distance IS NOT NULL
  AND s.ridehail_average_distance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.bike_average_distance - s.ridehail_average_distance) DESC, s.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- 目标：对每个地铁站，在其 500 米缓冲范围内，分别求共享单车锁车量(bike_locks)
--       与出租车下车完单量(taxi_dropoffs)最高的连续三小时窗口；
--       仅使用两项指标在窗口三个小时均有观测的窗口；
--       返回两项峰值窗口起点相同的站点，并列峰值全部保留。
-- 空间口径：metro_grid_distance.distance_m <= 500（米）。
-- 观测口径：站点—小时上该指标在缓冲内存在非 NULL 观测（COUNT(metric) > 0）；
--           NULL 表示无观测，不补零，仅在汇总时计入已观测网格的值。
-- 时间口径：2026-08-24，上海本地时间，stat_hour 0-23，窗口起点 0-21（不跨日回绕）。
WITH station_grid AS (
    SELECT station_id, geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
station_hour AS (
    SELECT sg.station_id,
           g.stat_hour,
           SUM(g.bike_locks)      AS bike_sum,
           SUM(g.taxi_dropoffs)   AS taxi_sum,
           COUNT(g.bike_locks)    AS bike_obs,
           COUNT(g.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_obs
    FROM station_grid sg
    JOIN grid_flow_hour g ON g.geohash = sg.geohash
    WHERE g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY sg.station_id, g.stat_hour
),
valid_hour AS (
    SELECT station_id, stat_hour, bike_sum, taxi_sum
    FROM station_hour
    WHERE bike_obs > 0 AND taxi_obs > 0
),
window_3h AS (
    SELECT h0.station_id,
           h0.stat_hour AS start_hour,
           h0.bike_sum + h1.bike_sum + h2.bike_sum AS bike_window,
           h0.taxi_sum + h1.taxi_sum + h2.taxi_sum AS taxi_window
    FROM valid_hour h0
    JOIN valid_hour h1
      ON h1.station_id = h0.station_id AND h1.stat_hour = h0.stat_hour + 1
    JOIN valid_hour h2
      ON h2.station_id = h0.station_id AND h2.stat_hour = h0.stat_hour + 2
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT w.station_id,
           w.start_hour,
           w.bike_window,
           w.taxi_window,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.station_id ORDER BY w.bike_window DESC) AS bike_rank,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.station_id ORDER BY w.taxi_window DESC) AS taxi_rank
    FROM window_3h w
)
SELECT r.station_id,
       s.station_name,
       r.start_hour,
       r.bike_window,
       r.taxi_window
FROM ranked r
JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = r.station_id
WHERE r.bike_rank = 1
  AND r.taxi_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.station_id, r.start_hour;

-- 互为最近邻且距离<=2000米的站对中，晚高峰（17/18/19时）出站量差最大的10对
-- 口径：
--   * 最近邻：在 metro_station_distance 中按 distance_m 升序、距离并列时按 nearby_station_id 升序取第1名
--   * 互为最近邻：a 的最近邻是 b 且 b 的最近邻是 a，且 distance_m <= 2000
--   * 完整三小时观测：两站在 17、18、19 三个小时均存在观测记录
--   * 出站量：按 station_id 汇总 17、18、19 三个小时的 exit_flow（人次）
--   * exit_difference = |a_exit - b_exit|
--   * Top10 边界同值时按 station_a_id、station_b_id 升序取满10对
WITH nn AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           nearby_station_id,
           distance_m,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id
                              ORDER BY distance_m ASC, nearby_station_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM metro_station_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 2000
),
mutual AS (
    SELECT a.station_id AS station_a_id,
           a.nearby_station_id AS station_b_id,
           a.distance_m
    FROM nn a
    JOIN nn b
      ON b.station_id = a.nearby_station_id
     AND b.nearby_station_id = a.station_id
    WHERE a.rn = 1
      AND b.rn = 1
      AND a.station_id < a.nearby_station_id
),
peak_exit AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY station_id
),
complete3 AS (
    SELECT station_id
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 3
)
SELECT m.station_a_id,
       sa.station_name AS station_a_name,
       m.station_b_id,
       sb.station_name AS station_b_name,
       m.distance_m,
       ea.exit_flow AS station_a_exit,
       eb.exit_flow AS station_b_exit,
       ABS(ea.exit_flow - eb.exit_flow) AS exit_difference
FROM mutual m
JOIN metro_station sa ON sa.station_id = m.station_a_id
JOIN metro_station sb ON sb.station_id = m.station_b_id
JOIN peak_exit ea ON ea.station_id = m.station_a_id
JOIN peak_exit eb ON eb.station_id = m.station_b_id
JOIN complete3 ca ON ca.station_id = m.station_a_id
JOIN complete3 cb ON cb.station_id = m.station_b_id
ORDER BY exit_difference DESC, m.station_a_id ASC, m.station_b_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH grid_metric AS (

        geohash,
        COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS ridehail_dropoffs,

grid_class AS (

    FROM grid_metric gm

    GROUP BY gm.geohash, gm.ridehail_dropoffs, gm.bike_locks
),
grouped AS (

            WHEN station_cnt = 2 THEN '2'
            ELSE '3+'

    ROUND(bike_locks * 100.0 / SUM(bike_locks) OVER (), 2)               AS bike_pct
FROM grouped

    JOIN added AS a ON a.geohash = f.geohash

),
union_sum AS (             -- 线路内网格并集去重后求和

-- 每站三个环均保留；该环无网格或无观测时指标为 NULL。
WITH nearest AS (
    SELECT
        d.station_id,
        d.geohash,
        d.distance_m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.geohash
            ORDER BY d.distance_m ASC, d.station_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        geohash,
        CASE
            WHEN distance_m <= 300 THEN '0-300'
            WHEN distance_m <= 500 THEN '300-500'
            ELSE '500-1000'
        END AS ring
    FROM nearest
    WHERE rn = 1
),
grid_obs AS (
    SELECT
        geohash,
        SUM(bike_locks)         AS bike_locks,
        SUM(ridehail_dropoffs)  AS ridehail_dropoffs
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY geohash
),
rings(ring) AS (
    VALUES ('0-300'), ('300-500'), ('500-1000')
)
SELECT
    s.station_id                AS station_id,
    s.station_name              AS station_name,
    r.ring                      AS ring,
    SUM(o.bike_locks)           AS evening_bike,
    SUM(o.ridehail_dropoffs)    AS evening_ridehail
FROM metro_station AS s
CROSS JOIN rings AS r
LEFT JOIN assigned AS a
       ON a.station_id = s.station_id
      AND a.ring = r.ring
LEFT JOIN grid_obs AS o
       ON o.geohash = a.geohash
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, r.ring

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN COALESCE(entry_flow, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_entry,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(entry_flow, 0)), 0) AS daily_entry
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  morning_entry,
  daily_entry,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN daily_entry = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE 100.0 * morning_entry / daily_entry END, 2) AS morning_pct
FROM base;

SELECT
  ms.station_id AS station_id,
  ms.station_name AS station_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0) AS entry_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) AS exit_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0) AS difference,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mfh.stat_date || '-' || mfh.stat_hour) AS compared_hours
FROM metro_flow_hour AS mfh
JOIN metro_station AS ms
  ON mfh.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE mfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8)
  AND mfh.entry_flow IS NOT NULL
  AND mfh.exit_flow IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ms.station_id,
  ms.station_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0)
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0) DESC,
  ms.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  s.station_id AS station_id,
  s.station_name AS station_name,
  f.stat_hour AS hour,
  SUM(COALESCE(f.entry_flow, 0)) AS entry_total,
  SUM(COALESCE(f.exit_flow, 0)) AS exit_total
FROM metro_flow_hour AS f
JOIN metro_station AS s
  ON f.station_id = s.station_id
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND f.stat_hour IS NOT NULL
  AND s.station_name = '徐家汇'
GROUP BY
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  f.stat_hour
ORDER BY
  s.station_id,
  f.stat_hour;

WITH station_hour AS (
  SELECT
    f.station_id,
    f.stat_hour,
    SUM(f.entry_flow) AS entry_total
  FROM metro_flow_hour AS f
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY f.station_id, f.stat_hour
  HAVING SUM(f.entry_flow) IS NOT NULL
),
station_max AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    MAX(entry_total) AS max_entry
  FROM station_hour
  GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  sh.stat_hour AS peak_hour,
  sh.entry_total AS peak_entry
FROM station_hour AS sh
JOIN station_max AS sm
  ON sh.station_id = sm.station_id
JOIN metro_station AS s
  ON s.station_id = sh.station_id
WHERE sh.entry_total = sm.max_entry
ORDER BY s.station_id, sh.stat_hour;

SELECT
  ml.line_id,
  ml.line_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0) AS entry_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) AS exit_total
FROM metro_line AS ml
LEFT JOIN metro_flow_hour AS mfh
  ON mfh.line_id = ml.line_id
  AND mfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY
  ml.line_id,
  ml.line_name
ORDER BY
  ml.line_id;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS bus_total FROM bus_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24';

SELECT
  stat_hour AS hour,
  COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS bus_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN passenger_flow IS NOT NULL AND bus_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN bus_line_id END) AS observed_lines
FROM bus_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY stat_hour
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT
  t.bus_line_id AS bus_line_id,
  l.line_name AS line_name,
  t.bus_total AS bus_total
FROM (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS bus_total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND bus_line_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
) AS t
JOIN (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    MIN(line_name) AS line_name
  FROM bus_line
  WHERE line_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
) AS l
  ON t.bus_line_id = l.bus_line_id
ORDER BY
  t.bus_total DESC,
  t.bus_line_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH today_flow AS (
  SELECT
    f.bus_line_id,
    f.stat_hour,
    f.passenger_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour AS f
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND f.passenger_flow IS NOT NULL
),
line_peak AS (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    MAX(passenger_flow) AS peak_flow
  FROM today_flow
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
)
SELECT
  tf.bus_line_id,
  bl.line_name,
  tf.stat_hour AS peak_hour,
  tf.passenger_flow AS peak_flow
FROM today_flow AS tf
JOIN line_peak AS lp
  ON tf.bus_line_id = lp.bus_line_id
 AND tf.passenger_flow = lp.peak_flow
JOIN bus_line AS bl
  ON bl.bus_line_id = tf.bus_line_id
ORDER BY
  tf.bus_line_id,
  tf.stat_hour;

SELECT
  b.bus_line_id,
  b.line_name,
  SUM(COALESCE(f.passenger_flow, 0)) AS night_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.passenger_flow > 0 THEN f.stat_hour END) AS positive_hours
FROM bus_flow_hour AS f
JOIN bus_line AS b
  ON f.bus_line_id = b.bus_line_id
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND f.stat_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5
GROUP BY b.bus_line_id, b.line_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.passenger_flow > 0 THEN f.stat_hour END) > 0;

SELECT
  b.bus_line_id,
  b.line_name,
  f.stat_hour AS hour,
  f.passenger_flow
FROM bus_line AS b
JOIN bus_flow_hour AS f
  ON b.bus_line_id = f.bus_line_id
WHERE b.line_name = '隧道夜宵线'
  AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
ORDER BY b.bus_line_id, f.stat_hour;

SELECT
  f.bus_line_id,
  l.line_name,
  f.observed_hours,
  f.daily_total,
  ROUND(f.daily_total * 1.0 / f.observed_hours, 2) AS average_hourly_flow
FROM (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    COUNT(passenger_flow) AS observed_hours,
    SUM(passenger_flow) AS daily_total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND passenger_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
  HAVING COUNT(passenger_flow) > 0
    AND COUNT(passenger_flow) < 18
) AS f
JOIN bus_line AS l
  ON l.bus_line_id = f.bus_line_id
WHERE l.line_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  ROUND(f.daily_total * 1.0 / f.observed_hours, 2) DESC,
  f.bus_line_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(gfh.taxi_pickups), 0) AS pickup_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs), 0) AS dropoff_total
FROM grid_flow_hour AS gfh
JOIN grid AS g
  ON gfh.geohash = g.geohash
WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24';

SELECT
  stat_hour AS hour,
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_pickups), 0) AS pickup_total,
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_dropoffs), 0) AS dropoff_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY stat_hour
ORDER BY stat_hour;

SELECT
  geohash,
  COALESCE(SUM(taxi_pickups), 0) AS pickup_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND geohash IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY geohash
ORDER BY pickup_total DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  g.geohash AS geohash,
  SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs) AS dropoff_total
FROM grid_flow_hour AS gfh
JOIN grid AS g
  ON gfh.geohash = g.geohash
WHERE
  gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND gfh.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  g.geohash
ORDER BY
  dropoff_total DESC,
  g.geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  geohash,
  stat_hour AS hour,
  taxi_pickups,
  taxi_dropoffs,
  taxi_dropoffs - taxi_pickups AS difference
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE geohash IS NOT NULL
  AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
  AND taxi_pickups IS NOT NULL
  AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  taxi_dropoffs - taxi_pickups DESC,
  geohash ASC,
  stat_hour ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  geohash,
  morning_dropoffs,
  evening_dropoffs,
  morning_hours,
  evening_hours
FROM (
  SELECT
    f.geohash AS geohash,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END), 0) AS morning_dropoffs,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN f.taxi_dropoffs END), 0) AS evening_dropoffs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND f.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS morning_hours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 AND f.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evening_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour AS f
  JOIN grid AS g
    ON f.geohash = g.geohash
  WHERE
    f.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
    OR f.stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
  GROUP BY f.geohash
) AS t
WHERE
  morning_hours > 0
  AND evening_hours > 0
  AND evening_dropoffs > morning_dropoffs
ORDER BY geohash;

WITH grid_pickups AS (
  SELECT
    g.geohash,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.taxi_pickups), 0) AS pickups
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT geohash
    FROM grid
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f
    ON g.geohash = f.geohash
  GROUP BY g.geohash
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    pickups
  FROM grid_pickups
  ORDER BY pickups DESC, geohash ASC
  LIMIT 10
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(pickups), 0) AS INTEGER) AS all_pickups
  FROM grid_pickups
),
top10_totals AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(pickups), 0) AS INTEGER) AS top10_pickups
  FROM top10
)
SELECT
  t.top10_pickups AS top10_pickups,
  a.all_pickups AS all_pickups,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN a.all_pickups = 0 THEN 0.0
      ELSE 100.0 * t.top10_pickups / a.all_pickups
    END,
    2
  ) AS top10_pct
FROM top10_totals AS t
CROSS JOIN totals AS a;

WITH hourly_grid AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour,
    geohash,
    SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS dropoff_total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_hour IS NOT NULL
    AND geohash IS NOT NULL
    AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour, geohash
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    geohash,
    dropoff_total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY stat_hour
      ORDER BY dropoff_total DESC, geohash ASC
    ) AS rank_in_hour
  FROM hourly_grid
  WHERE dropoff_total IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  hour,
  geohash,
  dropoff_total,
  rank_in_hour
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_hour <= 3
ORDER BY hour, rank_in_hour;

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_orders), 0) AS orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(orders), 0) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(dropoffs), 0) AS total_dropoffs
  FROM hourly
)
SELECT
  h.hour AS hour,
  h.orders AS orders,
  h.dropoffs AS dropoffs,
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * h.orders / NULLIF(t.total_orders, 0), 2), 0.0) AS order_pct,
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * h.dropoffs / NULLIF(t.total_dropoffs, 0), 2), 0.0) AS dropoff_pct
FROM hourly AS h
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY h.hour;

SELECT
  gfh.geohash AS geohash,
  SUM(COALESCE(gfh.ridehail_orders, 0)) AS order_total
FROM grid_flow_hour AS gfh
JOIN grid AS g
  ON g.geohash = gfh.geohash
WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY gfh.geohash
ORDER BY order_total DESC, gfh.geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour >= 7 AND stat_hour < 9 THEN ridehail_orders ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour >= 17 AND stat_hour < 19 THEN ridehail_orders ELSE 0 END), 0) AS evening_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_orders), 0) AS daily_orders
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  morning_orders,
  evening_orders,
  daily_orders,
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * morning_orders / NULLIF(daily_orders, 0), 2), 0.0) AS morning_pct,
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * evening_orders / NULLIF(daily_orders, 0), 2), 0.0) AS evening_pct
FROM agg;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.geohash) AS qualifying_grids
FROM grid_flow_hour AS f
JOIN grid AS g ON f.geohash = g.geohash
WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND f.ridehail_orders >= 100;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    stat_hour AS hour,
    ridehail_orders
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE geohash IS NOT NULL
    AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
    AND ridehail_orders > 0
    AND ridehail_dropoffs = 0
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_grid_hours FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
  q.geohash,
  q.hour,
  q.ridehail_orders,
  t.qualifying_grid_hours
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY
  q.ridehail_orders DESC,
  q.geohash ASC,
  q.hour ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  t.geohash AS geohash,
  t.daily_orders AS daily_orders,
  t.evening_orders AS evening_orders,
  ROUND(100.0 * t.evening_orders / t.daily_orders, 2) AS evening_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    gf.geohash,
    SUM(COALESCE(gf.ridehail_orders, 0)) AS daily_orders,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN gf.stat_hour IN (17, 18) THEN COALESCE(gf.ridehail_orders, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS evening_orders
  FROM grid_flow_hour AS gf
  WHERE gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND gf.geohash IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY gf.geohash
) AS t
WHERE t.daily_orders >= 100
ORDER BY 100.0 * t.evening_orders / t.daily_orders DESC, t.geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH observed AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    stat_date,
    stat_hour,
    ridehail_orders
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE
    geohash IS NOT NULL
    AND stat_date IS NOT NULL
    AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
    AND ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
),
increases AS (
  SELECT
    c.geohash AS geohash,
    p.stat_hour AS previous_hour,
    c.stat_hour AS current_hour,
    p.ridehail_orders AS previous_orders,
    c.ridehail_orders AS current_orders,
    c.ridehail_orders - p.ridehail_orders AS increase
  FROM observed AS c
  JOIN observed AS p
    ON c.geohash = p.geohash
   AND (
        (
          c.stat_date = p.stat_date
          AND c.stat_hour = p.stat_hour + 1
        )
        OR
        (
          c.stat_hour = 0
          AND p.stat_hour = 23
          AND p.stat_date = date(c.stat_date, '-1 day')
        )
        OR
        (
          c.stat_hour = 1
          AND p.stat_hour = 24
          AND p.stat_date = date(c.stat_date, '-1 day')
        )
      )
)
SELECT
  geohash,
  previous_hour,
  current_hour,
  previous_orders,
  current_orders,
  increase
FROM increases
ORDER BY
  increase DESC,
  geohash ASC,
  previous_hour ASC,
  current_hour ASC,
  previous_orders ASC,
  current_orders ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  geohash,
  stat_hour AS hour,
  ridehail_orders,
  ridehail_dropoffs,
  ridehail_orders - ridehail_dropoffs AS difference
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL
  AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  difference DESC,
  geohash ASC,
  hour ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gfh.bike_locks), 0) AS lock_total
FROM grid_flow_hour AS gfh
JOIN grid AS g
  ON gfh.geohash = g.geohash
WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24';

WITH RECURSIVE hours(hour) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT hour + 1
  FROM hours
  WHERE hour < 23
)
SELECT
  hours.hour AS hour,
  COALESCE(SUM(g.bike_locks), 0) AS lock_total
FROM hours
LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS g
  ON g.stat_hour = hours.hour
 AND g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY hours.hour
ORDER BY hours.hour;

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    SUM(bike_locks) AS lock_total
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  HAVING COUNT(bike_locks) > 0
)
SELECT
  hour,
  lock_total
FROM hourly
WHERE lock_total = (
  SELECT MAX(lock_total)
  FROM hourly
)
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT
  g.geohash AS geohash,
  SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS lock_total
FROM grid_flow_hour AS gfh
JOIN grid AS g
  ON gfh.geohash = g.geohash
WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
GROUP BY g.geohash
HAVING SUM(gfh.bike_locks) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lock_total DESC, g.geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH grid_totals AS (
    SELECT
        g.geohash,
        COALESCE(SUM(f.bike_locks), 0) AS locks
    FROM grid AS g
    JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f
        ON g.geohash = f.geohash
    GROUP BY g.geohash
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        geohash,
        locks,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY locks DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
    FROM grid_totals
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(locks), 0) AS top10_locks
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
all_locks AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(locks), 0) AS all_locks
    FROM grid_totals
)
SELECT
    t.top10_locks,
    a.all_locks,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN a.all_locks = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE 100.0 * t.top10_locks / a.all_locks
        END,
        2
    ) AS top10_pct
FROM top10 AS t
CROSS JOIN all_locks AS a;

SELECT
  g.geohash AS geohash,
  f7.bike_locks AS locks_7,
  f8.bike_locks AS locks_8,
  f9.bike_locks AS locks_9
FROM grid AS g
JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f7
  ON f7.geohash = g.geohash
 AND f7.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
 AND f7.stat_hour = 7
JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f8
  ON f8.geohash = g.geohash
 AND f8.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
 AND f8.stat_hour = 8
JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f9
  ON f9.geohash = g.geohash
 AND f9.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
 AND f9.stat_hour = 9
WHERE f7.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  AND f8.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  AND f9.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  AND f7.bike_locks < f8.bike_locks
  AND f8.bike_locks < f9.bike_locks;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN bike_locks END), 0) AS morning_locks,
    COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks), 0) AS daily_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  morning_locks,
  daily_locks,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN daily_locks = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE morning_locks * 100.0 / daily_locks END, 2) AS morning_pct
FROM t;

WITH peak AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_locks,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END), 0) AS evening_locks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS morning_hours,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evening_hours
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE geohash IS NOT NULL
    AND (stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 OR stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19)
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT
  geohash,
  morning_locks,
  evening_locks,
  evening_locks - morning_locks AS increase,
  morning_hours,
  evening_hours
FROM peak
WHERE morning_hours > 0
  AND evening_hours > 0
  AND evening_locks > morning_locks
ORDER BY increase DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH metro AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entries
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  HAVING COUNT(entry_flow) > 0
),
bus AS (
  SELECT
    stat_hour AS hour,
    SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stat_hour
  HAVING COUNT(passenger_flow) > 0
)
SELECT
  m.hour AS hour,
  m.metro_entries AS metro_entries,
  b.bus_flow AS bus_flow,
  SUM(m.metro_entries) OVER (
    ORDER BY m.hour
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_metro_entries,
  SUM(b.bus_flow) OVER (
    ORDER BY m.hour
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_bus_flow
FROM metro AS m
JOIN bus AS b
  ON m.hour = b.hour
ORDER BY m.hour;

WITH bus_hour AS (
  SELECT
    stat_date,
    stat_hour,
    SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_total,
    MAX(CASE WHEN passenger_flow IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_bus_obs
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  GROUP BY stat_date, stat_hour
),
ride_hour AS (
  SELECT
    stat_date,
    stat_hour,
    SUM(ridehail_orders) AS ride_total,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ride_obs
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  GROUP BY stat_date, stat_hour
),
hour_obs AS (
  SELECT
    b.stat_date,
    b.stat_hour,
    b.bus_total,
    r.ride_total
  FROM bus_hour AS b
  JOIN ride_hour AS r
    ON b.stat_date = r.stat_date
   AND b.stat_hour = r.stat_hour
  WHERE b.has_bus_obs = 1
    AND r.has_ride_obs = 1

    SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN h.exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS evening_exit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN h.ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS morning_ridehail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN h.ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS evening_ridehail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN h.ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN h.ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS ridehail_increase
FROM hour_obs h
JOIN valid_station v
  ON v.station_id = h.station_id
JOIN metro_station s
  ON s.station_id = h.station_id
GROUP BY
    h.station_id,
    s.station_name
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN h.exit_flow ELSE 0 END)
      > SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN h.exit_flow ELSE 0 END)
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN h.ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END)
      > SUM(CASE WHEN h.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN h.ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY
    ridehail_increase DESC,
    h.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH metro500_grids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mgd.geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS mgd
    JOIN grid AS g ON mgd.geohash = g.geohash
    WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 500.0
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN mg.geohash IS NOT NULL
                        THEN COALESCE(gf.taxi_dropoffs, 0)
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS covered_taxi,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN mg.geohash IS NOT NULL
                        THEN COALESCE(gf.ridehail_dropoffs, 0)
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS covered_ridehail,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN mg.geohash IS NOT NULL
                        THEN COALESCE(gf.bike_locks, 0)
                END
            ),
            0
        ) AS covered_bike,
        COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(gf.taxi_dropoffs, 0)), 0) AS all_taxi,
        COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(gf.ridehail_dropoffs, 0)), 0) AS all_ridehail,
        COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(gf.bike_locks, 0)), 0) AS all_bike
    FROM grid_flow_hour AS gf
    JOIN grid AS g ON gf.geohash = g.geohash
    LEFT JOIN metro500_grids AS mg ON gf.geohash = mg.geohash
    WHERE gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT metric, covered_total, all_grid_total, covered_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        '出租车下客' AS metric,
        covered_taxi AS covered_total,
        all_taxi AS all_grid_total,
        CASE
            WHEN all_taxi = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE ROUND(CAST(covered_taxi AS REAL) * 100.0 / all_taxi, 2)
        END AS covered_pct
    FROM totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '网约车下客',
        covered_ridehail,
        all_ridehail,
        CASE
            WHEN all_ridehail = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE ROUND(CAST(covered_ridehail AS REAL) * 100.0 / all_ridehail, 2)
        END
    FROM totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        '共享单车锁车',
        covered_bike,
        all_bike,
        CASE
            WHEN all_bike = 0 THEN 0.0
            ELSE ROUND(CAST(covered_bike AS REAL) * 100.0 / all_bike, 2)
        END
    FROM totals
)
ORDER BY
    CASE metric
        WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 1
        WHEN '网约车下客' THEN 2
        WHEN '共享单车锁车' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

WITH grid_agg AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour >= 7 AND stat_hour < 9 THEN taxi_dropoffs END), 0) AS taxi_morning,
    COALESCE(SUM(taxi_dropoffs), 0) AS taxi_daily,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour >= 7 AND stat_hour < 9 THEN ridehail_dropoffs END), 0) AS ride_morning,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS ride_daily
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND (taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL OR ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY geohash
),
near500 AS (
  SELECT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
  GROUP BY geohash
),
area_agg AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN n.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN '500米范围内'
      ELSE '500米范围外'
    END AS area_type,
    COALESCE(SUM(g.taxi_morning), 0) AS taxi_morning,
    COALESCE(SUM(g.taxi_daily), 0) AS taxi_daily,
    COALESCE(SUM(g.ride_morning), 0) AS ride_morning,
    COALESCE(SUM(g.ride_daily), 0) AS ride_daily
  FROM grid_agg AS g
  LEFT JOIN near500 AS n
    ON g.geohash = n.geohash
  GROUP BY 1
),
areas AS (
  SELECT '500米范围内' AS area_type
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '500米范围外' AS area_type
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT '出租车下客' AS metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '网约车下客' AS metric
)
SELECT
  a.area_type,
  m.metric,
  CASE m.metric
    WHEN '出租车下客' THEN COALESCE(aa.taxi_morning, 0)
    ELSE COALESCE(aa.ride_morning, 0)
  END AS morning_total,
  CASE m.metric
    WHEN '出租车下客' THEN COALESCE(aa.taxi_daily, 0)
    ELSE COALESCE(aa.ride_daily, 0)
  END AS daily_total,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(
      CASE m.metric
        WHEN '出租车下客' THEN aa.taxi_daily
        ELSE aa.ride_daily
      END,
      0
    ) = 0 THEN 0.00
    ELSE ROUND(
      COALESCE(
        CASE m.metric
          WHEN '出租车下客' THEN aa.taxi_morning
          ELSE aa.ride_morning
        END,
        0
      ) * 100.0 /
      COALESCE(
        CASE m.metric
          WHEN '出租车下客' THEN aa.taxi_daily
          ELSE aa.ride_daily
        END,
        0
      ),
      2
    )
  END AS morning_pct
FROM areas AS a
CROSS JOIN metrics AS m
LEFT JOIN area_agg AS aa
  ON aa.area_type = a.area_type
ORDER BY
  CASE a.area_type WHEN '500米范围内' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  CASE m.metric WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END;

WITH eligible_grids AS (
    SELECT d.geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
    JOIN grid AS g ON g.geohash = d.geohash
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
    GROUP BY d.geohash
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.station_id) >= 2
),
assigned_grids AS (
    SELECT
        d.geohash,
        d.station_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.geohash
            ORDER BY d.distance_m ASC, d.station_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
    JOIN eligible_grids AS e ON e.geohash = d.geohash
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
)
SELECT
    s.station_id AS station_id,
    s.station_name AS station_name,
    SUM(f.bike_locks) AS evening_bike,
    SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
FROM assigned_grids AS a
JOIN metro_station AS s ON s.station_id = a.station_id
LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS f
    ON f.geohash = a.geohash
   AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND f.stat_hour IN (17, 18)
WHERE a.rn = 1
GROUP BY
    s.station_id,
    s.station_name
ORDER BY
    s.station_id;

WITH x AS (
  SELECT d.geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN metro_station AS s ON d.station_id = s.station_id
  WHERE s.station_name = '徐家汇' AND d.distance_m <= 800
),
y AS (
  SELECT d.geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance AS d
  JOIN metro_station AS s ON d.station_id = s.station_id
  WHERE s.station_name = '上海体育馆' AND d.distance_m <= 800
),
gc AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN y.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN '两站都覆盖' ELSE '只靠近徐家汇' END AS area_type, x.geohash
  FROM x
  LEFT JOIN y ON x.geohash = y.geohash
  UNION
  SELECT CASE WHEN x.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN '两站都覆盖' ELSE '只靠近上海体育馆' END AS area_type, y.geohash
  FROM y
  LEFT JOIN x ON y.geohash = x.geohash
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    gc.area_type,
    SUM(COALESCE(gfh.taxi_dropoffs, 0)) AS evening_taxi,
    SUM(COALESCE(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs, 0)) AS evening_ridehail,
    SUM(COALESCE(gfh.bike_locks, 0)) AS evening_bike
  FROM gc
  LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS gfh
    ON gc.geohash = gfh.geohash
   AND gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND gfh.stat_hour IN (17, 18)
  GROUP BY gc.area_type
)
SELECT
  c.area_type,
  COALESCE(a.evening_taxi, 0) AS evening_taxi,
  COALESCE(a.evening_ridehail, 0) AS evening_ridehail,
  COALESCE(a.evening_bike, 0) AS evening_bike
FROM (
  SELECT '只靠近徐家汇' AS area_type
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '只靠近上海体育馆'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '两站都覆盖'
) AS c
LEFT JOIN agg AS a ON c.area_type = a.area_type
ORDER BY CASE c.area_type WHEN '只靠近徐家汇' THEN 1 WHEN '只靠近上海体育馆' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

WITH nearby_bus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT station_id, bus_line_id
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
    AND bus_line_id IS NOT NULL
),
bus_morning AS (
  SELECT
    bl.bus_line_id,
    SUM(bfh.passenger_flow) AS morning_bus_flow,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bfh.passenger_flow IS NOT NULL THEN bfh.stat_hour END) AS bus_observed_hours
  FROM bus_line bl
  LEFT JOIN bus_flow_hour bfh
    ON bfh.bus_line_id = bl.bus_line_id
   AND bfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND bfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8)
  GROUP BY bl.bus_line_id
),
station_morning AS (
  SELECT
    ms.station_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(mfh.entry_flow), 0) AS morning_entry,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mfh.entry_flow IS NOT NULL THEN mfh.stat_hour END) AS metro_observed_hours
  FROM metro_station ms
  LEFT JOIN metro_flow_hour mfh
    ON mfh.station_id = ms.station_id
   AND mfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND mfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8)
  GROUP BY ms.station_id
)
SELECT
  ms.station_id,
  ms.station_name,
  nb.bus_line_id,
  bl.line_name,
  bm.morning_bus_flow,
  CASE
    WHEN nb.bus_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(bm.bus_observed_hours, 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS bus_observed_hours,
  sm.morning_entry,
  sm.metro_observed_hours
FROM metro_station ms
LEFT JOIN nearby_bus nb
  ON nb.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN bus_line bl
  ON bl.bus_line_id = nb.bus_line_id
LEFT JOIN bus_morning bm
  ON bm.bus_line_id = nb.bus_line_id
LEFT JOIN station_morning sm
  ON sm.station_id = ms.station_id
ORDER BY
  ms.station_id,
  nb.bus_line_id;

WITH nearby AS (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS station_count
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 3
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    bus_line_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(passenger_flow), 0) AS daily_bus_total
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
)
SELECT
  n.bus_line_id,
  b.line_name,
  n.station_count,
  COALESCE(d.daily_bus_total, 0) AS daily_bus_total
FROM nearby AS n
JOIN bus_line AS b
  ON b.bus_line_id = n.bus_line_id
LEFT JOIN daily AS d
  ON d.bus_line_id = n.bus_line_id
ORDER BY n.bus_line_id;

WITH assigned AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.bus_line_id, d.station_id
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance AS d
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM metro_bus_line_distance AS d2
          WHERE d2.bus_line_id = d.bus_line_id
            AND d2.distance_m <= 500
            AND (
                d2.distance_m < d.distance_m
                OR (d2.distance_m = d.distance_m AND d2.station_id < d.station_id)
            )
      )
)
SELECT
    s.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.bus_line_id)
        FROM assigned AS a

    (
        SELECT SUM(f.passenger_flow)
        FROM assigned AS a
        JOIN bus_flow_hour AS f

        WHERE a.station_id = s.station_id
          AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    ) AS assigned_bus_total,
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT SUM(m.entry_flow)
            FROM metro_flow_hour AS m
            WHERE m.station_id = s.station_id

        ),

    ) AS metro_entry_total
FROM metro_station AS s
ORDER BY s.station_id;

WITH station_peak AS (
  SELECT
    ms.station_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(mfh.exit_flow), 0) AS peak_exit
  FROM metro_station AS ms
  LEFT JOIN metro_flow_hour AS mfh
    ON mfh.station_id = ms.station_id
   AND mfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
   AND mfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY ms.station_id
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT station_id

  ORDER BY peak_exit DESC, station_id ASC

),
selected_grids AS (

),
all_grids AS (

),
totals AS (

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sg.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN gf.taxi_dropoffs END), 0) AS selected_taxi,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ag.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN gf.taxi_dropoffs END), 0) AS all_taxi,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sg.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN gf.ridehail_dropoffs END), 0) AS selected_ridehail,

  FROM grid_flow_hour AS gf

),
result AS (

  FROM totals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    '网约车下客',
    CAST(selected_ridehail AS INTEGER),

    CASE WHEN all_ridehail = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * selected_ridehail / all_ridehail, 2) END

  SELECT

    CAST(selected_bike AS INTEGER),

)
SELECT metric, selected_total, all_station_total, selected_pct
FROM result
ORDER BY CASE metric WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 1 WHEN '网约车下客' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

WITH line_station AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mf.line_id, mf.station_id
    FROM metro_flow_hour AS mf
    WHERE mf.line_id IS NOT NULL
      AND mf.station_id IS NOT NULL
),
line_grid AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ls.line_id, mgd.geohash
    FROM line_station AS ls
    JOIN metro_grid_distance AS mgd
      ON mgd.station_id = ls.station_id
    WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 500
      AND mgd.geohash IS NOT NULL
),
line_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        lg.line_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS evening_ridehail,
        COALESCE(SUM(gfh.bike_locks), 0) AS evening_bike
    FROM line_grid AS lg
    LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS gfh
      ON gfh.geohash = lg.geohash
     AND gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
     AND gfh.stat_hour >= 17
     AND gfh.stat_hour < 19
    GROUP BY lg.line_id
)
SELECT
    ml.line_id,
    ml.line_name,
    COALESCE(lm.evening_ridehail, 0) AS evening_ridehail,
    COALESCE(lm.evening_bike, 0) AS evening_bike,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.evening_ridehail, 0) DESC) AS ridehail_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.evening_bike, 0) DESC) AS bike_rank
FROM metro_line AS ml
LEFT JOIN line_metrics AS lm
  ON lm.line_id = ml.line_id
ORDER BY ml.line_id;

WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ms.station_id,
    ms.station_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 800.0 THEN gfh.bike_locks END), 0) > 0
      THEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 800.0 THEN mgd.distance_m * gfh.bike_locks END), 0) * 1.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 800.0 THEN gfh.bike_locks END)
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS bike_average_distance,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 800.0 THEN gfh.ridehail_dropoffs END), 0) > 0
      THEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 800.0 THEN mgd.distance_m * gfh.ridehail_dropoffs END), 0) * 1.0
           / SUM(CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 800.0 THEN gfh.ridehail_dropoffs END)
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS ridehail_average_distance
  FROM metro_station AS ms
  LEFT JOIN metro_grid_distance AS mgd
    ON ms.station_id = mgd.station_id
  LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour AS gfh
    ON mgd.geohash = gfh.geohash
  GROUP BY
    ms.station_id,
    ms.station_name
)
SELECT
  station_id,
  station_name,
  ROUND(bike_average_distance, 6) AS bike_average_distance,
  ROUND(ridehail_average_distance, 6) AS ridehail_average_distance,
  ROUND(ABS(bike_average_distance - ridehail_average_distance), 6) AS distance_difference
FROM metrics
ORDER BY
  ABS(bike_average_distance - ridehail_average_distance) DESC,
  station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH station_grid AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ms.station_id,
        d.geohash
    FROM metro_station AS ms
    JOIN metro_grid_distance AS d
        ON d.station_id = ms.station_id
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
),
hourly AS (
    SELECT
        sg.station_id,
        gf.stat_date,
        gf.stat_hour,
        SUM(gf.bike_locks) AS bike_sum,
        SUM(gf.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_sum,
        COUNT(gf.bike_locks) AS bike_obs,
        COUNT(gf.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_obs
    FROM station_grid AS sg
    JOIN grid_flow_hour AS gf
        ON gf.geohash = sg.geohash
    WHERE gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY
        sg.station_id,
        gf.stat_date,
        gf.stat_hour
),
valid_hours AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        stat_date,
        stat_hour,
        bike_sum,
        taxi_sum
    FROM hourly
    WHERE bike_obs > 0
      AND taxi_obs > 0
),
windows AS (
    SELECT
        h1.station_id,
        h1.stat_date,
        h1.stat_hour AS start_hour,
        h1.bike_sum + h2.bike_sum + h3.bike_sum AS bike_window,
        h1.taxi_sum + h2.taxi_sum + h3.taxi_sum AS taxi_window
    FROM valid_hours AS h1
    JOIN valid_hours AS h2
        ON h2.station_id = h1.station_id
       AND h2.stat_date = h1.stat_date
       AND h2.stat_hour = h1.stat_hour + 1
    JOIN valid_hours AS h3
        ON h3.station_id = h1.station_id
       AND h3.stat_date = h1.stat_date
       AND h3.stat_hour = h1.stat_hour + 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    w.station_id,
    ms.station_name,
    w.start_hour,
    w.bike_window,
    w.taxi_window
FROM windows AS w
JOIN metro_station AS ms
    ON ms.station_id = w.station_id
WHERE w.bike_window = (
        SELECT MAX(w2.bike_window)
        FROM windows AS w2
        WHERE w2.station_id = w.station_id
          AND w2.stat_date = w.stat_date
    )
  AND w.taxi_window = (
        SELECT MAX(w2.taxi_window)
        FROM windows AS w2
        WHERE w2.station_id = w.station_id
          AND w2.stat_date = w.stat_date
    )
ORDER BY
    w.station_id,
    w.start_hour;

WITH morning_hourly AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    stat_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS row_cnt,
    COUNT(entry_flow) AS non_null_entry_cnt
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
),
station_entry AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(entry_flow), 0) AS station_morning_entry
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY station_id
),
station_complete AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                         WHEN row_cnt > 0 AND non_null_entry_cnt = row_cnt
                         THEN stat_hour
                       END) = 3
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_complete
  FROM morning_hourly
  GROUP BY station_id
),
neighbor_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    nearby_station_id,
    MIN(distance_m) AS distance_m
  FROM metro_station_distance
  WHERE nearby_station_id <> station_id
    AND distance_m <= 2000
  GROUP BY station_id, nearby_station_id

WITH metro_hour AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entries
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND entry_flow IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY stat_hour

    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
    FROM bus_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND passenger_flow IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY stat_hour

joined AS (
    SELECT m.stat_hour AS hour,
           m.metro_entries,
           b.bus_flow,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.metro_entries DESC) AS metro_rank,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.bus_flow DESC)     AS bus_rank
    FROM metro_hour m
    JOIN bus_hour b ON m.stat_hour = b.stat_hour
),
diff AS (

    FROM joined

       bus_rank,
       rank_difference
FROM diff
WHERE rank_difference = (SELECT MAX(rank_difference) FROM diff)
ORDER BY hour;

        SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_total,
        SUM(bike_locks)        AS bike_total,

    FROM grid_flow_hour

),
common AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM daily
    WHERE taxi_obs > 0 AND ridehail_obs > 0 AND bike_obs > 0
),

        geohash,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY taxi_total     DESC, geohash ASC) AS taxi_rank,

    FROM common
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT

        ridehail_rank,

    FROM ranked

-- 保留至少进入其中两类 Top10 的网格，并统计每小时符合条件的网格数。
WITH base AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, taxi_dropoffs, ridehail_dropoffs, bike_locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, '出租车下客' AS metric
    FROM (
        SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY taxi_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
        FROM base
        WHERE taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn <= 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, '网约车下客' AS metric
    FROM (
        SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
        FROM base
        WHERE ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn <= 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, '共享单车锁车' AS metric
    FROM (
        SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY bike_locks DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
        FROM base
        WHERE bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
agg AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
           COUNT(DISTINCT metric) AS hotspot_types,
           MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '出租车下客' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_taxi,
           MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '网约车下客' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ridehail,
           MAX(CASE WHEN metric = '共享单车锁车' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_bike
    FROM top10
    GROUP BY stat_hour, geohash
)
SELECT a.stat_hour AS hour,
       a.geohash,
       a.hotspot_types,
       CASE
           WHEN a.has_taxi = 1 AND a.has_ridehail = 1 AND a.has_bike = 1 THEN '出租车下客+网约车下客+共享单车锁车'
           WHEN a.has_taxi = 1 AND a.has_ridehail = 1 THEN '出租车下客+网约车下客'
           WHEN a.has_taxi = 1 AND a.has_bike = 1 THEN '出租车下客+共享单车锁车'

FROM agg a
WHERE a.hotspot_types >= 2

-- 按每小时前 10 个网格占本指标小时总量的比例衡量集中度；
-- 找出网约车下车完单量(ridehail_dropoffs)与共享单车锁车量(bike_locks)
-- 集中度都高于各自小时平均值的小时。
-- Top-K=10：值降序，边界同值按 geohash 升序取满 10 项。
WITH rh AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, ridehail_dropoffs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour
                            ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
),
rh_conc AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
           / SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_concentration
  FROM rh
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
bike AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, bike_locks,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour
                            ORDER BY bike_locks DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
),
bike_conc AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
           / SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_concentration
  FROM bike
  GROUP BY stat_hour
)
SELECT
  r.hour AS hour,
  r.ridehail_concentration AS ridehail_concentration,
  b.bike_concentration AS bike_concentration,
  (SELECT AVG(ridehail_concentration) FROM rh_conc) AS average_ridehail_concentration,
  (SELECT AVG(bike_concentration) FROM bike_conc) AS average_bike_concentration
FROM rh_conc r
JOIN bike_conc b ON r.hour = b.hour
WHERE r.ridehail_concentration > (SELECT AVG(ridehail_concentration) FROM rh_conc)
  AND b.bike_concentration > (SELECT AVG(bike_concentration) FROM bike_conc)
ORDER BY r.hour;

WITH station_metro AS (
    -- 每个物理地铁站在早/晚高峰的本站出站量（汇总全部线路）
    SELECT
        station_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS morning_exit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS evening_exit
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY station_id
),
station_rh_hour AS (
    -- 每个地铁站500米内网格、每个高峰小时的网约车下客量（NULL 不计入）
    SELECT
        mgd.station_id,
        gfh.stat_hour,
        SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh_sum,
        COUNT(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh_obs
    FROM metro_grid_distance AS mgd
    JOIN grid_flow_hour AS gfh
      ON gfh.geohash = mgd.geohash
    WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 500
      AND gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND gfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY mgd.station_id, gfh.stat_hour
),
station_rh AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN rh_sum END), 0) AS morning_ridehail,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN rh_sum END), 0) AS evening_ridehail,
        -- 六个高峰小时中网约车下客量存在观测的小时数
        SUM(CASE WHEN rh_obs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS observed_hours
    FROM station_rh_hour
    GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT
    sm.station_id AS station_id,
    m.station_name AS station_name,
    sm.morning_exit AS morning_exit,
    sm.evening_exit AS evening_exit,
    sr.morning_ridehail AS morning_ridehail,
    sr.evening_ridehail AS evening_ridehail,
    sr.evening_ridehail - sr.morning_ridehail AS ridehail_increase
FROM station_metro AS sm
JOIN station_rh AS sr ON sr.station_id = sm.station_id
JOIN metro_station AS m ON m.station_id = sm.station_id
WHERE sr.observed_hours = 6          -- 六个高峰小时均有网约车下客量观测

WITH eligible AS (

    GROUP BY bus_line_id

    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY station_id

SELECT s.station_id                                   AS station_id,
       s.station_name                                 AS station_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM assignment a
        WHERE a.station_id = s.station_id)            AS assigned_lines,
       (SELECT SUM(lf.day_total)
        FROM assignment a
        JOIN line_day_flow lf ON lf.bus_line_id = a.bus_line_id
        WHERE a.station_id = s.station_id)            AS assigned_bus_total,

-- 对每个地铁站，分别以800米内共享单车锁车量(bike_locks)和网约车下客量(ridehail_dropoffs)
-- 为权重计算地铁站到网格的平均距离，列出两项平均距离之差绝对值最大的10个站。
-- 数据日期：2026-08-24（全天，各网格按小时锁车量/下客量汇总为全天值作为权重）。
WITH grid_day AS (
    -- 每个网格全天的共享单车锁车量、网约车下客量（SUM 忽略 NULL 观测）
    SELECT
        geohash,
        SUM(bike_locks)        AS bike_total,
        SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_total
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY geohash
),
bike AS (
    -- 以共享单车锁车量为权重的平均距离（800米内网格）
    SELECT
        mgd.station_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(gd.bike_total, 0) * mgd.distance_m) AS wdist,
        SUM(COALESCE(gd.bike_total, 0))                  AS wsum
    FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
    JOIN grid_day gd ON gd.geohash = mgd.geohash
    WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 800
    GROUP BY mgd.station_id
),
ride AS (
    -- 以网约车下客量为权重的平均距离（800米内网格）
    SELECT
        mgd.station_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(gd.ridehail_total, 0) * mgd.distance_m) AS wdist,
        SUM(COALESCE(gd.ridehail_total, 0))                  AS wsum
    FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
    JOIN grid_day gd ON gd.geohash = mgd.geohash
    WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 800
    GROUP BY mgd.station_id
)
SELECT
    ms.station_id                                   AS station_id,
    ms.station_name                                 AS station_name,
    bike.wdist / bike.wsum                          AS bike_average_distance,
    ride.wdist / ride.wsum                          AS ridehail_average_distance,
    ABS(bike.wdist / bike.wsum - ride.wdist / ride.wsum) AS distance_difference
FROM metro_station ms
JOIN bike ON bike.station_id = ms.station_id
JOIN ride ON ride.station_id = ms.station_id
WHERE bike.wsum > 0 AND ride.wsum > 0
ORDER BY distance_difference DESC, ms.station_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

-- 对每个地铁站：选 2km 内最近 3 个其他站；
-- 早高峰(7/8/9时)本站进站量、已选邻站中三小时观测完整的站数、邻站合计(仅当所有已选邻站完整时给出)。
WITH morning AS (
  -- 每个物理站早高峰(7,8,9时)进站量，汇总该 station_id 的全部线路记录
  SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS entry
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY station_id
),
complete AS (
  -- 该物理站在 7/8/9 三个小时是否都有观测
  SELECT station_id,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_complete
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY station_id
),
ranked AS (
  -- 每个站的 2km 内其他站，按距离升序、并列按 nearby_station_id 升序取 Top-3
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id
                            ORDER BY distance_m ASC, nearby_station_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM metro_station_distance
),
sel AS (
  SELECT station_id AS s_id, nearby_station_id AS n_id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 3
),
selagg AS (
  SELECT s.s_id,
         COUNT(*) AS selected_cnt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.is_complete, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_cnt,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
               AND SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.is_complete, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*)
              THEN SUM(COALESCE(m.entry, 0))
              ELSE NULL
         END AS n_total
  FROM sel s
  LEFT JOIN complete c ON c.station_id = s.n_id
  LEFT JOIN morning  m ON m.station_id = s.n_id
  GROUP BY s.s_id
)
SELECT ms.station_id                                   AS station_id,
       ms.station_name                                 AS station_name,
       COALESCE(m.entry, 0)                            AS station_morning_entry,
       COALESCE(a.selected_cnt, 0)                     AS selected_neighbor_count,
       COALESCE(a.valid_cnt, 0)                        AS valid_neighbor_count,
       a.n_total                                       AS neighbor_entry_total
FROM metro_station ms
LEFT JOIN morning  m ON m.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN selagg   a ON a.s_id      = ms.station_id
ORDER BY ms.station_id;

WITH nearest AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        nearby_station_id AS nn_id,
        distance_m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

        ) AS rn
    FROM metro_station_distance
),
nn AS (
    SELECT station_id, nn_id, distance_m
    FROM nearest
    WHERE rn = 1
),
mutual_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(a.station_id, b.station_id) AS station_a_id,
        MAX(a.station_id, b.station_id) AS station_b_id,
        a.distance_m
    FROM nn a
    JOIN nn b
      ON a.station_id = b.nn_id
     AND b.station_id = a.nn_id
    WHERE a.distance_m <= 2000
      AND a.station_id < b.station_id
    GROUP BY a.station_id, a.nn_id
),
complete_stations AS (
    SELECT station_id
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
      AND exit_flow IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 3
),
station_exit AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_total
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY station_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        p.station_a_id,
        sa.station_name AS station_a_name,
        p.station_b_id,
        sb.station_name AS station_b_name,
        p.distance_m,
        ea.exit_total AS station_a_exit,
        eb.exit_total AS station_b_exit,
        ABS(ea.exit_total - eb.exit_total) AS exit_difference
    FROM mutual_pairs p
    JOIN metro_station sa ON sa.station_id = p.station_a_id
    JOIN metro_station sb ON sb.station_id = p.station_b_id
    JOIN complete_stations ca ON ca.station_id = p.station_a_id
    JOIN complete_stations cb ON cb.station_id = p.station_b_id
    JOIN station_exit ea ON ea.station_id = p.station_a_id
    JOIN station_exit eb ON eb.station_id = p.station_b_id
)
SELECT
    station_a_id,
    station_a_name,
    station_b_id,
    station_b_name,
    distance_m,
    station_a_exit,
    station_b_exit,
    exit_difference

ORDER BY exit_difference DESC, station_b_id ASC

    FROM bus_flow_hour f

      AND f.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
    GROUP BY f.bus_line_id
)

       CASE WHEN q.bus_line_id IS NOT NULL

       AND b.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
    GROUP BY o.station_id, o.bus_line_id
),
station_bus AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           COUNT(*) AS nearby_lines,

           SUM(line_bus_total) AS morning_bus_total
    FROM line_stats
    GROUP BY station_id
),

    FROM metro_bus_line_distance
    GROUP BY station_id

        c.bus_line_id,

            PARTITION BY c.station_id

  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered_grids) THEN gfh.taxi_dropoffs END) AS INTEGER) AS covered_total,
  CAST(SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs) AS INTEGER) AS all_grid_total,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered_grids) THEN gfh.taxi_dropoffs END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / CAST(SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs) AS REAL), 2) AS covered_pct
FROM grid_flow_hour gfh
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '网约车下客' AS metric,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered_grids) THEN gfh.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS INTEGER) AS covered_total,
  CAST(SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS INTEGER) AS all_grid_total,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered_grids) THEN gfh.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / CAST(SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS REAL), 2) AS covered_pct
FROM grid_flow_hour gfh
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '共享单车锁车' AS metric,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered_grids) THEN gfh.bike_locks END) AS INTEGER) AS covered_total,
  CAST(SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS INTEGER) AS all_grid_total,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM covered_grids) THEN gfh.bike_locks END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / CAST(SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS REAL), 2) AS covered_pct
FROM grid_flow_hour gfh

WITH grid_classification AS (
  SELECT gfh.geohash,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metro_grid_distance mgd 
        WHERE mgd.geohash = gfh.geohash AND mgd.distance_m <= 500
      ) THEN '500米范围内'
      ELSE '500米范围外'
    END AS area_type
  FROM grid_flow_hour gfh
  WHERE (gfh.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL OR gfh.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)
    AND gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY gfh.geohash
),
grid_data AS (
  SELECT gc.area_type,
    gfh.stat_hour,
    gfh.taxi_dropoffs,
    gfh.ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour gfh
  JOIN grid_classification gc ON gfh.geohash = gc.geohash
  WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT 
  area_type,
  '出租车下客' AS metric,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8) THEN taxi_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS morning_total,
  SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS daily_total,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8) THEN taxi_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(taxi_dropoffs), 0), 2) AS morning_pct
FROM grid_data
GROUP BY area_type
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  area_type,
  '网约车下客' AS metric,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8) THEN ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS morning_total,
  SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS daily_total,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8) THEN ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs), 0), 2) AS morning_pct
FROM grid_data
GROUP BY area_type
ORDER BY area_type, metric;

WITH grids_in_500m AS (
  SELECT geohash, station_id, distance_m
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
grids_multi_stations AS (
  SELECT geohash
  FROM grids_in_500m
  GROUP BY geohash
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 2
),
grid_assignment AS (
  SELECT g1.geohash, g1.station_id
  FROM grids_in_500m g1
  JOIN grids_multi_stations g2 ON g1.geohash = g2.geohash
  WHERE g1.distance_m = (
    SELECT MIN(distance_m)
    FROM grids_in_500m g3
    WHERE g3.geohash = g1.geohash
  )
  AND g1.station_id = (
    SELECT MIN(station_id)
    FROM grids_in_500m g4
    WHERE g4.geohash = g1.geohash AND g4.distance_m = g1.distance_m
  )
)
SELECT 
  ga.station_id,
  ms.station_name,
  SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS evening_bike,
  SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
FROM grid_assignment ga
JOIN metro_station ms ON ga.station_id = ms.station_id
LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour gfh ON ga.geohash = gfh.geohash
  AND gfh.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
GROUP BY ga.station_id, ms.station_name
ORDER BY ga.station_id

WITH xjh AS (
  SELECT station_id FROM metro_station WHERE station_name = '徐家汇'
),
stadium AS (
  SELECT station_id FROM metro_station WHERE station_name = '上海体育馆'
),
xjh_grids AS (
  SELECT geohash FROM metro_grid_distance 
  WHERE station_id = (SELECT station_id FROM xjh)
    AND distance_m <= 800
),
stadium_grids AS (
  SELECT geohash FROM metro_grid_distance 
  WHERE station_id = (SELECT station_id FROM stadium)
    AND distance_m <= 800
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    g.geohash,
    CASE 
      WHEN x.geohash IS NOT NULL AND s.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN '两站都覆盖'
      WHEN x.geohash IS NOT NULL THEN '只靠近徐家汇'
      ELSE '只靠近上海体育馆'
    END AS area_type
  FROM (
    SELECT geohash FROM xjh_grids
    UNION
    SELECT geohash FROM stadium_grids
  ) g
  LEFT JOIN xjh_grids x ON g.geohash = x.geohash
  LEFT JOIN stadium_grids s ON g.geohash = s.geohash
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    c.area_type,
    SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs) AS evening_taxi,
    SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail,
    SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS evening_bike
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour gfh ON c.geohash = gfh.geohash
  WHERE gfh.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY c.area_type
),
categories AS (
  SELECT '只靠近徐家汇' AS area_type
  UNION ALL SELECT '只靠近上海体育馆'
  UNION ALL SELECT '两站都覆盖'
)
SELECT 
  cat.area_type,
  COALESCE(a.evening_taxi, 0) AS evening_taxi,
  COALESCE(a.evening_ridehail, 0) AS evening_ridehail,
  COALESCE(a.evening_bike, 0) AS evening_bike
FROM categories cat
LEFT JOIN aggregated a ON cat.area_type = a.area_type
ORDER BY CASE cat.area_type
  WHEN '只靠近徐家汇' THEN 1
  WHEN '只靠近上海体育馆' THEN 2
  WHEN '两站都覆盖' THEN 3
END;

WITH 
station_bus AS (
    SELECT

        bus_line_id
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
bus_morning AS (
    SELECT 
        bus_line_id,
        SUM(passenger_flow) AS morning_bus_flow,
        COUNT(passenger_flow) AS bus_observed_hours
    FROM bus_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9

),
metro_morning AS (

SELECT

    bm.morning_bus_flow,

    mm.morning_entry,

FROM metro_station ms
JOIN metro_morning mm ON ms.station_id = mm.station_id
LEFT JOIN station_bus sb ON ms.station_id = sb.station_id
LEFT JOIN bus_line bl ON sb.bus_line_id = bl.bus_line_id
LEFT JOIN bus_morning bm ON sb.bus_line_id = bm.bus_line_id;

WITH bus_lines_nearby AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS station_count

  GROUP BY bus_line_id

SELECT

WITH station_lines AS (

line_metrics AS (

WITH station_grid AS (

),
bike_flow AS (

    GROUP BY sg.station_id, sg.distance_m
),
bike_avg AS (

    FROM bike_flow
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING SUM(bike_locks) > 0
),
ridehail_avg AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(distance_m * ridehail_dropoffs) / SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_average_distance

SELECT

WITH station_hour AS (
  SELECT 
    m.station_id,
    gfh.stat_date,
    gfh.stat_hour,
    SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS bike_sum,
    SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_sum
  FROM metro_grid_distance m

  WHERE m.distance_m <= 500

),
windows AS (
  SELECT 
    a.station_id,

    a.stat_hour AS start_hour,
    a.bike_sum + b.bike_sum + c.bike_sum AS bike_window,
    a.taxi_sum + b.taxi_sum + c.taxi_sum AS taxi_window
  FROM station_hour a
  JOIN station_hour b ON a.station_id = b.station_id AND a.stat_date = b.stat_date AND b.stat_hour = a.stat_hour + 1
  JOIN station_hour c ON a.station_id = c.station_id AND a.stat_date = c.stat_date AND c.stat_hour = a.stat_hour + 2
  WHERE a.bike_sum IS NOT NULL AND b.bike_sum IS NOT NULL AND c.bike_sum IS NOT NULL
    AND a.taxi_sum IS NOT NULL AND b.taxi_sum IS NOT NULL AND c.taxi_sum IS NOT NULL
),
bike_best AS (
  SELECT station_id, start_hour, bike_window
  FROM (
    SELECT station_id, start_hour, bike_window,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY bike_window DESC) AS rn
    FROM windows
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
taxi_best AS (
  SELECT station_id, start_hour, taxi_window
  FROM (
    SELECT station_id, start_hour, taxi_window,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY taxi_window DESC) AS rn
    FROM windows
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  bb.station_id,
  ms.station_name,
  bb.start_hour,
  bb.bike_window,

FROM bike_best bb
JOIN taxi_best tb ON bb.station_id = tb.station_id AND bb.start_hour = tb.start_hour
JOIN metro_station ms ON bb.station_id = ms.station_id
ORDER BY bb.station_id;

WITH 
ranked_neighbors AS (

      PARTITION BY msd.station_id 
      ORDER BY msd.distance_m ASC, msd.nearby_station_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM metro_station_distance msd
  WHERE msd.distance_m <= 2000 
    AND msd.station_id != msd.nearby_station_id
),
top_neighbors AS (
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id
  FROM ranked_neighbors
  WHERE rn <= 3
),
station_morning AS (

    station_id,
    SUM(entry_flow) AS morning_entry,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN entry_flow IS NOT NULL THEN stat_hour END) AS observed_hours
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY station_id
),
neighbor_agg AS (

  FROM top_neighbors tn

  GROUP BY tn.station_id
)
SELECT 
  ms.station_id,
  ms.station_name,
  COALESCE(s_self.morning_entry, 0) AS station_morning_entry,
  COALESCE(na.selected_count, 0) AS selected_neighbor_count,
  COALESCE(na.valid_count, 0) AS valid_neighbor_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(na.selected_count, 0) > 0 
         AND COALESCE(na.selected_count, 0) = COALESCE(na.valid_count, 0)
    THEN na.total_entry 
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS neighbor_entry_total
FROM metro_station ms
LEFT JOIN station_morning s_self ON ms.station_id = s_self.station_id
LEFT JOIN neighbor_agg na ON ms.station_id = na.station_id

WITH 
evening_peak AS (

  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
  GROUP BY station_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 3
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id, distance_m
  FROM metro_station_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 2000
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT 
    station_id,
    nearby_station_id,
    distance_m,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY station_id 
      ORDER BY distance_m ASC, nearby_station_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM candidates
),
mutual_nn AS (
  SELECT 
    n1.station_id AS a_id,
    n1.nearby_station_id AS b_id,
    n1.distance_m
  FROM nearest n1
  JOIN nearest n2 
    ON n1.station_id = n2.nearby_station_id 
    AND n1.nearby_station_id = n2.station_id
  WHERE n1.rn = 1 AND n2.rn = 1
    AND n1.station_id < n1.nearby_station_id
)
SELECT 
  m.a_id AS station_a_id,
  sa.station_name AS station_a_name,
  m.b_id AS station_b_id,
  sb.station_name AS station_b_name,
  ROUND(m.distance_m, 6) AS distance_m,
  ea.total_exit AS station_a_exit,
  eb.total_exit AS station_b_exit,
  ABS(ea.total_exit - eb.total_exit) AS exit_difference
FROM mutual_nn m
JOIN metro_station sa ON m.a_id = sa.station_id
JOIN metro_station sb ON m.b_id = sb.station_id
JOIN evening_peak ea ON m.a_id = ea.station_id
JOIN evening_peak eb ON m.b_id = eb.station_id
ORDER BY exit_difference DESC, m.a_id ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT

  FROM metro_flow_hour

  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
combined AS (
  SELECT m.stat_hour AS hour,
         100.0 * m.m_hour
           / (SELECT SUM(entry_flow) FROM metro_flow_hour
              WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24') AS metro_pct_raw,
         100.0 * r.r_hour
           / (SELECT SUM(ridehail_orders) FROM grid_flow_hour
              WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND ridehail_orders IS NOT NULL) AS ridehail_pct_raw
  FROM metro m
  INNER JOIN ridehail r ON m.stat_hour = r.stat_hour
)
SELECT hour,
       ROUND(metro_pct_raw, 2)     AS metro_pct,
       ROUND(ridehail_pct_raw, 2)  AS ridehail_pct,
       ROUND(ABS(metro_pct_raw - ridehail_pct_raw), 2) AS difference_pct
FROM combined
WHERE ABS(metro_pct_raw - ridehail_pct_raw) =
      (SELECT MAX(ABS(metro_pct_raw - ridehail_pct_raw)) FROM combined)
ORDER BY hour;

WHERE m_cur.metro_entry > m_prev.metro_entry
  AND b_cur.bus_pax     > b_prev.bus_pax

WITH h AS (

    geohash,
    taxi_dropoffs,

    bike_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour = 8

    geohash,
    CASE WHEN taxi_dropoffs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a,
    CASE WHEN ridehail_dropoffs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS b,
    CASE WHEN bike_locks > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c
  FROM h
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT '出租车下客' AS ma, '网约车下客' AS mb, a AS x, b AS y FROM s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '出租车下客', '共享单车锁车', a, c FROM s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '网约车下客', '共享单车锁车', b, c FROM s
)
SELECT
  ma AS metric_a,
  mb AS metric_b,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x = 1 AND y = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS intersection_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN x = 1 OR y = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS union_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN x = 1 AND y = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / SUM(CASE WHEN x = 1 OR y = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jaccard
FROM pairs
GROUP BY ma, mb

  CASE ma WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 1 WHEN '网约车下客' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  CASE mb WHEN '出租车下客' THEN 1 WHEN '网约车下客' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

-- 早高峰与晚高峰中，出租车与网约车下客量各自前20个网格的交集、并集与Jaccard
-- 时段口径：早高峰 7/8/9 时，晚高峰 17/18/19 时
-- 边界同值按 geohash 升序取满 K=20，不扩展并列
WITH
periods AS (
  SELECT '早高峰' AS period, 7 AS h_start, 9  AS h_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '晚高峰',           17,         19
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.period,
    g.geohash,
    SUM(g.taxi_dropoffs)     AS taxi_total,
    SUM(g.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_total
  FROM grid_flow_hour g
  JOIN periods p
    ON g.stat_hour BETWEEN p.h_start AND p.h_end
  WHERE g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY p.period, g.geohash
),
long_indicator AS (
  -- 仅保留存在正观测的 (period, mode, geohash)
  SELECT period, 'taxi'     AS indicator, geohash, taxi_total     AS total FROM agg WHERE taxi_total     IS NOT NULL AND taxi_total     > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period, 'ridehail' AS indicator, geohash, ridehail_total AS total FROM agg WHERE ridehail_total IS NOT NULL AND ridehail_total > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    period, indicator, geohash, total,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period, indicator ORDER BY total DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
  FROM long_indicator
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT period, indicator, geohash FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 20
),
taxi_t20 AS (
  SELECT period, geohash FROM top20 WHERE indicator = 'taxi'
),
ride_t20 AS (
  SELECT period, geohash FROM top20 WHERE indicator = 'ridehail'
),
union_set AS (
  SELECT period, geohash FROM taxi_t20
  UNION
  SELECT period, geohash FROM ride_t20
)
SELECT
  u.period                                                                            AS period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.geohash IS NOT NULL AND r.geohash IS NOT NULL
                      THEN u.geohash END)                                              AS intersection_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.geohash)                                                           AS union_count,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.geohash IS NOT NULL AND r.geohash IS NOT NULL
                           THEN u.geohash END) AS REAL)
    / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT u.geohash) AS REAL)                                         AS jaccard
FROM union_set u
LEFT JOIN taxi_t20 t ON u.period = t.period AND u.geohash = t.geohash
LEFT JOIN ride_t20 r ON u.period = r.period AND u.geohash = r.geohash
GROUP BY u.period
ORDER BY CASE u.period WHEN '早高峰' THEN 1 WHEN '晚高峰' THEN 2 ELSE 9 END;

  SELECT

),

  SELECT
    geohash,
    MAX(taxi_dropoffs)    AS max_taxi,
    MAX(ridehail_dropoffs) AS max_ridehail
  FROM common_obs
  GROUP BY geohash
),
grid_peak AS (
  -- 每个网格是否同时存在两类峰值小时（任一小时两类下客量均各自取最大值）

    co.geohash,
    SUM(CASE WHEN co.taxi_dropoffs = gm.max_taxi AND co.ridehail_dropoffs = gm.max_ridehail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overlap_hours

WITH
metro_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        stat_hour,
        SUM(exit_flow) AS total_exit
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour

bike_hourly AS (

        mgd.station_id,
        gfh.stat_hour,
        SUM(gfh.bike_locks) AS total_locks
    FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
    JOIN grid_flow_hour gfh
      ON mgd.geohash = gfh.geohash
    WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 500
      AND gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND gfh.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mgd.station_id, gfh.stat_hour
),
joint_stations AS (
    SELECT m.station_id
    FROM metro_hourly m
    JOIN bike_hourly b
      ON m.station_id = b.station_id
     AND m.stat_hour = b.stat_hour
    GROUP BY m.station_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6
),
metro_peak_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mh.station_id,
        mh.stat_hour
    FROM metro_hourly mh
    JOIN joint_stations js
      ON js.station_id = mh.station_id
    WHERE mh.total_exit = (
        SELECT MAX(mh2.total_exit)
        FROM metro_hourly mh2
        WHERE mh2.station_id = mh.station_id
    )
),
bike_peak_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        bh.station_id,
        bh.stat_hour
    FROM bike_hourly bh
    JOIN joint_stations js
      ON js.station_id = bh.station_id
    WHERE bh.total_locks = (
        SELECT MAX(bh2.total_locks)
        FROM bike_hourly bh2
        WHERE bh2.station_id = bh.station_id
    )
),
station_classification AS (
    SELECT
        js.station_id,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM metro_peak_set mp
                JOIN bike_peak_set bp
                  ON mp.station_id = bp.station_id
                 AND mp.stat_hour  = bp.stat_hour
                WHERE mp.station_id = js.station_id
            ) THEN '峰值小时有重合'
            ELSE '峰值小时无重合'
        END AS peak_relation
    FROM joint_stations js

SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS station_count
FROM station_classification
GROUP BY peak_relation

WITH metro AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7,8,9)   THEN exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS morning_exit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (17,18,19) THEN exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS evening_exit
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7,8,9)   THEN stat_hour END) = 3
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (17,18,19) THEN stat_hour END) = 3
),
rh_hour AS (
  -- 每个地铁站每个小时在 500 米内网格上的网约车下客量（仅汇总非 NULL 观测）
  SELECT
    mgd.station_id,
    gfh.stat_hour,
    SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS dropoffs
  FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
  JOIN grid_flow_hour gfh
    ON gfh.geohash = mgd.geohash
  WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND gfh.stat_hour IN (7,8,9,17,18,19)
    AND mgd.distance_m <= 500
    AND gfh.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mgd.station_id, gfh.stat_hour
),
rh AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7,8,9)   THEN dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS morning_ridehail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (17,18,19) THEN dropoffs ELSE 0 END) AS evening_ridehail
  FROM rh_hour
  GROUP BY station_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 6
)
SELECT
  m.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  CAST(m.morning_exit     AS INTEGER) AS morning_exit,
  CAST(m.evening_exit     AS INTEGER) AS evening_exit,
  CAST(r.morning_ridehail AS INTEGER) AS morning_ridehail,
  CAST(r.evening_ridehail AS INTEGER) AS evening_ridehail,
  CAST(r.evening_ridehail - r.morning_ridehail AS INTEGER) AS ridehail_increase
FROM metro m
JOIN rh  r ON r.station_id = m.station_id
JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = m.station_id
WHERE m.evening_exit > m.morning_exit
  AND r.evening_ridehail > r.morning_ridehail
