WITH
qualifying_grids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND (taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL OR ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)
),
grid_area AS (
  SELECT
    qg.geohash,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
        WHERE mgd.geohash = qg.geohash AND mgd.distance_m <= 500
      ) THEN '500米范围内'
      ELSE '500米范围外'
    END AS area_type
  FROM qualifying_grids qg
),
area_metric_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ga.area_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN gfh.taxi_dropoffs END) AS taxi_morning,
    SUM(gfh.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_daily,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gfh.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN gfh.ridehail_dropoffs END) AS ridehail_morning,
    SUM(gfh.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_daily
  FROM grid_flow_hour gfh
  JOIN grid_area ga ON gfh.geohash = ga.geohash
  WHERE gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY ga.area_type
),
area_types AS (SELECT '500米范围内' AS area_type UNION ALL SELECT '500米范围外'),
metrics AS (SELECT '出租车下客' AS metric UNION ALL SELECT '网约车下客')
SELECT
  at.area_type AS area_type,
  m.metric AS metric,
  CAST(CASE m.metric
         WHEN '出租车下客' THEN COALESCE(amt.taxi_morning, 0)
         WHEN '网约车下客' THEN COALESCE(amt.ridehail_morning, 0)
       END AS INTEGER) AS morning_total,
  CAST(CASE m.metric
         WHEN '出租车下客' THEN COALESCE(amt.taxi_daily, 0)
         WHEN '网约车下客' THEN COALESCE(amt.ridehail_daily, 0)
       END AS INTEGER) AS daily_total,
  ROUND(
    CASE m.metric
      WHEN '出租车下客' THEN CAST(COALESCE(amt.taxi_morning, 0) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(amt.taxi_daily, 0)
      WHEN '网约车下客' THEN CAST(COALESCE(amt.ridehail_morning, 0) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(amt.ridehail_daily, 0)
    END, 2
  ) AS morning_pct
FROM area_types at
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN area_metric_totals amt ON at.area_type = amt.area_type
ORDER BY
  CASE at.area_type WHEN '500米范围内' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,

-- Evening peak (17/18/19) shared-bike locks and ride-hail dropoffs on 2026-08-24,
-- for grids that are within 500m of at least two metro stations.
-- Each such grid is assigned to its nearest station (tie-break: smallest station_id).
WITH grids_multi AS (
    SELECT geohash
    FROM metro_grid_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
    GROUP BY geohash
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 2
),
grid_min AS (
    SELECT geohash, MIN(distance_m) AS min_d
    FROM metro_grid_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
      AND geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM grids_multi)
    GROUP BY geohash
),
grid_assignment AS (
    -- pick the station at the min distance; tie-break by smallest station_id
    SELECT gm.geohash, MIN(m.station_id) AS station_id
    FROM grid_min gm
    JOIN metro_grid_distance m
      ON m.geohash = gm.geohash
     AND m.distance_m = gm.min_d
    GROUP BY gm.geohash
),
evening_obs AS (
    SELECT geohash, bike_locks, ridehail_dropoffs
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
),
station_metrics AS (
    SELECT ga.station_id,
           SUM(eo.bike_locks)        AS evening_bike,
           SUM(eo.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
    FROM grid_assignment ga
    LEFT JOIN evening_obs eo ON ga.geohash = eo.geohash
    GROUP BY ga.station_id
)
SELECT sm.station_id,
       ms.station_name,
       sm.evening_bike,
       sm.evening_ridehail
FROM station_metrics sm
JOIN metro_station ms ON ms.station_id = sm.station_id
ORDER BY sm.station_id;

WITH nearest AS (
    SELECT
        bus_line_id,
        station_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY bus_line_id
            ORDER BY distance_m ASC, station_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
assigned AS (
    SELECT bus_line_id, station_id
    FROM nearest
    WHERE rn = 1
),
bus_daily AS (
    SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_total
    FROM bus_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY bus_line_id
),
station_bus_agg AS (
    SELECT
        a.station_id,
        COUNT(*) AS assigned_lines,
        SUM(bd.bus_total) AS assigned_bus_total
    FROM assigned a
    LEFT JOIN bus_daily bd ON a.bus_line_id = bd.bus_line_id
    GROUP BY a.station_id
),
metro_entry AS (
    SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entry_total
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT
    ms.station_id        AS station_id,
    ms.station_name      AS station_name,
    COALESCE(sba.assigned_lines, 0) AS assigned_lines,
    sba.assigned_bus_total          AS assigned_bus_total,
    COALESCE(me.metro_entry_total, 0) AS metro_entry_total
FROM metro_station ms
LEFT JOIN station_bus_agg sba ON ms.station_id = sba.station_id
LEFT JOIN metro_entry      me ON ms.station_id = me.station_id

  GROUP BY sg.station_id, gf.stat_hour

windows AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour AS start_hour,
         SUM(bike_sum) OVER w AS bike_window,
         SUM(taxi_sum) OVER w AS taxi_window
  FROM hourly

),
valid AS (
  SELECT w.* FROM windows w
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hourly h WHERE h.station_id = w.station_id AND h.stat_hour = w.start_hour)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hourly h WHERE h.station_id = w.station_id AND h.stat_hour = w.start_hour + 1)

  GROUP BY station_id
),
bike_top AS (

    FROM metro_station_distance
),
top_neighbors AS (
    SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id

per_station AS (

        s.station_name,
        me.morning_entry AS station_morning_entry,
        COUNT(t.nearby_station_id) AS selected_neighbor_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ho.n_hours = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS valid_neighbor_count
    FROM metro_station s
    LEFT JOIN morning_entry me ON s.station_id = me.station_id
    LEFT JOIN top_neighbors t ON s.station_id = t.station_id
    LEFT JOIN hours_observed ho ON t.nearby_station_id = ho.station_id
    GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, me.morning_entry
)
SELECT
    p.station_id,
    p.station_name,
    p.station_morning_entry,
    p.selected_neighbor_count,
    p.valid_neighbor_count,
    CASE
        WHEN p.selected_neighbor_count = 3 AND p.valid_neighbor_count = 3
            THEN (
                SELECT SUM(me2.morning_entry)
                FROM top_neighbors t2
                JOIN morning_entry me2 ON t2.nearby_station_id = me2.station_id
                WHERE t2.station_id = p.station_id

        ELSE NULL
    END AS neighbor_entry_total

-- 口径：网格是否属于某并集，由该网格到任意地铁站的最小距离 (MIN distance_m) 判断；
--       新增网格 = {g | 500 < MIN_s distance(g,s) <= 800}，基准网格 = {g | MIN_s distance(g,s) <= 500}。
-- 业务日期：2026-08-24（grid_flow_hour 单日快照）。

WITH grid_min_dist AS (
  SELECT geohash, MIN(distance_m) AS min_d
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  GROUP BY geohash
),
grid_class AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         CASE WHEN min_d <= 500 THEN 'base' ELSE 'added' END AS klass
  FROM grid_min_dist
  WHERE min_d <= 800
),
grid_hour_sum AS (
  SELECT geohash,
         SUM(taxi_dropoffs)     AS taxi_sum,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh_sum
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY geohash
),
agg AS (
  SELECT c.klass,
         COALESCE(SUM(g.taxi_sum), 0) AS taxi_total,
         COALESCE(SUM(g.rh_sum),   0) AS rh_total
  FROM grid_class c
  LEFT JOIN grid_hour_sum g ON c.geohash = g.geohash
  GROUP BY c.klass
)
SELECT
  CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'added' THEN taxi_total END) AS INTEGER) AS added_taxi,
  CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'base'  THEN taxi_total END) AS INTEGER) AS base_taxi,
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'added' THEN taxi_total END)
              / MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'base'  THEN taxi_total END), 2) AS taxi_added_pct,
  CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'added' THEN rh_total END) AS INTEGER) AS added_ridehail,
  CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'base'  THEN rh_total END) AS INTEGER) AS base_ridehail,
  ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'added' THEN rh_total END)
              / MAX(CASE WHEN klass = 'base'  THEN rh_total END), 2) AS ridehail_added_pct
FROM agg;

WITH
line_station AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT line_id, station_id
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
),
grid_day_locks AS (
  SELECT geohash, SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks_day
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY geohash
),
station_grid_locks AS (
  SELECT
    ls.line_id,
    md.station_id,
    md.geohash,
    COALESCE(g.bike_locks_day, 0) AS bike_locks_day
  FROM line_station ls
  JOIN metro_grid_distance md
    ON md.station_id = ls.station_id
   AND md.distance_m <= 500
  LEFT JOIN grid_day_locks g
    ON g.geohash = md.geohash
),
line_station_sum AS (
  SELECT line_id, SUM(station_locks) AS station_sum_locks
  FROM (
    SELECT line_id, station_id, SUM(bike_locks_day) AS station_locks
    FROM station_grid_locks
    GROUP BY line_id, station_id
  )
  GROUP BY line_id
),
line_union_sum AS (
  SELECT line_id, SUM(grid_locks) AS union_locks
  FROM (
    SELECT line_id, geohash, MAX(bike_locks_day) AS grid_locks
    FROM station_grid_locks
    GROUP BY line_id, geohash
  )
  GROUP BY line_id
)
SELECT
  ml.line_id,
  ml.line_name,
  lss.station_sum_locks,
  lus.union_locks,
  lss.station_sum_locks - lus.union_locks AS repeated_locks,
  ROUND(100.0 * (lss.station_sum_locks - lus.union_locks) / lss.station_sum_locks, 2) AS repeated_pct
FROM metro_line ml
JOIN line_station_sum lss USING (line_id)
JOIN line_union_sum  lus USING (line_id)
ORDER BY ml.line_id;

    UNION ALL
    SELECT '出租车上车量', stat_hour, SUM(taxi_pickups)

    GROUP BY stat_hour
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '网约车下单量', stat_hour, SUM(ridehail_orders)

        WHERE t2.metric = t.metric

)

    a.metric AS metric_a,
    b.metric AS metric_b,

FROM peaks a

   AND a.metric < b.metric
ORDER BY metric_a ASC, metric_b ASC

  JOIN g ON g.stat_hour = m.stat_hour
  WHERE g.ct > 0 AND g.cr > 0 AND g.ck > 0

  ROUND(r.f * 100.0 / r.total, 2) AS ridehail_pct,

FROM m

FROM metro_h mp
JOIN metro_h mc ON mc.stat_hour = mp.stat_hour + 1
JOIN bus_h bp ON bp.stat_hour = mp.stat_hour

  g7.geohash,
  g7.ridehail_dropoffs AS ridehail_7,
  g8.ridehail_dropoffs AS ridehail_8,
  g9.ridehail_dropoffs AS ridehail_9,
  g7.bike_locks AS bike_7,
  g8.bike_locks AS bike_8,
  g9.bike_locks AS bike_9
FROM grid_flow_hour g7
JOIN grid_flow_hour g8
  ON g8.stat_date = g7.stat_date AND g8.geohash = g7.geohash AND g8.stat_hour = 8
JOIN grid_flow_hour g9
  ON g9.stat_date = g7.stat_date AND g9.geohash = g7.geohash AND g9.stat_hour = 9
WHERE g7.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  AND g7.stat_hour = 7
  AND g7.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  AND g8.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  AND g9.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  AND g7.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  AND g8.bike_locks IS NOT NULL

  AND g7.ridehail_dropoffs < g8.ridehail_dropoffs
  AND g8.ridehail_dropoffs < g9.ridehail_dropoffs
  AND g7.bike_locks < g8.bike_locks
  AND g8.bike_locks < g9.bike_locks;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, taxi_dropoffs AS v FROM grid_flow_hour
   WHERE stat_date='2026-08-24' AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL AND taxi_dropoffs>0
),
r AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, ridehail_dropoffs AS v FROM grid_flow_hour
   WHERE stat_date='2026-08-24' AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL AND ridehail_dropoffs>0
),
b AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, bike_locks AS v FROM grid_flow_hour
   WHERE stat_date='2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL AND bike_locks>0
),
tt AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY v DESC, geohash ASC) rn FROM t
),
rr AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY v DESC, geohash ASC) rn FROM r
),
bb AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY v DESC, geohash ASC) rn FROM b
),
tops AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, 1 AS m FROM tt WHERE rn<=10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, 2 FROM rr WHERE rn<=10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, 3 FROM bb WHERE rn<=10
),
agg AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, geohash, SUM(m) AS hotspot_types,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tx,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rh,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bk
  FROM tops GROUP BY stat_hour, geohash
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m)>=2
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT stat_hour, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_grids_in_hour FROM agg GROUP BY stat_hour
)
SELECT a.stat_hour AS hour,
       a.geohash,
       a.hotspot_types,
       CASE
         WHEN a.tx=1 AND a.rh=1 AND a.bk=1 THEN '出租车下客+网约车下客+共享单车锁车'
         WHEN a.tx=1 AND a.rh=1 THEN '出租车下客+网约车下客'
         WHEN a.tx=1 AND a.bk=1 THEN '出租车下客+共享单车锁车'
         ELSE '网约车下客+共享单车锁车'
       END AS included_metrics,
       c.qualifying_grids_in_hour
FROM agg a JOIN cnt c ON c.stat_hour=a.stat_hour
ORDER BY a.stat_hour, a.geohash

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    g.geohash,
    COUNT(*) AS common_hours,
    MAX(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh_peak,
    AVG(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh_avg,
    MAX(f.bike_locks) AS bike_peak,
    AVG(f.bike_locks) AS bike_avg
  FROM grid_flow_hour f
  JOIN grid g ON g.geohash = f.geohash
  WHERE f.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    AND f.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.geohash
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    geohash,
    common_hours,
    rh_peak * 1.0 / rh_avg AS ridehail_peak_ratio,
    bike_peak * 1.0 / bike_avg AS bike_peak_ratio,
    ABS(rh_peak * 1.0 / rh_avg - bike_peak * 1.0 / bike_avg) AS ratio_difference
  FROM base
  WHERE common_hours >= 6
    AND rh_avg > 0
    AND bike_avg > 0
)
SELECT geohash, common_hours,
       ROUND(ridehail_peak_ratio, 6) AS ridehail_peak_ratio,
       ROUND(bike_peak_ratio, 6) AS bike_peak_ratio,
       ROUND(ratio_difference, 6) AS ratio_difference
FROM calc
ORDER BY ratio_difference DESC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH rh AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_concentration
  FROM (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, ridehail_dropoffs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
bk AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour,
         SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_concentration
  FROM (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, bike_locks,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stat_hour ORDER BY bike_locks DESC, geohash ASC) AS rn
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT AVG(ridehail_concentration) AS average_ridehail_concentration,
         AVG(bike_concentration) AS average_bike_concentration
  FROM rh JOIN bk USING (hour)
)
SELECT rh.hour AS hour,
       rh.ridehail_concentration,
       bk.bike_concentration,
       avgc.average_ridehail_concentration,
       avgc.average_bike_concentration
FROM rh
JOIN bk ON rh.hour = bk.hour
CROSS JOIN avgc
WHERE rh.ridehail_concentration > avgc.average_ridehail_concentration
  AND bk.bike_concentration > avgc.average_bike_concentration
ORDER BY rh.hour

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(m.entry_flow), 0) AS metro_entries,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.passenger_flow) FROM bus_flow_hour b WHERE b.stat_date = '2026-08-24'), 0) AS bus_flow,
  CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.passenger_flow) FROM bus_flow_hour b WHERE b.stat_date = '2026-08-24'), 0) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(m.entry_flow), 0), 0) AS bus_to_metro_ratio
FROM metro_flow_hour m
WHERE m.stat_date = '2026-08-24'

SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs, SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs, SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks FROM grid_flow_hour WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' GROUP BY stat_hour ORDER BY stat_hour

WITH m AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entries
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
b AS (
  SELECT stat_hour AS hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS bus_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9
  GROUP BY stat_hour
),
tot AS (
  SELECT (SELECT SUM(metro_entries) FROM m) AS mt,
         (SELECT SUM(bus_flow) FROM b) AS bt
)
SELECT m.hour AS hour,
       CAST(m.metro_entries AS INTEGER) AS metro_entries,
       CAST(b.bus_flow AS INTEGER) AS bus_flow,
       ROUND(m.metro_entries * 100.0 / tot.mt, 2) AS metro_pct,
       ROUND(b.bus_flow * 100.0 / tot.bt, 2) AS bus_pct
FROM m
JOIN b ON b.hour = m.hour
CROSS JOIN tot
ORDER BY m.hour

SELECT geohash, taxi_dropoffs, ridehail_dropoffs,
       ABS(taxi_dropoffs - ridehail_dropoffs) AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT g.geohash,
         SUM(gf.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs,
         SUM(gf.ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs
  FROM grid_flow_hour gf
  JOIN grid g ON g.geohash = gf.geohash
  WHERE gf.stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
    AND gf.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    AND gf.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY g.geohash
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gf.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL THEN gf.stat_date || '-' || gf.stat_hour END) > 0
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gf.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL THEN gf.stat_date || '-' || gf.stat_hour END) > 0
)
ORDER BY difference ASC, geohash ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  SUBSTR(geohash, 1, 5) AS area5,
  SUM(COALESCE(taxi_dropoffs, 0)) AS taxi_dropoffs,
  SUM(COALESCE(ridehail_dropoffs, 0)) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
  SUM(COALESCE(bike_locks, 0)) AS bike_locks,
  SUM(COALESCE(taxi_dropoffs, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(ridehail_dropoffs, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(bike_locks, 0)) AS combined_total
FROM grid_flow_hour
GROUP BY area5
ORDER BY combined_total DESC, area5 ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT '地铁进站' AS mode,
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN entry_flow ELSE 0 END) AS morning_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN entry_flow ELSE 0 END) AS evening_total
FROM metro_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '公交客流量',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN passenger_flow ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN passenger_flow ELSE 0 END)
FROM bus_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '出租车下客',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN taxi_dropoffs ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN taxi_dropoffs ELSE 0 END)
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '网约车下客',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN ridehail_dropoffs ELSE 0 END)
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT '共享单车锁车',
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN bike_locks ELSE 0 END)
FROM grid_flow_hour
WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24';

WITH metro_agg AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           SUM(exit_flow) AS morning_exit
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 8
    GROUP BY station_id
),
bike_agg AS (
    SELECT d.station_id,
           SUM(gf.bike_locks) AS morning_bike
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN grid_flow_hour gf
      ON gf.geohash = d.geohash
     AND gf.stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 8
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
    GROUP BY d.station_id
    HAVING SUM(gf.bike_locks) IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    SELECT ms.station_id,
           ms.station_name,
           ma.morning_exit,
           ba.morning_bike
    FROM metro_station ms
    JOIN metro_agg ma
      ON ma.station_id = ms.station_id
     AND ma.morning_exit IS NOT NULL
    JOIN bike_agg ba
      ON ba.station_id = ms.station_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           station_name,
           morning_exit,
           morning_bike,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY morning_exit DESC) AS metro_rank,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY morning_bike DESC) AS bike_rank
    FROM base
)
SELECT station_id,
       station_name,
       morning_exit,
       morning_bike,
       metro_rank,
       bike_rank,
       ABS(metro_rank - bike_rank) AS rank_difference
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_difference DESC, station_id ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE hours(hour) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT hour + 1 FROM hours WHERE hour < 23
),
rings(ring) AS (
  SELECT '0-300'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '300-800'
),
target_station AS (
  SELECT station_id
  FROM metro_station
  WHERE station_name = '徐家汇'
),
ring_grid AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN mgd.distance_m <= 300 THEN '0-300' ELSE '300-800' END AS ring,
    gfh.stat_hour,
    gfh.taxi_dropoffs,
    gfh.ridehail_dropoffs,
    gfh.bike_locks
  FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
  JOIN target_station ts ON ts.station_id = mgd.station_id
  JOIN grid_flow_hour gfh
    ON gfh.geohash = mgd.geohash
   AND gfh.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  WHERE mgd.distance_m >= 0
    AND mgd.distance_m <= 800
),
ring_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ring,
    stat_hour,
    SUM(taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs,
    SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
    SUM(bike_locks) AS bike_locks
  FROM ring_grid
  GROUP BY ring, stat_hour
)
SELECT
  r.ring AS ring,
  h.hour AS hour,
  ra.taxi_dropoffs AS taxi_dropoffs,
  COALESCE(ra.ridehail_dropoffs, 0) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
  ra.bike_locks AS bike_locks
FROM hours h
CROSS JOIN rings r
LEFT JOIN ring_agg ra
  ON ra.ring = r.ring
 AND ra.stat_hour = h.hour
ORDER BY
  CASE r.ring WHEN '0-300' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  h.hour;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_date, stat_hour, SUM(exit_flow) AS v
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_date, stat_hour
),
m_obs AS (
  SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM m GROUP BY station_id
),
m_peak AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour AS peak_hour FROM m
  WHERE v = (SELECT MAX(v) FROM m m2 WHERE m2.station_id = m.station_id)
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
),
b AS (
  SELECT d.station_id, f.stat_date, f.stat_hour, SUM(f.bike_locks) AS v
  FROM metro_grid_distance d
  JOIN grid_flow_hour f ON f.geohash = d.geohash
  WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
  GROUP BY d.station_id, f.stat_date, f.stat_hour
  HAVING SUM(f.bike_locks) IS NOT NULL
),
b_obs AS (
  SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM b GROUP BY station_id
),
b_peak AS (
  SELECT station_id, stat_hour AS peak_hour FROM b
  WHERE v = (SELECT MAX(v) FROM b b2 WHERE b2.station_id = b.station_id)
  GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour
),
joined AS (
  SELECT mp.station_id, mp.peak_hour,
         EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b_peak bp WHERE bp.station_id = mp.station_id AND bp.peak_hour = mp.peak_hour) AS hit
  FROM m_peak mp
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN hit THEN '峰值小时有重合' ELSE '峰值小时无重合' END AS peak_relation,
  COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS station_count
FROM (
  SELECT mp.station_id,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM b_peak bp
           WHERE bp.station_id = mp.station_id AND bp.peak_hour = mp.peak_hour
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit
  FROM m_peak mp
  WHERE mp.station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM m_obs WHERE n >= 6)
    AND mp.station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM b_obs WHERE n >= 6)
  GROUP BY mp.station_id, mp.peak_hour
)
GROUP BY hit

WITH hours AS (
  SELECT 7 AS h UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
),
station_hours AS (
  SELECT mf.station_id, h.h,
         SUM(mf.exit_flow) AS exit_flow,
         COUNT(mf.exit_flow) AS obs
  FROM metro_flow_hour mf
  CROSS JOIN hours h
  WHERE mf.stat_hour = h.h
  GROUP BY mf.station_id, h.h
),
grid_ride AS (
  SELECT mgd.station_id, h.h,
         SUM(gf.ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh,
         COUNT(gf.ridehail_dropoffs) AS obs
  FROM metro_grid_distance mgd
  JOIN grid_flow_hour gf
    ON gf.geohash = mgd.geohash AND gf.stat_hour = h.h
  CROSS JOIN hours h
  WHERE mgd.distance_m <= 500 AND gf.stat_hour = h.h
  GROUP BY mgd.station_id, h.h
),
agg AS (
  SELECT s.station_id,
         ms.station_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.h IN (7,8,9) THEN s.exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS morning_exit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.h IN (17,18,19) THEN s.exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS evening_exit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.h IN (7,8,9) THEN r.rh ELSE 0 END) AS morning_ridehail,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.h IN (17,18,19) THEN r.rh ELSE 0 END) AS evening_ridehail
  FROM station_hours s
  JOIN grid_ride r ON r.station_id = s.station_id AND r.h = s.h
  JOIN metro_station ms ON ms.station_id = s.station_id
  GROUP BY s.station_id, ms.station_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 6
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.exit_flow IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN r.rh IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
)
SELECT station_id, station_name,
       morning_exit, evening_exit,
       morning_ridehail, evening_ridehail,
       evening_ridehail - morning_ridehail AS ridehail_increase
FROM agg
WHERE evening_exit > morning_exit
  AND evening_ridehail > morning_ridehail
ORDER BY ridehail_increase DESC, station_id ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH covered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(taxi_dropoffs),0) AS taxi_dropoffs,
    COALESCE(SUM(ridehail_dropoffs),0) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
    COALESCE(SUM(bike_locks),0) AS bike_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
),
cov AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(f.taxi_dropoffs),0) AS taxi_dropoffs,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs),0) AS ridehail_dropoffs,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.bike_locks),0) AS bike_locks
  FROM grid_flow_hour f
  JOIN covered c ON f.geohash = c.geohash
  WHERE f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)
SELECT
  '出租车下客' AS metric,
  c.taxi_dropoffs AS covered_total,
  a.taxi_dropoffs AS all_grid_total,
  ROUND(c.taxi_dropoffs * 100.0 / a.taxi_dropoffs, 2) AS covered_pct
FROM cov c, agg a
UNION ALL
SELECT
  '网约车下客',
  c.ridehail_dropoffs,
  a.ridehail_dropoffs,
  ROUND(c.ridehail_dropoffs * 100.0 / a.ridehail_dropoffs, 2)
FROM cov c, agg a
UNION ALL
SELECT
  '共享单车锁车',
  c.bike_locks,
  a.bike_locks,
  ROUND(c.bike_locks * 100.0 / a.bike_locks, 2)
FROM cov c, agg a

WITH grid_area AS (
  SELECT g.geohash,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM metro_grid_distance d
           WHERE d.geohash = g.geohash AND d.distance_m <= 500
         ) THEN '500米范围内' ELSE '500米范围外' END AS area_type
  FROM grid g
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM grid_flow_hour f
    WHERE f.geohash = g.geohash
      AND (f.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL OR f.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)
  )
),
unpivot AS (
  SELECT a.area_type,
         '出租车下客' AS metric,
         f.stat_hour,
         f.taxi_dropoffs AS val
  FROM grid_flow_hour f
  JOIN grid_area a ON a.geohash = f.geohash
  WHERE f.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.area_type,
         '网约车下客' AS metric,
         f.stat_hour,
         f.ridehail_dropoffs AS val
  FROM grid_flow_hour f
  JOIN grid_area a ON a.geohash = f.geohash
  WHERE f.ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT area_type,
       metric,
       SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN val ELSE 0 END) AS morning_total,
       SUM(val) AS daily_total,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN val ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(val), 2) AS morning_pct
FROM unpivot
GROUP BY area_type, metric
ORDER BY area_type, metric

WITH grid_two AS (
  SELECT geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
  GROUP BY geohash
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 2
),
grid_assign AS (
  SELECT d.geohash, d.station_id
  FROM (
    SELECT d.geohash, d.station_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geohash ORDER BY d.distance_m ASC, d.station_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN grid_two t ON t.geohash = d.geohash
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
  ) d
  WHERE d.rn = 1
)
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name,
       SUM(f.bike_locks) AS evening_bike,
       SUM(f.ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
FROM grid_assign a
JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = a.station_id
LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour f
  ON f.geohash = a.geohash
 AND f.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY s.station_id

WITH
xjh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance m
  JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = m.station_id
  WHERE s.station_name = '徐家汇' AND m.distance_m <= 800
),
tyg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.geohash
  FROM metro_grid_distance m
  JOIN metro_station s ON s.station_id = m.station_id
  WHERE s.station_name = '上海体育馆' AND m.distance_m <= 800
),
areas AS (
  SELECT geohash, '只靠近徐家汇' AS area_type
  FROM xjh WHERE geohash NOT IN (SELECT geohash FROM tyg)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geohash, '只靠近上海体育馆'
  FROM tyg WHERE geohash NOT IN (SELECT geohash FROM xjh)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geohash, '两站都覆盖'
  FROM xjh WHERE geohash IN (SELECT geohash FROM tyg)
)
SELECT
  a.area_type AS area_type,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(g.taxi_dropoffs), 0) AS INTEGER) AS evening_taxi,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(g.ridehail_dropoffs), 0) AS INTEGER) AS evening_ridehail,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(g.bike_locks), 0) AS INTEGER) AS evening_bike
FROM areas a
LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour g
  ON g.geohash = a.geohash
 AND g.stat_hour IN (17, 18)
GROUP BY a.area_type
ORDER BY CASE a.area_type
  WHEN '只靠近徐家汇' THEN 1
  WHEN '只靠近上海体育馆' THEN 2
  ELSE 3
END;

SELECT
  ms.station_id AS station_id,
  ms.station_name AS station_name,
  b.bus_line_id AS bus_line_id,
  b.line_name AS line_name,
  bf.morning_bus_flow AS morning_bus_flow,
  bf.bus_observed_hours AS bus_observed_hours,
  COALESCE(mf.morning_entry, 0) AS morning_entry,
  COALESCE(mf.metro_observed_hours, 0) AS metro_observed_hours
FROM metro_station ms
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance

  ON bl.bus_line_id = l.bus_line_id

-- 2026-08-24 上海出租车下车完单（taxi_dropoffs）网格早晚高峰对比
-- 口径：早高峰 7-9 时，晚高峰 17-19 时（上海本地时间）；
--       "有观测"指该网格小时 taxi_dropoffs 非 NULL；观测小时数按非 NULL 小时计数；
--       总量 SUM 忽略 NULL，不补零。
-- 条件：早、晚高峰均有下车完单观测的网格中，晚高峰总量 > 早高峰总量。
WITH peak AS (
    SELECT
        geohash,
        CASE
            WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9  THEN 'morning'
            WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19 THEN 'evening'
        END AS peak,
        SUM(taxi_dropoffs)   AS total_dropoffs,
        COUNT(taxi_dropoffs) AS obs_hours
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
      AND (stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 OR stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19)
    GROUP BY geohash, peak
)
SELECT
    m.geohash,
    m.total_dropoffs AS morning_dropoffs,
    e.total_dropoffs AS evening_dropoffs,
    m.obs_hours      AS morning_hours,
    e.obs_hours      AS evening_hours
FROM peak m
JOIN peak e
  ON e.geohash = m.geohash
 AND e.peak = 'evening'
WHERE m.peak = 'morning'
  AND e.total_dropoffs > m.total_dropoffs
ORDER BY m.geohash;

WITH m AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS v
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
b AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(passenger_flow) AS v
    FROM bus_flow_hour
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
t AS (

r AS (

    FROM grid_flow_hour
    GROUP BY stat_hour

k AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(bike_locks) AS v
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
common_hours AS (
    SELECT m.stat_hour,
           m.v AS metro_v, b.v AS bus_v, t.v AS taxi_v,
           r.v AS ridehail_v, k.v AS bike_v
    FROM m
    JOIN b USING (stat_hour)
    JOIN t USING (stat_hour)
    JOIN r USING (stat_hour)
    JOIN k USING (stat_hour)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(metro_v) AS metro_total,
           SUM(bus_v) AS bus_total,
           SUM(taxi_v) AS taxi_total,
           SUM(ridehail_v) AS ridehail_total,
           SUM(bike_v) AS bike_total
    FROM common_hours
),
long_fmt AS (
    SELECT '地铁进站量' AS metric, stat_hour, metro_v AS v, metro_total AS total

    UNION ALL

--   网约车下单量 = grid_flow_hour.ridehail_orders 按小时汇总

--   返回差值最大的小时（保留可能并列）
WITH m AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(entry_flow) AS metro_entry
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
r AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(ridehail_orders) AS rh_orders
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
j AS (
    SELECT m.stat_hour AS hour, m.metro_entry, r.rh_orders
    FROM m
    JOIN r ON r.stat_hour = m.stat_hour
),
p AS (
    SELECT hour,
           metro_entry * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(metro_entry) FROM j) AS metro_pct,
           rh_orders   * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(rh_orders)   FROM j) AS ridehail_pct
    FROM j
),
d AS (
    SELECT hour, metro_pct, ridehail_pct, ABS(metro_pct - ridehail_pct) AS diff

       ROUND(diff, 2)                                                  AS difference_pct
FROM d
WHERE diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM d)

long AS (
  SELECT geohash, 1 AS metric_id, '出租车下客' AS metric, (taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL) AS present FROM h

  SELECT geohash, 2 AS metric_id, '网约车下客' AS metric, (ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL) AS present FROM h
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geohash, 3 AS metric_id, '共享单车锁车' AS metric, (bike_locks IS NOT NULL) AS present FROM h
)
SELECT
  a.metric AS metric_a,
  b.metric AS metric_b,
  SUM(a.present AND b.present) AS intersection_count,
  SUM(a.present OR b.present) AS union_count,
  CAST(SUM(a.present AND b.present) AS REAL) / SUM(a.present OR b.present) AS jaccard
FROM long a
JOIN long b
  ON a.geohash = b.geohash

-- 口径：
--   1) 共同总体：2026-08-24 全天 taxi_dropoffs、ridehail_dropoffs、bike_locks 三项均有观测（SUM(列 IS NOT NULL) > 0）的网格；

--   3) 最终只返回正好有两个指标排名进入 Top-100 的网格；
--      taxi_rank/ridehail_rank/bike_rank 输出该网格在共同总体内的实际全天排名，其中恰好两个 ≤ 100，一个 > 100，均非空。
-- 单位：出租车下客=次，网约车下客=单，共享单车锁车=次；时间范围：2026-08-24 全天（0—23 时）。
WITH grid_totals AS (
    SELECT geohash,
           SUM(taxi_dropoffs)       AS taxi_total,
           SUM(ridehail_dropoffs)   AS ridehail_total,
           SUM(bike_locks)          AS bike_total,
           SUM(taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)     AS taxi_obs,
           SUM(ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL) AS ridehail_obs,
           SUM(bike_locks IS NOT NULL)        AS bike_obs
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY geohash
    HAVING taxi_obs > 0
       AND ridehail_obs > 0
       AND bike_obs > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT geohash,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY taxi_total     DESC, geohash ASC) AS taxi_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ridehail_total DESC, geohash ASC) AS ridehail_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bike_total     DESC, geohash ASC) AS bike_rank
    FROM grid_totals
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT geohash, taxi_rank, ridehail_rank, bike_rank,
           (taxi_rank     <= 100)
         + (ridehail_rank <= 100)
         + (bike_rank     <= 100) AS hit_count
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT geohash,
       CASE
           WHEN taxi_rank <= 100 AND ridehail_rank <= 100 THEN '出租车下客+网约车下客'
           WHEN taxi_rank <= 100 AND bike_rank <= 100     THEN '出租车下客+共享单车锁车'
           ELSE '网约车下客+共享单车锁车'
       END AS hotspot_pair,
       taxi_rank,
       ridehail_rank,
       bike_rank
FROM qualified
WHERE hit_count = 2
ORDER BY geohash ASC;

-- 早高峰/晚高峰：出租车下客 Top-20 网格与网约车下客 Top-20 网格的交集、并集与交并比
-- 数据：grid_flow_hour（日期 2026-08-24，上海本地时间；早高峰 7-9 时，晚高峰 17-19 时）
-- 口径：每个网格先按高峰时段汇总 taxi_dropoffs / ridehail_dropoffs（忽略 NULL，无观测网格不参与排名）；
--       Top-20 按 (下客量 DESC, geohash ASC) 排名取满 20 项，同值边界用 geohash 升序消歧。
WITH peak AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '早高峰' ELSE '晚高峰' END AS period,
         geohash,
         SUM(taxi_dropoffs)      AS taxi_sum,
         SUM(ridehail_dropoffs)  AS rh_sum
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND (stat_hour BETWEEN 7 AND 9 OR stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT period, geohash,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY taxi_sum DESC, geohash ASC) AS r_taxi,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY rh_sum   DESC, geohash ASC) AS r_rh
  FROM peak
),
combined AS (
  SELECT period, geohash, 1 AS in_taxi, 0 AS in_rh FROM ranked WHERE r_taxi <= 20
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period, geohash, 0, 1 FROM ranked WHERE r_rh <= 20
),
member AS (
  SELECT period, geohash, SUM(in_taxi) AS it, SUM(in_rh) AS ir
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY period, geohash
)
SELECT period,
       SUM(it * ir) AS intersection_count,
       COUNT(*)     AS union_count,
       ROUND(SUM(it * ir) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS jaccard
FROM member
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY CASE period WHEN '早高峰' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

-- 问题：对于出租车与网约车都有下客观测的网格，只在共同观测小时内比较峰值。
-- 峰值小时有重合和无重合的网格分别有多少？
-- 口径：2026-08-24（上海本地时间）；下客 = taxi_dropoffs / ridehail_dropoffs；
-- 网格需要至少存在一个“出租车下客与网约车下客同时有观测”的小时（共同观测小时）；
-- 峰值小时仅在共同观测小时内取：出租车峰值小时 = 共同观测小时中 taxi_dropoffs 最大的小时（含并列），
-- 网约车峰值小时同理；两类峰值小时集合相交（存在同一小时既是出租车峰值小时也是网约车峰值小时）记为“峰值小时有重合”。

WITH hourly AS (
  -- 每网格每小时的两指标最大值（主键粒度下即该小时唯一值），以及该小时是否为共同观测小时
  SELECT geohash,
         stat_hour,
         MAX(taxi_dropoffs)        AS taxi_max,
         MAX(ridehail_dropoffs)    AS rh_max,
         SUM(CASE WHEN taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_both
  FROM grid_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND (taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL OR ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY geohash, stat_hour
),
peak_values AS (
  -- 仅在共同观测小时内取两指标各自的峰值
  SELECT geohash,
         MAX(taxi_max) AS taxi_peak,
         MAX(rh_max)   AS rh_peak
  FROM hourly
  WHERE n_both > 0
  GROUP BY geohash
),
peak_hours AS (
  -- 标记每个共同观测小时是否为出租车峰值小时 / 网约车峰值小时（含并列）
  SELECT h.geohash,
         h.stat_hour,
         CASE WHEN h.taxi_max = p.taxi_peak THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_taxi_peak_hour,
         CASE WHEN h.rh_max   = p.rh_peak   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_rh_peak_hour
  FROM hourly h
  JOIN peak_values p USING (geohash)
  WHERE h.n_both > 0
),
grid_relation AS (
  -- 两类峰值小时存在同一小时 → 有重合
  SELECT geohash,
         MAX(is_taxi_peak_hour * is_rh_peak_hour) AS has_overlap
  FROM peak_hours
  GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT CASE WHEN has_overlap = 1 THEN '峰值小时有重合' ELSE '峰值小时无重合' END AS peak_relation,
       COUNT(*) AS grid_count
FROM grid_relation
GROUP BY has_overlap
ORDER BY has_overlap DESC;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT stat_date, stat_hour, geohash,
           taxi_dropoffs, ridehail_dropoffs, bike_locks
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
),
rank_taxi AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY stat_hour
               ORDER BY taxi_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
),
rank_rh AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY stat_hour
               ORDER BY ridehail_dropoffs DESC, geohash ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
),
rank_bike AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY stat_hour
               ORDER BY bike_locks DESC, geohash ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM base
    WHERE bike_locks IS NOT NULL
),
flags AS (
    SELECT b.stat_hour, b.geohash,
           MAX(CASE WHEN t.rn <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_taxi,
           MAX(CASE WHEN r.rn <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_rh,
           MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_bike
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN rank_taxi  t ON t.stat_hour = b.stat_hour AND t.geohash = b.geohash
    LEFT JOIN rank_rh    r ON r.stat_hour = b.stat_hour AND r.geohash = b.geohash
    LEFT JOIN rank_bike  k ON k.stat_hour = b.stat_hour AND k.geohash = b.geohash
    GROUP BY b.stat_hour, b.geohash
),
qual AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, geohash, in_taxi, in_rh, in_bike,
           in_taxi + in_rh + in_bike AS hotspot_types
    FROM flags
    WHERE in_taxi + in_rh + in_bike >= 2
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_grids_in_hour
    FROM qual
    GROUP BY stat_hour
)
SELECT q.stat_hour                                            AS "hour",
       q.geohash                                              AS "geohash",
       q.hotspot_types                                        AS "hotspot_types",
       CASE
           WHEN q.in_taxi = 1 AND q.in_rh = 1 AND q.in_bike = 1
               THEN '出租车下客+网约车下客+共享单车锁车'
           WHEN q.in_taxi = 1 AND q.in_rh = 1

FROM qual q
JOIN cnt c ON c.stat_hour = q.stat_hour
ORDER BY q.stat_hour, q.hotspot_types DESC, q.geohash;

WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT stat_hour,
           SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS rh_hour_total,
           SUM(bike_locks)        AS bike_hour_total
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
      AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY stat_hour
),
grid_rh AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS val
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND ridehail_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY stat_hour, geohash
),
grid_bike AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, SUM(bike_locks) AS val
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY stat_hour, geohash
),
top_rh AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, val,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY stat_hour
               ORDER BY val DESC, stat_hour ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM grid_rh
),
top_bike AS (
    SELECT stat_hour, val,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY stat_hour
               ORDER BY val DESC, stat_hour ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM grid_bike
),
conc AS (
    SELECT h.stat_hour,
           (SELECT SUM(val) FROM top_rh WHERE stat_hour = h.stat_hour AND rn <= 10) * 1.0
               / h.rh_hour_total AS ridehail_concentration,
           (SELECT SUM(val) FROM top_bike WHERE stat_hour = h.stat_hour AND rn <= 10) * 1.0
               / h.bike_hour_total AS bike_concentration
    FROM hourly h
),
avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ridehail_concentration) AS average_ridehail_concentration,
           AVG(bike_concentration) AS average_bike_concentration
    FROM conc
)
SELECT c.stat_hour AS hour,
       ROUND(c.ridehail_concentration, 6) AS ridehail_concentration,
       ROUND(c.bike_concentration, 6) AS bike_concentration,
       ROUND(a.average_ridehail_concentration, 6) AS average_ridehail_concentration,
       ROUND(a.average_bike_concentration, 6) AS average_bike_concentration
FROM conc c
CROSS JOIN avg a
WHERE c.ridehail_concentration > a.average_ridehail_concentration
  AND c.bike_concentration > a.average_bike_concentration

WITH metro_hourly AS (
    SELECT station_id, stat_hour, SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_flow

    GROUP BY station_id, stat_hour

bike_hourly AS (
    SELECT d.station_id, f.stat_hour, SUM(f.bike_locks) AS bike_locks
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN grid_flow_hour f
      ON f.geohash = d.geohash
     AND f.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
     AND f.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
    GROUP BY d.station_id, f.stat_hour
),
joint AS (
    SELECT m.station_id, m.stat_hour, m.exit_flow, b.bike_locks
    FROM metro_hourly m
    JOIN bike_hourly b
      ON b.station_id = m.station_id
     AND b.stat_hour = m.stat_hour
),
qual_stations AS (
    SELECT station_id
    FROM joint
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6
),
metro_peak AS (
    SELECT j.station_id, j.stat_hour
    FROM joint j

-- 日期： 2026-08-24（上海本地时间）
WITH two_stations AS (
    SELECT station_id, station_name
    FROM metro_station
    WHERE station_name IN ('徐家汇', '上海体育馆')
),
area_grids AS (
    SELECT
        d.geohash,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(d.station_id = 137) > 0 AND SUM(d.station_id = 186) > 0 THEN '两站都覆盖'
            WHEN SUM(d.station_id = 137) > 0 THEN '只靠近徐家汇'
            ELSE '只靠近上海体育馆'
        END AS area_type
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN two_stations t ON t.station_id = d.station_id
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 800
    GROUP BY d.geohash
),
evening AS (
    SELECT
        geohash,
        SUM(COALESCE(taxi_dropoffs, 0))     AS evening_taxi,
        SUM(COALESCE(ridehail_dropoffs, 0)) AS evening_ridehail,
        SUM(COALESCE(bike_locks, 0))        AS evening_bike
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 19
    GROUP BY geohash
)
SELECT
    a.area_type                                              AS area_type,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(e.evening_taxi), 0) AS INTEGER)        AS evening_taxi,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(e.evening_ridehail), 0) AS INTEGER)    AS evening_ridehail,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(e.evening_bike), 0) AS INTEGER)        AS evening_bike
FROM area_grids a
LEFT JOIN evening e ON e.geohash = a.geohash
GROUP BY a.area_type
ORDER BY CASE a.area_type
    WHEN '只靠近徐家汇' THEN 1
    WHEN '只靠近上海体育馆' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
END;

    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
    GROUP BY station_id
),
nearby AS (
    -- 500 米内地铁站—公交线路邻近关系（按实体标识去重）

WITH stations AS (

peak AS (

         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)    THEN f.stat_hour END) AS am_hours,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19) THEN f.stat_hour END) AS pm_hours
  FROM bus_flow_hour f

)

       b.line_name,
       p.morning_total,
       p.evening_total,

-- 将每条公交线路分配给 500 米内最近的地铁站（距离并列按 station_id 升序），
-- 按地铁站汇总：分配的线路数、所分配线路的全天公交客流，并给出该站全天进站量。
-- 全天 = 2026-08-24 全部小时有效观测，不补零。
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT station_id, bus_line_id, distance_m
  FROM metro_bus_line_distance
  WHERE distance_m <= 500
),
assigned AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, station_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      c.bus_line_id,
      c.station_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.bus_line_id
        ORDER BY c.distance_m ASC, c.station_id ASC
      ) AS rn
    FROM candidates c
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
bus_line_day AS (
  SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS total_flow
  FROM bus_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY bus_line_id
),
station_entry AS (
  SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_total
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
  GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.bus_line_id)  AS assigned_lines,
  SUM(COALESCE(b.total_flow, 0)) AS assigned_bus_total,
  COALESCE(e.entry_total, 0)     AS metro_entry_total
FROM metro_station s
LEFT JOIN assigned a        ON a.station_id = s.station_id
LEFT JOIN bus_line_day b    ON b.bus_line_id = a.bus_line_id
LEFT JOIN station_entry e   ON e.station_id = s.station_id
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY s.station_id;

--   * NULL 表示无观测、按 0 计入求和（COALESCE）；
--   * 排名按指标降序，DENSE_RANK 使并列取相同名次。
WITH line_grid AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.line_id, d.geohash
    FROM metro_flow_hour f
    JOIN metro_grid_distance d
      ON d.station_id = f.station_id
     AND d.distance_m <= 500
),
line_agg AS (
    SELECT lg.line_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(g.ridehail_dropoffs, 0)) AS evening_ridehail,
           SUM(COALESCE(g.bike_locks, 0))        AS evening_bike
    FROM line_grid lg
    LEFT JOIN grid_flow_hour g
      ON g.geohash = lg.geohash
     AND g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
     AND g.stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY lg.line_id
)
SELECT l.line_id,
       l.line_name,
       a.evening_ridehail,
       a.evening_bike,
       CAST(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.evening_ridehail DESC) AS INTEGER) AS ridehail_rank,
       CAST(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.evening_bike DESC) AS INTEGER)     AS bike_rank
FROM line_agg a
JOIN metro_line l ON l.line_id = a.line_id
ORDER BY ridehail_rank, bike_rank, l.line_id;

-- 和出租车下客量（taxi_dropoffs，次）最高的连续三小时窗口（按窗口起点小时 0-21）。
-- 仅统计窗口三个小时均有观测的窗口；bike 窗口与 taxi 窗口起点相同的站保留（含并列最高）。
-- 数据日期：2026-08-24（上海本地时间）；空间口径：metro_grid_distance.distance_m <= 500。

WITH bike_hour AS (
    -- 站点 500 米范围内网格的逐小时共享单车锁车量（仅计有观测行）
    SELECT d.station_id AS station_id,
           g.stat_hour  AS stat_hour,
           SUM(g.bike_locks) AS bike_locks
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN grid_flow_hour g
      ON g.geohash = d.geohash
     AND g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
      AND g.bike_locks IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.station_id, g.stat_hour
),
taxi_hour AS (
    -- 站点 500 米范围内网格的逐小时出租车下客量（仅计有观测行）
    SELECT d.station_id AS station_id,
           g.stat_hour  AS stat_hour,
           SUM(g.taxi_dropoffs) AS taxi_dropoffs
    FROM metro_grid_distance d
    JOIN grid_flow_hour g
      ON g.geohash = d.geohash
     AND g.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    WHERE d.distance_m <= 500
      AND g.taxi_dropoffs IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.station_id, g.stat_hour
),
bike_window AS (
    -- 连续三小时窗口 [h, h+1, h+2]，三小时均有观测才有效
    SELECT b1.station_id AS station_id,
           b1.stat_hour  AS start_hour,
           b1.bike_locks + b2.bike_locks + b3.bike_locks AS bike_window
    FROM bike_hour b1
    JOIN bike_hour b2 ON b2.station_id = b1.station_id AND b2.stat_hour = b1.stat_hour + 1
    JOIN bike_hour b3 ON b3.station_id = b1.station_id AND b3.stat_hour = b1.stat_hour + 2
),
taxi_window AS (
    SELECT t1.station_id AS station_id,
           t1.stat_hour  AS start_hour,
           t1.taxi_dropoffs + t2.taxi_dropoffs + t3.taxi_dropoffs AS taxi_window
    FROM taxi_hour t1
    JOIN taxi_hour t2 ON t2.station_id = t1.station_id AND t2.stat_hour = t1.stat_hour + 1
    JOIN taxi_hour t3 ON t3.station_id = t1.station_id AND t3.stat_hour = t1.stat_hour + 2
),
bike_max AS (
    SELECT station_id, MAX(bike_window) AS max_bike_window
    FROM bike_window
    GROUP BY station_id
),
taxi_max AS (
    SELECT station_id, MAX(taxi_window) AS max_taxi_window
    FROM taxi_window
    GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT s.station_id   AS station_id,
       s.station_name AS station_name,
       bw.start_hour  AS start_hour,
       bw.bike_window AS bike_window,
       tw.taxi_window AS taxi_window
FROM bike_max bm
JOIN bike_window bw
  ON bw.station_id = bm.station_id
 AND bw.bike_window = bm.max_bike_window
JOIN taxi_max tm
  ON tm.station_id = bm.station_id
JOIN taxi_window tw
  ON tw.station_id = tm.station_id
 AND tw.taxi_window = tm.max_taxi_window
JOIN metro_station s
  ON s.station_id = bm.station_id
WHERE bw.start_hour = tw.start_hour
ORDER BY s.station_id, start_hour;

-- 输出本站早高峰(7/8/9时)进站量、已选邻站中三个小时观测完整的站数及邻站合计；
-- 仅当所有已选邻站完整时才给出邻站合计，否则为 NULL。
-- 距离相同按 nearby_station_id 升序取满 K 项，不扩展并列。

WITH morning_entry AS (
  -- 各站早高峰(7,8,9时)进站量（物理站按 station_id 汇总全部线路记录）
  SELECT station_id, SUM(entry_flow) AS entry_total
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
  GROUP BY station_id
),
hours_observed AS (
  -- 各站早高峰有 entry_flow 观测的小时数（=3 视为三个小时观测完整）
  SELECT station_id, COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) AS hours_with_entry
  FROM metro_flow_hour
  WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND entry_flow IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY station_id
),
ranked_neighbors AS (
  -- 每站2公里内邻站按距离升序、距离相同按 nearby_station_id 升序排名
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY station_id
           ORDER BY distance_m, nearby_station_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM metro_station_distance
),
selected_neighbors AS (
  -- 固定取最近3个邻站，不扩展并列；不足3个时取全部可用邻站
  SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id
  FROM ranked_neighbors
  WHERE rn <= 3
),
agg AS (
  SELECT s.station_id,
         s.station_name,
         me.entry_total AS station_morning_entry,
         COUNT(sn.nearby_station_id) AS selected_neighbor_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ho.hours_with_entry = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_neighbor_count,
         SUM(me_n.entry_total) AS neighbor_sum
  FROM metro_station s
  LEFT JOIN selected_neighbors sn ON sn.station_id = s.station_id
  LEFT JOIN morning_entry me ON me.station_id = s.station_id
  LEFT JOIN morning_entry me_n ON me_n.station_id = sn.nearby_station_id
  LEFT JOIN hours_observed ho ON ho.station_id = sn.nearby_station_id
  GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, me.entry_total
)
SELECT station_id,
       station_name,
       station_morning_entry,
       selected_neighbor_count,
       valid_neighbor_count,
       CASE WHEN valid_neighbor_count = selected_neighbor_count
            THEN neighbor_sum END AS neighbor_entry_total
FROM agg
ORDER BY station_id;

-- 日期：2026-08-24（上海本地时间）；出站量为物理站全部线路之和。

WITH exit_peak AS (
    -- 晚高峰出站量：按物理站汇总全部线路，17/18/19 时三个小时均须有观测
    SELECT station_id,
           SUM(exit_flow) AS exit_peak
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY station_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) = 3
),
nearest AS (
    -- 每站的最近邻站：距离升序、距离并列时按 nearby_station_id 升序
    SELECT station_id, nearby_station_id, distance_m
    FROM (
        SELECT d.station_id,
               d.nearby_station_id,
               d.distance_m,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY d.station_id
                   ORDER BY d.distance_m, d.nearby_station_id
               ) AS rn
        FROM metro_station_distance d
        WHERE d.distance_m <= 2000
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pairs AS (
    -- 互为最近邻的站对；每对只保留一次，station_a 为 ID 较小者
    SELECT MIN(a.station_id, a.nearby_station_id) AS station_a_id,
           MAX(a.station_id, a.nearby_station_id) AS station_b_id,
           a.distance_m AS distance_m
    FROM nearest a
    JOIN nearest b
      ON b.station_id = a.nearby_station_id
     AND b.nearby_station_id = a.station_id
    WHERE a.station_id < a.nearby_station_id
)
SELECT
    p.station_a_id,
    sa.station_name  AS station_a_name,
    p.station_b_id,
    sb.station_name  AS station_b_name,
    p.distance_m,
    pa.exit_peak     AS station_a_exit,
    pb.exit_peak     AS station_b_exit,
    ABS(pa.exit_peak - pb.exit_peak) AS exit_difference
FROM pairs p

-- 问题：哪些地铁站 300 米内没有公交线路，但 300 至 800 米内至少有 3 条？
-- 输出：外围线路数(nearby_lines)、早高峰(7-9时)观测完整线路数(complete_lines)、
--       早高峰公交客流量(morning_bus_total)、本站早高峰出站量(morning_exit)、
--       本站早高峰观测小时数(metro_observed_hours)
-- 数据日期：2026-08-24（上海本地时间）；距离使用预计算 distance_m，米
WITH
-- 300 米内有公交线路的站
near AS (
    SELECT station_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bus_line_id) AS near_cnt
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance
    WHERE distance_m < 300
    GROUP BY station_id
),
-- 300 至 800 米（含边界）内有公交线路的站
mid AS (
    SELECT station_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bus_line_id) AS mid_cnt
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance
    WHERE distance_m >= 300 AND distance_m <= 800
    GROUP BY station_id
),
-- 满足空间条件的候选站：300 米内 0 条，且 300-800 米内 >= 3 条
cand AS (
    SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, m.mid_cnt AS nearby_lines
    FROM metro_station s
    JOIN mid m ON m.station_id = s.station_id
    LEFT JOIN near n ON n.station_id = s.station_id
    WHERE COALESCE(n.near_cnt, 0) = 0
      AND m.mid_cnt >= 3
),
-- 早高峰（7、8、9 时）各公交线路客流
bus_morning AS (
    SELECT bus_line_id, SUM(passenger_flow) AS morning_pf
    FROM bus_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24' AND stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9)
    GROUP BY bus_line_id
),
-- 候选站 300-800 米内每条线路：是否早高峰有观测 + 早高峰客流
station_lines AS (
    SELECT d.station_id,
           COUNT(*) AS nearby_lines,
           SUM(CASE WHEN bm.morning_pf IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_lines,
           SUM(COALESCE(bm.morning_pf, 0)) AS morning_bus_total
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance d
    JOIN cand c ON c.station_id = d.station_id
    LEFT JOIN bus_morning bm ON bm.bus_line_id = d.bus_line_id
    WHERE d.distance_m >= 300 AND d.distance_m <= 800
    GROUP BY d.station_id
),
-- 候选站早高峰出站量（全部线路记录汇总）与全天观测小时数
metro_agg AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN stat_hour IN (7, 8, 9) THEN exit_flow ELSE 0 END) AS morning_exit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT stat_hour) AS metro_observed_hours
    FROM metro_flow_hour
    WHERE station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM cand)
    GROUP BY station_id
)
SELECT c.station_id,
       c.station_name,
       sl.nearby_lines,
       sl.complete_lines,
       sl.morning_bus_total,
       ma.morning_exit,
       ma.metro_observed_hours
FROM cand c
JOIN station_lines sl ON sl.station_id = c.station_id
JOIN metro_agg ma ON ma.station_id = c.station_id
ORDER BY c.station_id;

  WHERE distance_m <= 800

  WHERE gf.stat_date = '2026-08-24'
)

  CAST(added_taxi AS INTEGER)                              AS added_taxi,
  CAST(base_taxi AS INTEGER)                               AS base_taxi,

    SELECT d.station_id, SUM(COALESCE(lg.locks, 0)) AS locks

),

    SELECT ls.line_id, SUM(sl.locks) AS station_sum_locks

),
line_union AS (
    SELECT lg.line_id, SUM(g.locks) AS union_locks
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT d.line_id, d.geohash
        FROM metro_grid_distance d
        JOIN line_station ls ON ls.station_id = d.station_id
        WHERE d.distance_m <= 500

    LEFT JOIN locks_by_grid g ON g.geohash = lg.geohash
    GROUP BY lg.line_id

    m.line_name,
    ss.station_sum_locks,
    lu.union_locks,
    ss.station_sum_locks - lu.union_locks AS repeated_locks,
    ROUND((ss.station_sum_locks - lu.union_locks) * 100.0 / ss.station_sum_locks, 2) AS repeated_pct
FROM metro_line m
JOIN station_sum ss ON ss.line_id = m.line_id
JOIN line_union lu ON lu.line_id = m.line_id

-- 对每个地铁站：800米内最近的5条公交线路，再从中选全天(2026-08-24)客流最高的一条
-- 口径：
--   候选 = metro_bus_line_distance 中 distance_m <= 800 的行（预计算距离，最大保存1000米）
--   距离名次 near_rank = 按 (distance_m 升序, bus_line_id 升序) 的 ROW_NUMBER（距离并列按 bus_line_id 消歧，取满5条不扩展并列）
--   全天客流 = bus_flow_hour 中 2026-08-24 各小时 passenger_flow 求和（不将缺失小时补零）
--   从5条中选 daily_bus_total 最高者；客流并列时按 bus_line_id 升序消歧
--   无候选的地铁站（含距离表无行或800米内无线路）输出 NULL 候选字段
WITH cand AS (
    SELECT station_id,
           bus_line_id,
           distance_m,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY station_id
               ORDER BY distance_m ASC, bus_line_id ASC
           ) AS near_rank
    FROM metro_bus_line_distance
    WHERE distance_m <= 800
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT station_id, bus_line_id, distance_m, near_rank
    FROM cand
    WHERE near_rank <= 5
),
line_flow AS (
    SELECT bus_line_id,
           SUM(passenger_flow) AS daily_bus_total
    FROM bus_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
    GROUP BY bus_line_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT t.station_id,
           t.bus_line_id,
           t.distance_m,
           t.near_rank,
           lf.daily_bus_total,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY t.station_id
               ORDER BY lf.daily_bus_total DESC, t.bus_line_id ASC
           ) AS fr
    FROM top5 AS t
    LEFT JOIN line_flow AS lf ON lf.bus_line_id = t.bus_line_id
)
SELECT r.station_id                                     AS station_id,
       s.station_name                                   AS station_name,
       r.bus_line_id                                    AS bus_line_id,
       b.line_name                                      AS line_name,
       r.daily_bus_total                                AS daily_bus_total,
       r.distance_m                                     AS distance_m,
       r.near_rank                                      AS near_rank
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN metro_station AS s ON s.station_id = r.station_id
LEFT JOIN bus_line AS b ON b.bus_line_id = r.bus_line_id
WHERE r.fr = 1
ORDER BY r.station_id ASC;

-- G26: 将地铁站1公里内网格唯一分配给最近站，按 0-300 / 300-500 / 500-1000 米三环
-- 统计 2026-08-24 晚高峰（17、18、19时）共享单车锁车量与网约车下车完单量。
-- 口径：唯一归属取最小 distance_m，距离并列按 station_id 升序；
--       0-300 含两端，300-500 与 500-1000 左开右闭；
--       每站三环全保留，无分配网格或无观测时指标为 NULL。

WITH evening AS (
    -- 晚高峰各网格指标（NULL 观测不补零，仅求和有效观测）
    SELECT geohash,
           SUM(bike_locks)        AS evening_bike,
           SUM(ridehail_dropoffs) AS evening_ridehail
    FROM grid_flow_hour
    WHERE stat_date = '2026-08-24'
      AND stat_hour IN (17, 18, 19)
    GROUP BY geohash
),
assigned AS (
    -- 每个网格唯一分配给最近站；距离并列时按 station_id 升序
    SELECT station_id, geohash, distance_m
    FROM (
        SELECT station_id,
               geohash,
               distance_m,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY geohash
                   ORDER BY distance_m ASC, station_id ASC
               ) AS rn
        FROM metro_grid_distance
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
rings AS (
    -- 三环划分：[0,300] / (300,500] / (500,1000]
    SELECT station_id,
           geohash,
           CASE
               WHEN distance_m <= 300 THEN '0-300'
               WHEN distance_m <= 500 THEN '300-500'
               ELSE '500-1000'
           END AS ring
    FROM assigned
),
stations_rings AS (
    -- 每站 × 三环完整骨架，保证无网格的环也保留
    SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, r.ring
    FROM metro_station s
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT '0-300' AS ring
        UNION ALL SELECT '300-500'
        UNION ALL SELECT '500-1000'
    ) r
),
agg AS (
    -- 按站按环聚合晚高峰指标；环内无晚高峰观测时 SUM 为 NULL
    SELECT rg.station_id,
           rg.ring,
           SUM(e.evening_bike)      AS evening_bike,
           SUM(e.evening_ridehail)  AS evening_ridehail
    FROM rings rg
    LEFT JOIN evening e ON e.geohash = rg.geohash
    GROUP BY rg.station_id, rg.ring
)
SELECT sr.station_id,
       sr.station_name,
       sr.ring,
       a.evening_bike,
       a.evening_ridehail
FROM stations_rings sr
LEFT JOIN agg a
       ON a.station_id = sr.station_id
      AND a.ring = sr.ring
ORDER BY sr.station_id,
         CASE sr.ring WHEN '0-300' THEN 1 WHEN '300-500' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

-- 口径：预计算物理距离表 metro_grid_distance（覆盖 1,000 米内），

SELECT
  s.station_id AS station_id,
  s.station_name AS station_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.geohash) AS grid_count
FROM metro_station AS s
LEFT JOIN metro_grid_distance AS d
  ON d.station_id = s.station_id
 AND d.distance_m <= 500
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
ORDER BY s.station_id;
